title: AI Can Change Your Cybersecurity Culture: Is That What You Intended?
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, KPMG, KPMG, KPMG, KPMG, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and KPMG

detail.title: AI Can Change Your Cybersecurity Culture: Is That What You Intended?
detail.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into so many facets of business operations is changing organizational processes and practices, and creating new challenges in human risk management. While organizational leaders are still discovering effective methods to leverage AI, they must also minimize the new human risks. One way to reduce human risk is by building and strengthening the cybersecurity culture of an organization. We define culture as the attitudes, beliefs, and values that drive employee behavior. This research studied how AI impacts human risk management by fostering or hindering cybersecurity culture, uncovering recommendations that managers can employ to enhance their cybersecurity culture maturity. This study does not focus on the potential for AI to replace humans. Instead, the goal is to enhance general managers' understanding of both the intended and unintended consequences of AI on their cybersecurity culture and providing actionable insights to improve the effectiveness of their decisions on investments in culture. Three Key Points: 1. Leaders have a responsibility to find ways to keep their organizations cybersecure and resilient and the adoption of AI is making this an increasingly urgent need. Managing human risk through driving a culture of cybersecurity is one of their key tools. 2. AI can positively and negatively influence a cybersecurity culture, the values, attitudes and beliefs that drive cybersecure behaviors, and leaders need new mechanisms to manage both the intended and unintended consequences. 3. AI creates new ways for managers to have visibility, efficiencies, quantification, personalization and scalability of mechanisms they use to influence the cybersecurity culture of their organization. Using these approaches sparks new ways to use AI tools to build, change, and mature culture.

AI.tldr: AI在商业运营中的广泛应用改变了组织流程和实践，给人类风险管理带来新挑战。本研究探讨AI如何通过促进或阻碍网络安全文化来影响人类风险管理，为管理者提供增强网络安全文化成熟度的建议。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过促进或阻碍网络安全文化来影响人类风险管理？管理者可以采取哪些措施来增强组织的网络安全文化成熟度？
AI.motivation: AI在商业运营中的快速整合正在改变组织流程和实践，同时带来了新的人类风险管理挑战。组织领导者需要找到有效利用AI的方法，同时最小化新的人类风险。加强网络安全文化是减少人类风险的重要途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化理论（将文化定义为驱动员工行为的价值观、态度和信念）；网络安全文化成熟度模型；人类风险管理框架；AI对组织文化影响的双重性理论（积极和消极影响）
AI.method: 基于文献综述和理论分析的研究方法，通过分析AI对网络安全文化的影响机制，提出管理建议和行动框架。
AI.findings: 1. AI对网络安全文化具有双重影响：既能促进也能阻碍网络安全文化发展；2. 领导者需要新的机制来管理AI带来的预期和非预期后果；3. AI为管理者提供了增强可见性、效率、量化、个性化和规模化能力的新途径来影响网络安全文化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了AI影响网络安全文化的理论框架；2. 提出了AI对组织文化双重影响的理论视角；3. 发展了网络安全文化成熟度与AI整合的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供了增强网络安全文化成熟度的具体建议；2. 提出了利用AI工具建设、改变和成熟组织文化的创新方法；3. 提供了投资网络安全文化的决策指导。

title: The Architecture of American Global Power: Military, Economic, Institutional, and Cultural Foundations
affiliations: Loyola College, Chennai - Department of Commerce

detail.title: The Architecture of American Global Power: Military, Economic, Institutional, and Cultural Foundations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently and without any commercial or political affiliations that may constitute a conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual and theoretical analysis based exclusively on secondary sources and publicly available scholarly literature. It does not involve human participants, personal data, clinical trials, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as part of independent academic research.

detail.abstract: The global influence of the United States has been one of the defining features of the modern international system. From economic dominance and military capability to technological innovation and cultural outreach, American power operates across multiple dimensions. This conceptual article provides a comprehensive and inclusive analysis of how and why the United States has emerged as one of the most powerful nations in the world. Drawing from international relations theory, political economy, institutional analysis, and soft power scholarship, the study examines economic strength, financial hegemony, military projection, technological leadership, geopolitical positioning, alliance networks, institutional influence, and cultural reach. At the same time, it critically evaluates internal structural challenges, global competition, inequality, and debates surrounding legitimacy and global governance. The paper argues that American power is multidimensional, institutionalized, and adaptive rather than purely coercive. However, sustaining global influence requires responsible governance, inclusive economic development, ethical diplomacy, and multilateral cooperation in an increasingly multipolar world.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国全球影响力的多维性、制度化特征和适应性进行了概念性分析，探讨了美国如何成为世界强国及其面临的挑战，强调维持全球影响力需要负责任的治理和多边合作。
AI.research_question: 美国如何以及为何成为世界上最强大的国家之一？其全球影响力的本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国在全球体系中的主导地位是现代国际关系的重要特征，需要从多维度、综合性的角度理解其权力来源和运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论、政治经济学、制度分析、软权力理论
AI.method: 概念性文章，采用综合性和包容性的分析方法
AI.findings: 美国权力具有多维性（经济、军事、技术、文化等）、制度化和适应性特征，而非纯粹的强制性权力；但面临内部结构挑战、全球竞争和不平等等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对美国全球影响力的多维分析框架，强调权力的制度化和适应性特征，挑战了纯粹强制性的权力观。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出维持美国全球影响力需要负责任的治理、包容性经济发展、道德外交和多边合作，为政策制定者提供了在日益多极化的世界中维持影响力的战略建议。

title: Design and Implementation of Scalable AI-Driven Conversational Systems for Enterprise-Level Feedback Intelligence and Decision Support
affiliations: University of Missouri at Kansas City

detail.title: Design and Implementation of Scalable AI-Driven Conversational Systems for Enterprise-Level Feedback Intelligence and Decision Support

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study utilized synthetic, non-identifiable enterprise-style datasets generated for research and demonstration purposes. No human subjects or confidential organizational data were involved. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Organizations are leveraging conversational AI technology to extract continuous feedback and improve complex decision-making processes in customer experience, day-today business, and strategic planning. Recent developments in large language models, dialog management, and cloud-native platforms have led to scalable multi-agent conversational AI systems that can convert unstructured dialogue interactions into actionable feedback intelligence and interactive decision support tools. This paper outlines a scalable reference architecture that can aggregate AI-enabled conversational systems, including omnichannel interaction, conversational intelligence, feedback intelligence, and decision support. The paper discusses implementation challenges, gaps, and future directions in multimodal feedback intelligence, federated learning, and human-AI deliberation in high-stakes decision-making in enterprise systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的参考架构，用于整合AI驱动的对话系统，包括全渠道交互、对话智能、反馈智能和决策支持，并讨论了实施挑战和未来方向。
AI.research_question: 如何构建可扩展的多智能体对话AI系统架构，将非结构化对话交互转化为可操作的反馈智能和交互式决策支持工具？
AI.motivation: 组织正在利用对话AI技术提取持续反馈并改进客户体验、日常业务和战略规划中的复杂决策过程。大型语言模型、对话管理和云原生平台的最新发展为构建可扩展系统提供了可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大型语言模型、对话管理、云原生架构、多智能体系统、反馈智能和决策支持理论。
AI.method: 提出可扩展参考架构设计方法，包括系统组件整合、实施挑战分析和未来方向探讨。
AI.findings: 开发了一个能够聚合AI驱动对话系统的参考架构，涵盖全渠道交互、对话智能、反馈智能和决策支持组件。
AI.theory_contributions: 为多智能体对话AI系统提供了理论架构框架，扩展了反馈智能和决策支持的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业实施对话AI系统提供了可操作的参考架构，帮助组织将非结构化对话转化为有价值的反馈和决策支持工具。

title: Balancing Acts: Unveiling the Dynamics of Post Removal on Social Media User-Generated Content
affiliations: and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: Balancing Acts: Unveiling the Dynamics of Post Removal on Social Media User-Generated Content
detail.abstract: User-generated content (UGC) is pivotal in driving the adoption and engagement of platforms, influencing both users and platform owners. Despite UGC's positive impact, users often violate platform guidelines and generate low-quality content. In response to these challenges, online platforms commonly employ content moderation strategies, including the removal of posts that violate community guidelines (e.g., creating a civil and safe community). The impact of post removal on subsequent UGC creation remains uncertain. Some studies suggest that moderation tactics, such as user bans, induce a psychological backlash, potentially leading to increased UGC quantity but a decline in quality. Conversely, the learning theory suggests that the removal of posts can serve as a disciplinary measure, encouraging users to learn and internalize community guidelines and adjust their behavior accordingly. We explore the consequences of post removal on UGC quality on Reddit. Additionally, we explore the learning processes derived from users' own experiences of being punished, from users' observations of others facing similar consequences, and from the underlying reasons for moderation. Our findings indicate that post removal significantly decreases users' future rule violations and encourages the generation of higher-quality posts (as evidenced by an increase in upvotes). These results suggest that post removal, as a disciplinary measure, fosters user learning, motivating users to adhere to community guidelines and contribute superior quality content. This study's implications extend to theoretical and practical domains and provide valuable insights for platform operators on leveraging post removal as a content moderation strategy to guide users toward producing high-quality content.

AI.tldr: 研究Reddit平台上帖子删除对用户生成内容质量的影响，发现帖子删除作为纪律措施能促进用户学习，减少违规行为并提高内容质量
AI.research_question: 帖子删除对用户后续生成内容的质量有何影响？用户如何从自身受罚经历、观察他人受罚以及理解审核原因中学习？
AI.motivation: 用户生成内容对平台至关重要，但用户经常违反平台准则并产生低质量内容。平台采用内容审核策略（如删除违规帖子），但其对后续UGC创建的影响尚不明确，存在相互矛盾的理论观点
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 心理反弹理论：审核策略可能引发心理反弹，导致UGC数量增加但质量下降；2. 学习理论：帖子删除可作为纪律措施，促使用户学习并内化社区准则，调整行为
AI.method: 在Reddit平台上进行研究，分析帖子删除对用户后续行为的影响，考察用户从自身受罚经历、观察他人受罚以及理解审核原因三个维度的学习过程
AI.findings: 帖子删除显著减少用户未来的规则违反行为，并鼓励生成更高质量的帖子（表现为点赞数增加）。这表明帖子删除作为纪律措施能促进用户学习
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了学习理论在内容审核领域的适用性；2. 区分了用户学习的三个维度（自身经历、观察他人、理解原因）；3. 为平台内容审核策略提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台运营商提供有价值的见解：帖子删除可作为有效的内容审核策略，引导用户生产高质量内容，帮助平台管理者制定更有效的内容治理策略

title: A Context-Aware Framework for Secure Fintech APIs: Leveraging Java Spring Boot and OAuth 2.0 with Dynamic Token Adaptation

detail.title: A Context-Aware Framework for Secure Fintech APIs: Leveraging Java Spring Boot and OAuth 2.0 with Dynamic Token Adaptation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Information Systems Engineering and Management 2025, 10(49s)

detail.abstract: Fintech applications are generally designed to maintain ultra low latency sub 25 ms p99 and high performance and enterprise grade security requirements to secure millions of high value transactions. This paper presents Dynamic Contextual OAuth Token Adaptation (DCOTA), an innovative Java SpringBoot framework built to enhance standard Oauth 2 flows in real-time with context-aware token policies. We calculate a per request risk score considering device fingerprinting, geolocation, transaction amount and network jitter and dynamically augmenting JSON Web Token (JWT) scope, time to live (TTL), and rate limits on the fly. We designed a three-tier architecture consists of a mutual TLS terminating API Gateway, a DCOTA filtering layer that validates with JWK backed JWTs, and Spring Boot resource servers that use clustered Redis as storage for atomic revocation. We calculated time complexity of DCOTA to be O(1) and revocation in O(logN) (Eq. 1-2). A comprehensive test suite includes functional testing using JUnit 5 & Mockito, load testing using Apache JMeter, and penetration using OWASP ZAP & Burp Suite. Under WAN emulation we achieved 50 ms RTT at 0.1 % packet loss. DCOTA incurs only a 2 ms median latency overhead and 84 % less unauthorized attempts while keeping ≥ 230 TPS. The outcomes affirm DCOTA's variant and contemporary high performance, secure fintech API deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCOTA框架，通过动态上下文感知的OAuth令牌适配，在实时交易中根据风险评分调整JWT范围、TTL和速率限制，实现高性能金融科技API安全部署。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持金融科技应用超低延迟（p99 < 25ms）和高性能的同时，通过动态上下文感知的OAuth令牌适配增强API安全性？
AI.motivation: 金融科技应用需要处理数百万高价值交易，要求超低延迟（p99 < 25ms）、高性能和企业级安全性，传统OAuth 2.0流程缺乏实时上下文感知能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OAuth 2.0授权框架，结合动态风险评估、设备指纹识别、地理位置分析、交易金额和网络抖动等上下文因素，构建动态令牌策略理论。
AI.method: 采用三层架构：1) 双向TLS终止API网关；2) DCOTA过滤层（JWK验证JWT）；3) Spring Boot资源服务器（集群Redis原子撤销）。使用JUnit 5、Mockito、Apache JMeter、OWASP ZAP和Burp Suite进行功能、负载和渗透测试。
AI.findings: DCOTA时间复杂度为O(1)，撤销操作为O(logN)；在WAN仿真中实现50ms RTT（0.1%丢包率）；仅增加2ms中位延迟开销；减少84%未授权尝试；保持≥230 TPS吞吐量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出动态上下文感知令牌适配理论框架，扩展标准OAuth 2.0流程，实现基于实时风险评分的动态令牌策略调整。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供Java SpringBoot框架实现，支持金融科技API的高性能安全部署，显著降低未授权访问风险，同时保持超低延迟和高吞吐量。

title: When Assurance Distorts Judgment: How Cybersecurity Governance Shapes Expert Cognition Under Digital Uncertainty
affiliations: , University of Gdansk and University of Gdansk

detail.title: When Assurance Distorts Judgment: How Cybersecurity Governance Shapes Expert Cognition Under Digital Uncertainty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

keywords: Cybersecurity assurance can distort expert judgment under digital uncertainty
Reporting structures shape confidence in cyber-risk governance
Introduces assurance-induced cognitive distortion as a governance mechanism

detail.abstract: Organizations invest heavily in formal cybersecurity assurance mechanisms such as audits, compliance reviews, and structured reporting lines to reduce uncertainty and strengthen control. Yet it remains theoretically underexplored how these governance structures may inadvertently reshape executive risk cognition under persistent digital uncertainty. Moving beyond trait-based accounts of overconfidence and optimism, this study theorizes assurance-induced cognitive distortion as a governance-level mechanism through which formal assurance architectures attenuate experiential learning signals, elevate perceived control, and systematically miscalibrate executive judgment. Drawing on survey data from 144 CISOs, CIOs, and senior cyber leaders across medium-to-large organizations, complemented by exploratory expert interviews, we examine how variation in assurance intensity and governance design relates to confidence calibration and optimism in cyber-risk assessment. The findings indicate that audit-intensive environments and the absence of experiential simulations are associated with elevated overconfidence, whereas governance structures that position the CISO outside the IT function are associated with lower overconfidence. By identifying how cybersecurity governance architectures can unintentionally distort executive judgment, this study advances strategic information systems research by shifting attention from individual cognitive dispositions toward the structural design of assurance systems and their implications for adaptive cyber capability under digital uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，正式的网络安全保证机制（如审计、合规审查）虽然旨在降低不确定性，但可能通过"保证诱导的认知扭曲"机制，削弱高管从经验中学习的能力，提升其感知控制感，从而系统性地导致高管在网络安全风险评估中过度自信和乐观偏差。
AI.research_question: 正式的网络安全保证机制如何影响高管的风险认知和判断校准？具体来说，保证机制的强度和治理设计如何与高管在网络安全风险评估中的信心校准和乐观程度相关联？
AI.motivation: 组织在正式的网络安全保证机制（如审计、合规审查、结构化报告线）上投入大量资源以降低不确定性和加强控制，但这些治理结构如何在持续的数字不确定性下无意中重塑高管的风险认知，这在理论上尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了"保证诱导的认知扭曲"这一治理层面的机制，认为正式的保证架构会削弱经验学习信号，提升感知控制，并系统性地导致高管判断失准。超越了基于特质的过度自信和乐观解释。
AI.method: 使用144名CISO、CIO和高级网络安全领导者的调查数据，辅以探索性的专家访谈，考察保证强度和治理设计的变化如何与网络安全风险评估中的信心校准和乐观程度相关联。
AI.findings: 审计密集型环境和缺乏经验模拟与更高的过度自信相关；而将CISO置于IT职能之外的治理结构与较低的过度自信相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过识别网络安全治理架构如何无意中扭曲高管判断，本研究将战略信息系统研究的注意力从个体认知倾向转向保证系统的结构设计及其在数字不确定性下对自适应网络能力的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计网络安全治理结构提供了重要启示：避免过度依赖审计密集型环境，引入经验模拟，并考虑将CISO职能独立于IT部门之外，以降低高管过度自信的风险。

title: Implementing AI-Driven Decision Support in Agricultural Lending Through Predictive Analytics for Customer Relationship Management
affiliations: and

detail.title: Implementing AI-Driven Decision Support in Agricultural Lending Through Predictive Analytics for Customer Relationship Management

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Intelligent Management Decision, volume 5, issue 1, 2026[10.56578/jimd050102]

detail.abstract: This work provides a complete methodology for adopting well-established AI methods (predictive analytics, LLM agents, forecasting) into Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Relationship Management (CRM) for agricultural lending. While not claiming that the algorithms are novel, this work contributes a pragmatic approach to implementing these algorithms that specifically address the regulatory, seasonal, and operational characteristics of agricultural finance, as regulated by the Farm Credit System. It focuses on the real-life constraints and constraints within the regulated financial services industry, and measurable impacts that occurred. The paper provides a domain-oriented application of specific existing AI-CRM integration, with credible statistical testing including an external validation on USDA datasets and benchmarking across peer Farm Credit institutions, as well as crossinstitutional analysis. By taking a reasonably conservative duration of 18 months, the Farm Credit institutions noted a statistically significant impact (operational efficiencies of the lending institution to assess member interests) where average case resolution time reduced by 28% (67.2h to 48.4h), and lead conversions improved by 35% (25.9% to 35.0%). Each methodology of implementation also included a series of validations in compliance with regulatory oversight in financial institutions that started to build data governance, model performance compliance through a proactive risk definition, and compliance standards suitable for their institution, and within regulatory standards by regulations. Beyond statistical significance (paired tests, p < 0.001), practical impact was quantified using absolute and relative changes and bootstrap confidence intervals. The article provides the agricultural lending industry an applied methodology to adopt AI for stakeholder innovation while ensuring they are adept in their enterprise risk management requirement, and still target measurable business outcomes. Given a conservative potential implementation timetable (i.e., 18 months) and validation methodology protocols developed to ensure complete data and model validation, this approach is scalable for agricultural lending implementation and would be a useful instrument across all 72 Farm Credit System institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套完整的AI-CRM集成方法论，专门针对农业信贷行业，在微软Dynamics 365 CRM平台上实施预测分析、LLM智能体和预测技术，在18个月内显著提升了运营效率（案件处理时间减少28%，潜在客户转化率提升35%），同时满足金融监管要求。
AI.research_question: 如何在受监管的农业信贷行业（特别是Farm Credit System机构）中，将成熟的AI方法（预测分析、LLM智能体、预测技术）有效集成到微软Dynamics 365 CRM系统中，同时满足监管要求并实现可衡量的业务成果？
AI.motivation: 农业信贷行业面临独特的监管、季节性和运营挑战，现有AI-CRM集成方案缺乏针对这些特定约束的实用方法。金融机构需要既能创新又能满足严格监管要求的AI实施方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI-CRM集成理论、农业金融风险管理框架、监管科技（RegTech）原则，以及企业风险管理（ERM）在金融服务业的应用。
AI.method: 采用18个月的保守实施时间表，包括：1）针对农业信贷特点的AI算法定制；2）符合监管要求的数据治理和模型验证流程；3）外部验证（USDA数据集）；4）同行基准测试（Farm Credit机构间比较）；5）统计测试（配对检验p<0.001）和自助法置信区间；6）跨机构分析。
AI.findings: 实施后取得显著效果：平均案件处理时间从67.2小时减少到48.4小时（减少28%），潜在客户转化率从25.9%提升到35.0%（提升35%）。统计显著性高（p<0.001），同时建立了符合监管要求的数据治理和模型合规框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了针对受监管农业信贷行业的AI-CRM集成理论框架；2）发展了在严格监管环境下平衡创新与合规的AI实施理论；3）扩展了农业金融科技的理论基础，特别是针对Farm Credit System的特定需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为72家Farm Credit System机构提供了可扩展的AI实施路线图；2）开发了符合金融监管要求的验证方法协议；3）提供了具体的业务成果衡量指标（效率提升28-35%）；4）建立了数据治理和模型合规标准；5）展示了如何在18个月内实现可衡量的投资回报。

title: Incognito Consumer Harm
affiliations: Hofstra University - Maurice A. Deane School of Law

detail.title: Incognito Consumer Harm
detail.abstract:
What good is a legal system built for visible injuries in a world where injury is designed to be invisible? This Article identifies and theorizes incognito consumer harm: consumer-facing wrongdoing designed to remain unnoticed by most victims. A robot vacuum cleaner covertly records video inside consumers’ homes. A seemingly helpful browser extension records everything users do on the internet. A dating app quietly retains photo IDs it promised to delete. Because consumers cannot readily detect these harms, the law’s ordinary enforcement triggers rarely fire: victims do not complain, lawyers are not retained, and regulators receive no report. Thus, discovery of incognito consumer harm depends more on leaks, hacks, whistleblowers, and other accidents than on routine enforcement mechanisms.

Incognito consumer harm matters for three reasons. First, it exposes a structural weakness in U.S. consumer protection. Both public and private enforcement depend on the victims’ awareness, but courts cannot litigate the invisible and agencies do not routinely audit products for concealed design choices. Second, it highlights a diagnosis-cure mismatch in the literature. Even when scholars describe “invisible” harms, they often propose remedies that assume detection, such as procedural reforms, bans, and enhanced damages, even though incognito harm is designed precisely to prevent detection. Third, modern technology makes concealment scalable, continuous, and embedded in everyday products. As AI increases firms’ appetite for granular and intimate data, the payoff to undiscoverable extraction only grows.

This Article argues that incognito consumer harm requires fundamental reform, not marginal tweaks, because existing law fails doubly. It is not built to surface invisible injuries and, even when misconduct is exposed, doctrine often fails to recognize concealed risk, loss of control, and informational deprivation as cognizable harms. Without detection-first reform, the status quo persists. We learn about hidden misconduct only when systems are breached or insiders come forward—in effect, relying on wrongdoers to expose wrongdoing.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并理论化了"隐形消费者伤害"——企业故意设计成让大多数受害者无法察觉的消费者伤害行为。由于消费者难以发现这些伤害，传统法律执行机制失效，导致此类伤害主要依赖泄密、黑客攻击等偶然事件才能被发现。
AI.research_question: 在消费者伤害被设计成隐形的情况下，法律体系如何有效应对这种新型消费者保护挑战？
AI.motivation: 现代技术使得企业能够大规模、持续性地将伤害设计成隐形状态（如智能设备秘密录制视频、浏览器扩展记录用户行为、应用保留承诺删除的数据）。由于消费者无法察觉这些伤害，传统法律执行机制（投诉、诉讼、监管报告）失效，导致此类伤害主要依赖偶然事件才能被发现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐形消费者伤害理论：企业故意设计消费者伤害使其对大多数受害者不可察觉；法律执行的结构性弱点：公法和私法执行都依赖受害者意识；诊断-治疗不匹配：现有文献提出的解决方案假设伤害能被发现，但隐形伤害恰恰旨在防止被发现。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究：通过识别和分析隐形消费者伤害现象，构建理论框架，批判现有法律体系和学术文献的不足。
AI.findings: 1. 隐形消费者伤害暴露了美国消费者保护的结构性弱点；2. 现有学术文献存在诊断-治疗不匹配问题；3. 现代技术使隐蔽行为可扩展、持续且嵌入日常产品；4. 现有法律双重失败：既无法发现隐形伤害，又在伤害暴露后往往不承认隐蔽风险、控制权丧失和信息剥夺为可诉伤害。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统识别和理论化"隐形消费者伤害"概念；2. 揭示了法律执行对受害者意识的依赖这一结构性缺陷；3. 指出了学术文献中诊断与治疗方案的不匹配；4. 为消费者保护理论提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 呼吁根本性改革而非边际调整；2. 提出需要"检测优先"的改革方案；3. 警示随着AI发展，企业对精细和私密数据的渴求将增加不可发现数据提取的回报；4. 为政策制定者、监管机构和法律实践者提供了应对隐形消费者伤害的新视角。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Judiciary: A Threat to the Rule of Law?

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Judiciary: A Threat to the Rule of Law?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Monika Zalnieriute and Agne Limante (eds), The Cambridge Handbook of AI and Technologies in Courts, Cambridge University Press, 2026.

detail.abstract: AI applications are increasingly deployed in the judiciary for a wide array of tasks, denoted as ‘judicial AI’. The implications for the legal system are vast. In this chapter, I focus on the effects of judicial AI on the rule of law, given the judiciary’s essential role in safeguarding this value. After examining what is meant by the rule of law, three sets of questions guide my analysis. First, how does the turn from text-driven to code- and data-driven legal interpretation affect the nature of law? Is there a risk that instead of fostering the rule of law, this leads to algorithmic rule by law? Second, since AI applications are designed by human beings, delegating judicial tasks to AI implies a delegation to the coders developing it. To what extent can this result in a rule of coders? And last, what impact does judicial AI have on the separation of powers, given that the executive and legislative branch of power control the judiciary’s resources? Can it undermine the judiciary’s ability to check and balance the other branches of power? The answers to these questions force me to conclude that many concerns must be addressed prior to judicial AI’s wide-scale adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨司法AI对法治的影响，分析了从文本驱动到代码/数据驱动的法律解释转变、开发者权力转移以及三权分立平衡问题，认为大规模采用司法AI前需解决诸多担忧。
AI.research_question: 司法AI如何影响法治？具体包括：1) 从文本驱动到代码/数据驱动的法律解释转变如何影响法律本质？2) 司法任务委托给AI开发者是否会导致"程序员统治"？3) 司法AI对三权分立有何影响？
AI.motivation: AI在司法领域的应用日益广泛，对法律体系影响深远。鉴于司法部门在维护法治方面的核心作用，需要深入分析司法AI对法治价值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法治理论、法律解释理论、权力分立理论、算法治理理论、技术伦理框架
AI.method: 概念分析、理论推理、规范性分析、问题导向的批判性分析
AI.findings: 1) 从文本到代码/数据驱动的法律解释转变可能改变法律本质，存在算法"依法"统治而非促进法治的风险；2) 司法任务委托给AI开发者可能导致"程序员统治"；3) 司法AI可能削弱司法部门对其他权力分支的制衡能力，特别是在行政和立法部门控制司法资源的情况下。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了司法AI对法治影响的三个核心分析维度：法律解释的范式转变、权力委托的伦理问题、三权分立的结构性影响，为理解算法时代的法治挑战提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示司法AI大规模采用前需要解决的关键问题，为政策制定者、司法机构和AI开发者提供了实践指导，强调需要在技术部署前建立适当的监管和伦理框架。

title: The Law of the Best or the Law of Averages? Modeling and Evidence from the Digital Game Industry
affiliations: , Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University - School of Economics and Management and Tsinghua University - School of Economics and Management

detail.title: The Law of the Best or the Law of Averages? Modeling and Evidence from the Digital Game Industry
detail.abstract: How does team skill disparity, that is, the differences in team members' skill levels, affect the team performance? Is a team with a super-star more likely to win a team where each team member is equally good? While existing literature offers controversial empirical findings, the advancement of IT and big data analytics makes it possible to investigate this problem through a unique dataset from the digital game industry, which features longitudinal, objective team performance measures and consistent member skill metrics. We first develop a theoretical model of team competition, where the team performance depends not only on team members' abilities but also on their effort levels. We find that whether a team with greater skill disparity outperforms a team with a more balanced skill distribution crucially depends on the nature of competition between the teams, that is, the sensitivity of team performance with respect to individual ability (relative to individual effort). Specifically, controlling for the teams' average skill levels, teams with greater skill disparity excel in settings where performance heavily depends on individual ability relative to effort. Our empirical results, consistent with our hypotheses, reveal that teams with greater skill disparities are more likely to win, particularly when they are high-skilled teams. These findings offer guidelines for team management in both e-sports and broader organizational settings.

AI.tldr: 研究团队技能差异如何影响团队绩效，发现技能差异大的团队在能力敏感型竞争中表现更好，特别是高技能团队。
AI.research_question: 团队技能差异（即团队成员技能水平的差异）如何影响团队绩效？拥有超级明星的团队是否比成员技能均衡的团队更可能获胜？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对团队技能差异与绩效关系存在争议性实证发现，数字游戏行业的大数据为研究这一问题提供了独特机会，包含纵向、客观的团队绩效测量和一致的成员技能指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 团队竞争理论模型，团队绩效不仅取决于团队成员的能力，还取决于他们的努力水平。竞争性质（团队绩效对个人能力相对于努力的敏感度）是关键调节因素。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析，使用数字游戏行业的独特数据集，包含纵向、客观的团队绩效测量和一致的成员技能指标。
AI.findings: 团队技能差异对绩效的影响取决于竞争性质：在绩效对个人能力（相对于努力）高度敏感的环境中，技能差异大的团队表现更好。实证结果支持假设，技能差异大的团队更可能获胜，特别是当他们是高技能团队时。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了团队技能差异与绩效关系的争议，提出竞争性质作为关键调节因素的理论框架，解释了何时技能差异有利或不利。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子竞技和更广泛的组织环境中的团队管理提供指导，帮助管理者根据竞争环境决定是否组建技能差异大的团队。

title: Enhancing Financial Transaction Security Using OAuth2, MFA, and Azure AD Authentication: A Java-Based Integrated Approach

detail.title: Enhancing Financial Transaction Security Using OAuth2, MFA, and Azure AD Authentication: A Java-Based Integrated Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Computational and Experimental Science and Engineering, volume 11, issue 2, 2025[10.22399/ijcesen.2068]

detail.abstract: In recent years, financial transactions have been increasingly targeted by cyberattacks, fraud transactions and identity theft. Traditional authentication mechanisms such as basic auth have proven to be insufficient. This paper proposes a multi-layered security framework which integrates three components-Oauth2 token-based authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA) and Azure Active Directory (AAD) to secure real-time financial transactions. This approach aims to maintain seamless transaction processing along with reducing token compromise rates and prevent unauthorized access. This research paper presents a quantitative approach to evaluate the impact of integrating transaction security, authentication latency and overall performance. A java-based implementation using Springboot and Spring-security has been developed to empirically evaluate the effectiveness of the approach. Using a sample size of 10,000 financial transactions, the integrated Oauth2+MFA+Azure AD approach reduced the token compromise rates from 2.7% to mere 0.4%, which is offset by a latency increase of only 260ms. These findings demonstrate that integrated authentication substantially enhances security at the same time maintains acceptable performance, thus offers a robust foundation for high-throughput and large-scale financial applications. This research lays groundwork for future enhancements into adaptive MFA policies and machine learning based anomaly detection for real-time financial transactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成OAuth2令牌认证、多因素认证和Azure Active Directory的多层安全框架，用于保护实时金融交易。通过Java实现和10,000笔交易的实证评估，该方法将令牌泄露率从2.7%降至0.4%，仅增加260ms延迟，在保持可接受性能的同时显著提升安全性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能显著提升金融交易安全性，又能保持可接受性能的多层认证框架？
AI.motivation: 近年来金融交易面临越来越多的网络攻击、欺诈交易和身份盗窃威胁，传统基础认证机制已证明不足，需要更强大的安全解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层安全框架理论、OAuth2令牌认证理论、多因素认证理论、身份和访问管理理论
AI.method: 定量研究方法，使用Java Springboot和Spring-security实现原型系统，通过10,000笔金融交易样本进行实证评估，测量安全性和性能指标。
AI.findings: 集成OAuth2+MFA+Azure AD的方法将令牌泄露率从2.7%大幅降低至0.4%，仅增加260ms的认证延迟，在显著提升安全性的同时保持了可接受的性能水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个集成多层认证的理论框架，为金融交易安全提供了新的理论模型，展示了不同安全组件协同工作的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可实施的安全解决方案，证明了在保持性能的同时显著提升安全性的可行性，为大规模金融应用奠定了坚实基础。

title: A Novel Java-Based Framework for Real-Time Financial Risk Assessment and Anomaly Detection Using Apache Kafka and Apache Flink

detail.title: A Novel Java-Based Framework for Real-Time Financial Risk Assessment and Anomaly Detection Using Apache Kafka and Apache Flink

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Information Systems Engineering and Management 2025, 10(36s)

detail.abstract: Modern financial systems create massive amounts of real-time data from high-frequency trading platforms, market feeds, and transactional systems. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel integrated framework for real-time financial risk assessment and anomaly detection. It is built upon the high-throughput fault-tolerant messaging system Apache Kafka and lowlatency stateful stream processor Apache Flink. The framework is built in Java, which guarantees performance, painless integration with enterprise systems, and scalability to meet the future development of market conditions. Extremely low latency, high throughput, and good detection accuracy have been demonstrated in extensive experiments operated over synthetically generated datasets that aim to approximate realistic market conditions, as well as with injected anomalies. The system's modular architecture and innovative statistical techniques it implements serve as a solid basis for the future refinement with methods such as deep learning integration and adaptive thresholding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Apache Kafka和Apache Flink的实时金融风险评估与异常检测集成框架，在合成数据集上展示了极低延迟、高吞吐量和良好检测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够处理大规模实时金融数据、实现低延迟高吞吐量的风险评估与异常检测系统？
AI.motivation: 现代金融系统产生海量实时数据（高频交易平台、市场数据流、交易系统），需要有效的实时风险管理和异常检测解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于流处理架构理论，结合高吞吐量容错消息系统（Apache Kafka）和低延迟有状态流处理器（Apache Flink）的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用Java构建集成框架，使用Apache Kafka作为消息系统，Apache Flink作为流处理器，在合成数据集上进行实验验证，并注入异常进行测试。
AI.findings: 系统在模拟真实市场条件的合成数据集上表现出极低延迟、高吞吐量和良好的检测精度，能够有效检测注入的异常。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个集成实时金融风险评估与异常检测的理论框架，结合了现代流处理技术，为金融风险管理提供了新的技术架构范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个可实际部署的实时金融风险系统，具有模块化架构，便于与现有企业系统集成，支持未来扩展（如深度学习集成、自适应阈值调整）。

title: AI-Driven Fraud Detection in Real-Time Payment Processing Systems: A Java-Based Approach

detail.title: AI-Driven Fraud Detection in Real-Time Payment Processing Systems: A Java-Based Approach
detail.abstract: Fraud schemes are becoming more sophisticated and digital payment systems are exposed so there is a need for accurate detection methods that can work in real time. We introduce an AI-based framework for detection of fraud that cooperatively utilizes a deep neural network (DNN) model and domain specific heuristics based on rules. It is a microservices-based architecture, all nice and wrapped in Java with Spring Boot powered by the asynchronous, real-time streaming of Apache Kafka. The tool is a custom Java simulation engine that creates a dataset of 1.5 million transactions with realistic features and controlled fraud injections. Extensive technical performance metrics indicate 97.1% detection accuracy, 95.4% recall, and an average transaction processing delay of 78 ms. This work covers each step from data simulation and AI model design to enterprise integration, providing a foundation for realistic deployment in high-throughput financial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AI的欺诈检测框架，结合深度神经网络和领域特定启发式规则，采用微服务架构和实时流处理技术，在模拟的150万笔交易数据集上实现了97.1%的检测准确率和78毫秒的平均处理延迟。
AI.research_question: 如何在实时、高吞吐量的数字支付环境中，开发一个准确、高效的AI驱动欺诈检测系统？
AI.motivation: 欺诈手段日益复杂化，数字支付系统面临更高风险，需要能够在实时环境中工作的准确检测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合深度神经网络（DNN）模型和领域特定启发式规则的混合AI框架，利用微服务架构和实时流处理理论。
AI.method: 1. 开发基于Java Spring Boot的微服务架构；2. 使用Apache Kafka进行异步实时流处理；3. 创建自定义Java模拟引擎生成150万笔交易数据集；4. 结合DNN模型和规则引擎进行欺诈检测。
AI.findings: 系统在模拟数据集上实现了97.1%的检测准确率、95.4%的召回率，平均交易处理延迟为78毫秒，证明了在高吞吐量金融环境中的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合深度学习和规则引擎的混合AI欺诈检测框架，为实时金融欺诈检测提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了完整的欺诈检测系统原型；2. 提供了从数据模拟到企业集成的完整解决方案；3. 展示了在高吞吐量金融环境中的实际部署基础；4. 开源了自定义Java模拟引擎工具。

title: Chat Ts&Cs: A Survey of 20 Standard Contracts for Generative AI Services
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London, School of Law - Centre for Commercial Law Studies, Queen Mary University of London, School of Law - Centre for Commercial Law Studies and

detail.title: Chat Ts&Cs: A Survey of 20 Standard Contracts for Generative AI Services

declarations.funderStatement: This paper has been produced by members of the Cloud Legal Project, Centre for Commercial Law Studies, Queen Mary University of London. The authors are grateful to Microsoft for the generous financial support that has made this project possible. Responsibility for views expressed, however, remains with the authors.

publicationDetails.journalName: Queen Mary Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this paper, we report the results of a detailed survey of 20 standard contracts for chat-based generative AI services from 13 leading providers. We cover both US providers, such as Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, and European and Chinese providers, such as Alibaba, DeepSeek, and Mistral. We analyse the terms and conditions that govern both commercial and consumer use of the services for customers in the UK and across Europe. We cover a range of contractual issues including the choice of law and forum for disputes; provider duties and liability for breach of contract; acceptable use policies; and termination. We compare trends across providers and analyse the survey findings in light of English and EU law, including consumer protection law, the Data Act, and the AI Act.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对13家领先提供商（包括美国、欧洲和中国公司）的20份聊天生成式AI服务标准合同进行详细调查，分析了英国和欧洲客户商业和消费使用的条款，涵盖法律选择、争议解决、提供商责任、可接受使用政策、终止条款等关键合同问题，并结合英国和欧盟法律进行比较分析。
AI.research_question: 聊天生成式AI服务提供商的标准合同条款在关键法律问题上存在哪些差异和趋势？这些条款如何与英国和欧盟法律（包括消费者保护法、数据法和AI法案）相协调？
AI.motivation: 随着聊天生成式AI服务的普及，用户（包括商业和消费者）与提供商之间的合同关系变得日益重要。然而，目前缺乏对这些服务标准合同的系统性分析，特别是在不同司法管辖区和提供商之间的比较研究，以及这些合同条款如何与新兴的AI监管框架相适应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同法理论、消费者保护法、数据保护法（特别是欧盟数据法）、人工智能监管框架（欧盟AI法案）、比较法律分析、服务条款研究。
AI.method: 对13家领先提供商（包括Anthropic、Google、Microsoft、OpenAI、Alibaba、DeepSeek、Mistral等）的20份标准合同进行详细调查和内容分析，涵盖美国、欧洲和中国提供商，重点分析英国和欧洲客户的商业和消费使用条款。
AI.findings: 研究发现不同提供商在关键合同条款上存在显著差异：1）法律选择和争议解决条款的多样性；2）提供商责任和违约赔偿的限制程度不同；3）可接受使用政策的严格程度和范围各异；4）终止条款的灵活性和保护水平不一。这些差异反映了不同司法管辖区和商业模式的考量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了聊天生成式AI服务合同分析的理论框架；2）揭示了跨国AI服务合同条款的趋同与分化趋势；3）提出了AI服务合同与新兴监管框架协调的理论模型；4）为数字服务合同研究提供了新的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为AI服务用户提供了合同条款比较的实用指南；2）为政策制定者提供了监管合规性的实证依据；3）为企业法务部门提供了合同谈判的参考框架；4）为消费者保护机构提供了识别不公平条款的基准；5）为AI服务提供商提供了合同设计的行业最佳实践参考。

reference: Boston University Journal of Science and Technology Law (forthcoming)
title: Misplaced Trust in Artificial Professional Advice
affiliations: Northeastern University (USA) - School of Law

detail.title: Misplaced Trust in Artificial Professional Advice

publicationDetails.detailsText: Boston University Journal of Science and Technology Law (forthcoming)

detail.abstract:
The professional relationship constitutes a distinctive social interaction in which the professional has knowledge that the client or patient lacks but needs to make important decisions. A specific legal and ethical framework governs this relationship. Traditionally, this framework assumes interactions between human actors and is designed to safeguard normative values inherent to human-centered professional advice-giving. Prominent among the foundational assumptions are expectations of competence, loyalty, and trust. Individuals seeking professional advice expect to receive accurate and comprehensive advice reflecting the insights of the profession. 

This Essay examines the social relationship based on knowledge asymmetries and trust underlying the human professional relationship and what its absence means for the output of AI-based non-human actors-including generative AI systems like large language models (LLMs)-dispensing what looks like professional advice. As I will argue in this Essay, the trust problem is twofold: first, trust in AI output resembling professional advice is misplaced; second, untrustworthy AI displacing professionals in turn undermines trust in human professionals.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能系统（如大型语言模型）提供类似专业建议时，由于缺乏传统专业关系中基于知识不对称和信任的社会关系，导致的双重信任问题：对AI输出的信任是错位的，同时不可信的AI取代专业人士会破坏对人类专业人士的信任。
AI.research_question: 当人工智能系统（如大型语言模型）提供类似专业建议时，基于知识不对称和信任的传统人类专业关系框架如何适用？其缺失对AI输出和人类专业信任有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统的专业关系法律和伦理框架假设人类互动，旨在保护以人为中心的专业建议给予的规范性价值。随着AI系统开始提供类似专业建议，需要重新审视这一框架的适用性，特别是当AI缺乏人类专业关系中的信任基础时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识不对称的专业关系理论、信任理论、专业伦理框架（包括能力、忠诚和信任等核心价值）、人机交互理论。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证，通过比较人类专业关系与AI系统提供建议的差异，分析信任问题的双重性质。
AI.findings: AI系统缺乏人类专业关系中的信任基础，导致双重信任问题：1）对AI输出的信任是错位的；2）不可信的AI取代专业人士会破坏对人类专业信任的生态系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了专业关系理论到AI时代，提出了"双重信任问题"框架，挑战了传统专业伦理框架对AI系统的直接适用性，为理解人机专业互动提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、专业组织和AI开发者提供指导：1）需要重新设计AI系统的监管框架；2）保护人类专业信任生态系统；3）明确区分AI建议与人类专业建议的界限。

title: Explainable AI for Automated Compliance and Regulatory Reporting in FinTech: A Java Spring Boot Microservices Framework

detail.title: Explainable AI for Automated Compliance and Regulatory Reporting in FinTech: A Java Spring Boot Microservices Framework
detail.abstract: In the recent past, FinTech firms have more and more adopted Artificial Intelligence (AI) for mission-critical tasks such as credit scoring, fraud detection, and risk evaluation. Blackbox models, however, have the enormous challenge of the lack of transparency that renders regulatory transparency under such regulations as General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), European Banking Authority (EBA) Opinion 2021/01, and the Sarbanes-Oxley Act highly challenging. This paper introduces XAI-Comply, an end-to-end Java Spring Boot microservices system incorporating Explainable AI (XAI) in compliance and reporting processes. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) services for transaction-level explanation are used, and it employs a novel regulatory-mapping algorithm (Eq. 1) to convert feature-attribution vectors to compliance risk scores and has automated audit-ready report generation using Spring Batch and Apache Kafka. Hosted in Docker containers and orchestrated on Kubernetes, the system is monitored via Prometheus and Grafana. Experimental testing on a simulated dataset demonstrates 70 % reduction in compliance exceptions and 60 % reduction in report generation delay. Load testing with JMeter confirms consistent throughput of over 500 txn/s. Security is ensured via Vault-based secret management and ISO-27001 compliant patterns. Our contributions are: (1) a microservices architecture for real-time XAI in FinTech. (2) a regulatory-mapping algorithm transforming model-agnostic explanations into actionable metrics; and (3) end-to-end performance and scalability analysis guiding production deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XAI-Comply系统，一个基于Java Spring Boot微服务的端到端解决方案，将可解释AI（XAI）整合到金融科技合规流程中，使用SHAP和LIME进行交易级解释，通过监管映射算法将特征归因向量转换为合规风险评分，并自动生成审计就绪报告，实验显示能减少70%合规异常和60%报告生成延迟。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个端到端的可解释AI系统来解决金融科技中黑盒AI模型面临的监管透明度挑战？
AI.motivation: 金融科技公司越来越多地采用AI进行关键任务（如信用评分、欺诈检测、风险评估），但黑盒模型缺乏透明度，使得遵守GDPR、EBA Opinion 2021/01和萨班斯-奥克斯利法案等法规变得极具挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解释AI（XAI）理论，特别是SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）和LIME（Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations）方法；监管合规理论；微服务架构理论。
AI.method: 开发了XAI-Comply系统，一个基于Java Spring Boot的微服务架构，包含SHAP和LIME服务进行交易级解释，使用监管映射算法将特征归因向量转换为合规风险评分，采用Spring Batch和Apache Kafka自动生成审计就绪报告，系统部署在Docker容器中并通过Kubernetes编排，使用Prometheus和Grafana监控。
AI.findings: 在模拟数据集上的实验测试显示：合规异常减少70%，报告生成延迟减少60%。使用JMeter进行的负载测试确认了超过500 txn/s的持续吞吐量。系统通过Vault-based秘密管理和ISO-27001合规模式确保安全性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为金融科技实时XAI提供微服务架构；2) 监管映射算法将模型无关解释转化为可操作指标；3) 端到端性能和可扩展性分析指导生产部署。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 实际可部署的XAI-Comply系统，帮助金融科技公司满足监管透明度要求；2) 自动化合规报告生成，减少人工工作量；3) 提供可扩展的高性能解决方案，支持实时交易处理。

title: Strategic Project Feasibility and Control Analysis for Sustainability Transformation at Wasserman

detail.title: Strategic Project Feasibility and Control Analysis for Sustainability Transformation at Wasserman
detail.abstract: This study presents a strategic feasibility and control analysis for a sustainability transformation initiative at Wasserman. The research evaluates five potential project concepts using a structured scoring system, emphasizing ESG alignment, feasibility, innovation, and risk management. The selected project—an Athlete-Led Sustainability Ambassador Platform—demonstrates strong strategic alignment and sustainability impact. The study further develops a high-level WBS, PBS, risk register, cost estimation, and performance metrics to assess implementation feasibility. The findings highlight how structured project management tools can support sustainable transformation while balancing innovation, governance, and commercial objectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究对Wasserman公司的可持续发展转型进行了战略可行性和控制分析，评估了五个潜在项目概念，最终选择了运动员主导的可持续发展大使平台，并开发了详细的项目管理工具来评估实施可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构化项目管理工具支持Wasserman公司的可持续发展转型，平衡创新、治理和商业目标？
AI.motivation: 企业需要进行可持续发展转型，但需要系统化的方法来评估和选择转型项目，确保战略一致性、可行性和风险可控。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG（环境、社会和治理）框架，结合项目管理理论，包括战略一致性、风险评估、成本效益分析等。
AI.method: 使用结构化评分系统评估五个潜在项目概念，重点考察ESG一致性、可行性、创新性和风险管理；开发高层WBS（工作分解结构）、PBS（产品分解结构）、风险登记册、成本估算和绩效指标。
AI.findings: 运动员主导的可持续发展大使平台项目显示出最强的战略一致性和可持续发展影响力；结构化项目管理工具能有效支持可持续转型，平衡创新、治理和商业目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统项目管理工具应用于可持续发展转型领域，提供了评估和选择可持续发展项目的系统化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Wasserman公司提供了具体的可持续发展转型实施方案，包括项目选择标准、风险管理方法和绩效评估指标，可供其他企业参考。

title: Board Skill Set Heterogeneity and Firm Value
affiliations: Florida Atlantic University and Florida Atlantic University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Board Skill Set Heterogeneity and Firm Value
detail.abstract: We examine how heterogeneity in board skills affects firm value. Using machine learning methods, we extract director biography information from proxy filings of U.S. publicly listed firms from 2010 to 2022 to construct measures of monitoring-and advising-related skills. We find that greater heterogeneity in monitoring-related board skill sets is negatively associated with firm value, whereas heterogeneity in advising-related skills is positively associated with firm value, particularly for firms facing greater operational complexity, operating in more innovative industries, and at earlier stages of the corporate life cycle. Additional analyses indicate that advising-skill heterogeneity is associated with higher takeover activity, improved deal efficiency, and acquisitions of more valuable targets. These findings have direct implications for director nomination practices, as firms face increasing pressure to assemble boards with broader and more diverse skill sets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究董事会技能异质性对公司价值的影响。研究发现：监督相关技能异质性降低公司价值，而咨询相关技能异质性提升公司价值，尤其对运营复杂、创新行业和早期生命周期的公司更明显。
AI.research_question: 董事会技能异质性如何影响公司价值？监督相关技能异质性与咨询相关技能异质性对公司价值的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 随着公司面临组建具有更广泛和多样化技能董事会的压力增加，了解不同类型董事会技能异质性对公司价值的影响具有重要实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于董事会监督职能和咨询职能的理论框架，区分监督相关技能和咨询相关技能对公司价值的不同影响机制。
AI.method: 使用机器学习方法从2010-2022年美国上市公司代理文件中提取董事传记信息，构建监督相关技能和咨询相关技能的测量指标。
AI.findings: 1. 监督相关董事会技能异质性与公司价值负相关；2. 咨询相关技能异质性与公司价值正相关，尤其对运营复杂、创新行业和早期生命周期的公司更显著；3. 咨询技能异质性关联更高的收购活动、更好的交易效率和更有价值的目标收购。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：区分了董事会监督职能和咨询职能的技能异质性对公司价值的不同影响，深化了对董事会构成与公司绩效关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为董事提名实践提供直接指导，帮助公司在组建董事会时平衡不同类型技能的异质性，特别是在面对运营复杂性、创新需求和不同生命周期阶段时。

title: “Recruitment Trends Post Pandemic”

detail.title: “Recruitment Trends Post Pandemic”
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly reshaped global recruitment practices and workforce expectations. This study investigates emerging recruitment trends in the post-pandemic era, with a specific focus on factors influencing job offer acceptance and rejection. Using a survey-based research design, data were collected from professionals across multiple industries and experience levels. The findings reveal that compensation alone no longer determines candidate decisions; instead, flexibility, work-life balance, remote work opportunities, organizational culture, and benefits packages play a critical role. The study also highlights a mismatch between employer assumptions and candidate expectations, leading to increased offer declines. These results indicate a shift toward a candidate-centric labor market where holistic employment value propositions outweigh traditional salary considerations. The research provides practical recommendations for HR professionals and organizations to redesign recruitment strategies, improve offer conversion rates, and align hiring practices with evolving workforce priorities in the post-pandemic landscape.

AI.tldr: COVID-19疫情重塑了全球招聘实践和劳动力期望，研究发现薪酬不再是决定候选人决策的唯一因素，灵活性、工作生活平衡、远程工作机会、组织文化和福利待遇变得至关重要，揭示了雇主假设与候选人期望之间的不匹配，表明劳动力市场正转向以候选人为中心。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时代新兴招聘趋势是什么？哪些因素影响工作录用接受和拒绝决策？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行显著改变了全球招聘实践和劳动力期望，需要研究后疫情时代的新兴招聘趋势，特别是影响工作录用决策的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 候选人决策理论、工作接受理论、劳动力市场动态理论、组织吸引力理论、工作价值主张理论。
AI.method: 基于调查的研究设计，从多个行业和经验水平的专业人士收集数据。
AI.findings: 1. 薪酬不再是决定候选人决策的唯一因素；2. 灵活性、工作生活平衡、远程工作机会、组织文化和福利待遇起关键作用；3. 雇主假设与候选人期望之间存在不匹配，导致录用拒绝率增加；4. 劳动力市场正转向以候选人为中心，整体就业价值主张超过传统薪资考虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了后疫情时代候选人决策理论；2. 丰富了工作价值主张理论，强调非货币因素的重要性；3. 发展了候选人中心劳动力市场理论；4. 提供了雇主-候选人期望差距的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为HR专业人士提供重新设计招聘策略的实践建议；2. 帮助组织提高录用转化率；3. 指导企业将招聘实践与不断变化的劳动力优先事项保持一致；4. 提供改善组织吸引力的具体方法。

title: Smart Contracts, Dumb Money: Open Source Lemons
affiliations: , University of Chicago, Boston College and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Smart Contracts, Dumb Money: Open Source Lemons

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Chicago Booth Initiative on Global Markets Working Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Chicago Booth: Initiative on Global Markets Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Why does a market structure built on radical transparency paradoxically foster the proliferation of low-quality assets? We address this puzzle by identifying a Transparency Paradox in decentralized finance: despite the open-source nature of smart contracts, high-quality innovation is systematically crowded out by memecoins. We develop a model of adverse selection in which information acquisition is endogenous and costly. We show that when technical complexity raises the effective cost of processing information above a critical threshold, rational investors optimally underinvest in attention, becoming dumb money. This creates a pooling equilibrium that strips genuine projects of their valuation premium. Consequently, innovators face a complexity penalty and exit, leaving assets that are cognitively easy to evaluate but of low fundamental quality. Our findings challenge the regulatory orthodoxy of mandated disclosure, suggesting that in algorithmic markets, overwhelming information can exacerbate asymmetry by exceeding investor cognitive capacity.

AI.tldr: 市场透明度提高反而导致低质量资产泛滥，因为技术复杂性使投资者理性地减少信息处理，形成"笨钱"均衡，挤出高质量创新。
AI.research_question: 为什么建立在激进透明度基础上的市场结构反而促进了低质量资产的泛滥？
AI.motivation: 去中心化金融中存在透明度悖论：尽管智能合约开源透明，但高质量创新被模因币系统性挤出，这与传统监管逻辑相悖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生信息获取的逆向选择模型，引入技术复杂性作为信息处理成本，分析投资者理性注意力分配决策。
AI.method: 理论模型构建，分析当技术复杂性使信息处理成本超过临界阈值时，理性投资者如何最优地减少注意力投入。
AI.findings: 技术复杂性导致投资者理性地成为"笨钱"，形成混同均衡，剥夺了真实项目的估值溢价，创新者面临复杂性惩罚而退出。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战强制披露的监管正统，提出算法市场中信息过载可能加剧信息不对称，揭示透明度与复杂性之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DeFi市场监管提供新视角，建议考虑投资者认知能力限制，避免单纯依赖透明度要求。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Electric vehicle Charging Navigation in Dynamic Transportation Networks
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University, Beijing Jiaotong University and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Electric vehicle Charging Navigation in Dynamic Transportation Networks
detail.abstract: Range anxiety remains a significant barrier to sustainable electric vehicle (EV) adoption. Existing navigation methods often decouple station selection from route planning, struggling to adapt to real-world uncertainties. To address this, we propose a real-time, bi-level stochastic optimization framework capturing the spatiotemporal dynamics of coupled transportation and charging networks. We develop a novel Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning approach (HE-DDQN-A2C) to solve this system. The upper-level Double Deep Q-Network optimizes station selection to minimize queuing and charging costs, while the lower-level Advantage Actor-Critic algorithm executes sequential route planning to minimize energy consumption and travel time. Validated on an urban network, HE-DDQN-A2C significantly outperforms traditional routing (Dijkstra, Genetic Algorithms) and single-layer reinforcement learning baselines. By achieving a 100% success rate and substantially reducing total navigation costs, our framework offers a robust solution for alleviating range anxiety and enhancing sustainable EV mobility.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种实时双层随机优化框架HE-DDQN-A2C，通过分层强化学习方法同时优化充电站选择和路径规划，有效缓解电动汽车续航焦虑问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够实时处理交通和充电网络时空动态耦合的导航框架，以有效缓解电动汽车的续航焦虑问题？
AI.motivation: 续航焦虑是阻碍电动汽车可持续采用的主要障碍，现有导航方法通常将充电站选择与路径规划分离，难以适应现实世界的不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层随机优化理论，结合分层强化学习框架，将充电站选择（上层）和路径规划（下层）进行耦合优化。
AI.method: 提出HE-DDQN-A2C分层强化学习方法：上层使用Double Deep Q-Network优化充电站选择以最小化排队和充电成本；下层使用Advantage Actor-Critic算法执行顺序路径规划以最小化能耗和旅行时间。
AI.findings: 在城市网络验证中，HE-DDQN-A2C显著优于传统路由方法（Dijkstra、遗传算法）和单层强化学习基线，实现了100%的成功率并大幅降低了总导航成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了耦合交通和充电网络时空动态的实时双层随机优化框架；2. 开发了新颖的分层强化学习方法HE-DDQN-A2C；3. 建立了充电站选择与路径规划的协同优化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为缓解电动汽车续航焦虑提供了鲁棒解决方案；2. 显著提升了电动汽车导航的成功率和效率；3. 增强了可持续电动汽车出行的可行性。

title: Heroic Imperfection: A Study in Biblical Redemption
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business

detail.title: Heroic Imperfection: A Study in Biblical Redemption
detail.abstract: The biblical narrative consistently underscores a fundamental truth: human fallibility is intrinsic to our existence. This paper meticulously examines the imperfections of pivotal biblical figures, including Abraham, Sarah, Moses, Aaron, Miriam, Joseph, David, and Esther. Far from obscuring their shortcomings, Scripture deliberately highlights these faults, presenting them not as flawless archetypes but as individuals whose spiritual achievements are intertwined with their profound humanity and capacity for error. Central to this analysis is the concept of teshuvah (repentance), a foundational biblical principle. The significance lies not in the absence of mistakes, but in the subsequent pursuit of forgiveness and the earnest endeavor to rectify one's actions. Intertwined with penitence, forgiveness emerges as a paramount factor in fostering societal harmony. Acknowledging the universality of human imperfection and the inevitability of errors, even among the most revered, cultivates a deeper understanding of why absolute certainty can prove detrimental. Furthermore, the condemnation of individuals for past transgressions is inherently unjust, as every person merits the opportunity for redemption and a second chance.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析亚伯拉罕、撒拉、摩西、亚伦、米利暗、约瑟、大卫和以斯帖等关键圣经人物的不完美性，探讨了人类缺陷的普遍性。研究强调悔改（teshuvah）的重要性，指出错误后的宽恕和改正比完美无瑕更有价值，并主张谴责他人过去错误是不公正的，因为每个人都有救赎的机会。
AI.research_question: 圣经为何刻意突出关键人物的缺陷和错误，而不是将他们描绘成完美无瑕的典范？这种对人性不完美的呈现对理解悔改、宽恕和社会和谐有何意义？
AI.motivation: 圣经叙事中反复强调人类固有的不完美性，但这一主题的系统性分析相对缺乏。论文旨在深入探讨圣经如何通过展示关键人物的缺陷来传达关于人性、悔改和宽恕的重要信息，以及这对当代社会和谐的启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以犹太教传统中的teshuvah（悔改）概念为核心理论框架，结合圣经叙事分析、人物研究以及伦理学中的宽恕理论，探讨人性缺陷与精神成就之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用文本分析方法，系统性地分析亚伯拉罕、撒拉、摩西、亚伦、米利暗、约瑟、大卫和以斯帖等关键圣经人物的叙事，特别关注圣经如何描述他们的错误、悔改过程以及最终的精神成长。
AI.findings:
1. 圣经刻意突出关键人物的缺陷，表明精神成就与人性不完美可以共存
2. teshuvah（悔改）是圣经的核心原则，强调错误后的改正比完美无瑕更重要
3. 宽恕是促进社会和谐的关键因素
4. 承认人类普遍不完美有助于理解绝对确定性的危害
5. 谴责他人过去错误是不公正的，因为每个人都有救赎和重新开始的权利
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 深化了对圣经叙事中人性不完美主题的理解
2. 系统化了teshuvah（悔改）概念在圣经人物研究中的应用
3. 提出了"缺陷中的精神成就"这一分析框架
4. 为宗教伦理学研究提供了关于宽恕和救赎的新视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为宗教教育提供关于如何理解和教导圣经人物缺陷的指导
2. 为社会和谐建设提供基于宽恕和第二次机会的实践框架
3. 为个人精神成长提供基于悔改和改正的实用路径
4. 为司法和社会政策中对待过去错误提供伦理参考

title: A Scale-Invariant Architecture for General Reasoning in Complex Adaptive Organizations
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Scale-Invariant Architecture for General Reasoning in Complex Adaptive Organizations
detail.abstract: Organizations beyond a critical size threshold lose the capacity to reason generally about their own structure, dynamics, and state. Existing enterprise tools address this gap with narrow, domain-specific solutions that answer pre-defined questions within isolated functional silos. This paper proposes Organizational General Intelligence (OGI)-a framework asserting that general intelligence, defined as the capacity to generate accurate responses to arbitrary well-formed questions about a complex domain, requires a common set of functional primitives regardless of the scale at which it operates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了组织通用智能（OGI）框架，认为通用智能需要一套通用的功能原语，无论其运作规模如何，以解决大型组织无法对其自身结构、动态和状态进行一般性推理的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为超越临界规模阈值的组织构建通用智能，使其能够准确回答关于复杂领域的任意合理问题？
AI.motivation: 当组织规模超过临界阈值时，会失去对其自身结构、动态和状态进行一般性推理的能力。现有企业工具只能提供狭窄的、特定领域的解决方案，在孤立的功能孤岛中回答预定义的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织通用智能（OGI）框架，基于通用智能的定义：生成对复杂领域任意合理问题的准确响应的能力。
AI.method: 论文提出了一个概念框架，主张通用智能需要一套通用的功能原语，无论运作规模如何。
AI.findings: 提出了OGI框架，认为通用智能的能力可以通过一套通用的功能原语来实现，这些原语在不同规模的组织中都具有适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了组织通用智能（OGI）的概念框架；2. 定义了组织规模的通用智能需求；3. 提出了功能原语的通用性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为解决大型组织信息孤岛问题提供了新思路；2. 为企业构建跨领域智能系统提供了理论指导；3. 为组织智能化转型提供了框架性建议。

title: What AI Can't Say: Oral Competence In Legal Education
affiliations: Loyola University of Chicago School of Law

detail.title: What AI Can't Say: Oral Competence In Legal Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract:
This Article brings together two critical conversations rarely considered in tandem – generative AI’s impact on legal education and the need for more practical skills – and argues for a shared solution centered on oral communication skills.  Law schools have historically devoted substantial attention to teaching students how to write like lawyers, but not how to speak like one. Although this is a long-standing imbalance, the widespread use of generative AI in written work provides an additional urgent reason to reconsider how learning is assessed and place more emphasis on oral assignments. These challenges are generally treated separately, yet both reflect a common blind spot:  systemic neglect of oral communication skills, especially within doctrinal classes.

Although attorney surveys and ABA accreditation standards alike identify oral communication as a core professional competency, it has largely been overlooked. Most law schools only require oral assessment once—during 1L oral arguments in legal writing classes.  This leaves oral communication skills largely unaddressed during legal education, resulting in a continuing problem of recent law school graduates with inadequate skills. The ABA’s recent proposal to double experiential learning credits aims to address this, but even the ABA admits that implementation is challenging due to the limited enrollment of experiential classes.

This Article argues that doctrinal classes offer an underused, scalable opportunity to develop oral competence in ways that meet the challenge of an AI era and recognized need for increased skills.   Drawing on learning science and assessment literature, this Article shows how short oral reports and presentations embedded in doctrinal classes can deepen substantive learning while simultaneously promoting readiness for practice.  Unlike expansion of experiential learning, such as law school clinics, these approaches require no new resources.  Also, these experiences can mirror oral work that junior lawyers perform, such as explaining law to supervisors, clients and courts.

This Article provides specific recommendations for the ABA, law schools, and individual faculty. However, recognizing institution reform can be slow, the Article focuses on providing classroom-ready strategies that individual faculty can immediately adopt, including ones that are quick to implement. By recentering oral communication as a core mode of legal assessment, this Article provides a practical and principled response to generative AI that also strengthens legal education and professional preparation.

title: Organizational Metamorphosis and the Hollowing Out of Governance Induced by External Funding Dependence -A Structural Anatomy of Financial Structure and Audit Results in Kashiwa City -Author: Hokuto Koyama (SBCM Alliance)
affiliations: SBCM Alliance

detail.title: Organizational Metamorphosis and the Hollowing Out of Governance Induced by External Funding Dependence -A Structural Anatomy of Financial Structure and Audit Results in Kashiwa City -Author: Hokuto Koyama (SBCM Alliance)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This is an independent study conducted using publicly available data.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it involves the analysis of publicly available administrative documents, financial reports, and audit results published by Kashiwa City. No human subjects were involved, and no personal identifiable information was collected beyond what is publicly disclosed in official records.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted as an independent, self-funded project.

keywords: Public Accounting and Governance The Singularity of "Management Entities Without Bankruptcy"

detail.abstract: This study defines local governments and social welfare corporations as "special management entities that survive through constant injection of external funds" and examines how this financial structure impacts organizational behavior and governance. In the private sector, excessive reliance on external funding is often a precursor to bankruptcy; however, in public organizations, this reliance is the norm. Consequently, as Kornai posits, "soft budget constraints" may be loosening organizational discipline. This paper utilizes the FY2024 (Reiwa 6) financial statements, personnel administration reports, and audit reports of Kashiwa City, Chiba Prefecture, as empirical data. The analysis reveals the mechanism by which a high ratio of dependent revenue sources triggers an "organizational metamorphosis," characterized by a dilution of the sense of ownership within the organization, the transformation of procedures into ends in themselves, and the bloating of administrative departments.

AI.tldr: 该研究将地方政府和社会福利法人定义为"依赖外部资金持续注入的特殊管理实体"，探讨这种财务结构如何影响组织行为和治理。研究发现高度依赖外部收入会引发"组织蜕变"，表现为所有权意识淡化、程序目的化、行政部门膨胀。
AI.research_question: 地方政府和社会福利法人作为依赖外部资金的特殊管理实体，其财务结构如何影响组织行为和治理？
AI.motivation: 在私营部门，过度依赖外部资金通常是破产的前兆，但在公共组织中，这种依赖却是常态。科尔奈提出的"软预算约束"理论可能正在削弱组织纪律，需要实证研究验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科尔奈的"软预算约束"理论，组织行为理论，公共组织治理理论。
AI.method: 使用千叶县柏市2024年（令和6年）财务报表、人事管理报告和审计报告作为实证数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 高度依赖外部收入会触发"组织蜕变"，具体表现为：组织内所有权意识淡化、程序本身成为目的、行政部门膨胀。
AI.theory_contributions: 将科尔奈的软预算约束理论应用于地方政府和社会福利法人，提出了"组织蜕变"的概念框架，丰富了公共组织治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府和社会福利法人的财务管理提供警示，指出过度依赖外部资金可能导致组织效率低下和治理问题，为政策制定者提供改进建议。

title: Production Function For Economies With Deployed Self-Learning Technologies (With Empirical Evidences)

detail.title: Production Function For Economies With Deployed Self-Learning Technologies (With Empirical Evidences)
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a new production function for economies, in which deployed self-learning AI have become meaningful determinant of total output. Building on the Mankiw-Romer-Weil (MRW) framework, the production function separates technologies into deployed non-self-learning technologies and deployed self-learning technologies. Furthermore, the production function separates physical capital, labor forces and human capital based on AI-specificity. The production function is the following: Y(t) = (T(t)l × [S(t) × D(t)]q(t)) × (KAI(t)a1 × KNAI(t)a2) × (LAI(t)Æ1 ×LNAI(t)Æ2) × (HAI(t)¶1 × HNAI(t)¶2). The most unique feature of the production function is the exponent q(t) because q(t) is the only exponent whose value is determined by its base; this is the unique recursive feature of the production function. Self-learning AI, which determine the value of q(t), also determine whether the economy has production function with decreasing, constant or increasing returns to scale. Mathematical proof shows that, in the proposed production function, singularity is impossible. Empirical evidences from 26 high-income countries show that the proposed production function is very useful in cross-countries analysis; the proposed production function is much more accurate than MRW production function. While MRW production function produces 0.49 correlation among 22 OECD countries in year 1985, the proposed production function produces 0.96 correlation among 26 high-income countries in year 2024. Simulations show that self-learning AI can transition an economy from having production function with decreasing returns to scale to having production function with increasing returns to scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种包含自学习AI的新生产函数，基于MRW框架将技术分为非自学习和自学习两类，并将生产要素按AI专用性分离。该函数具有独特的递归特性，能解释经济从规模报酬递减到递增的转变，实证显示比传统MRW模型更准确。
AI.research_question: 自学习AI如何影响经济总产出？包含自学习AI的生产函数能否比传统MRW框架更准确地解释现代经济体的产出差异？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术特别是自学习AI的部署，传统生产函数无法充分捕捉AI对经济产出的影响，需要开发新的分析框架来理解AI驱动的经济增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Mankiw-Romer-Weil (MRW) 增长模型框架，将技术分为部署的非自学习技术(T)和部署的自学习技术(S×D)，并将生产要素（物质资本K、劳动力L、人力资本H）按AI专用性分离为AI专用和非AI专用两类。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：提出包含自学习AI的新生产函数；2. 数学证明：证明在该函数中奇点不可能；3. 实证分析：使用26个高收入国家的数据进行跨国比较；4. 模拟分析：展示自学习AI如何改变规模报酬性质。
AI.findings: 1. 新生产函数比MRW模型更准确（相关系数从0.49提高到0.96）；2. 自学习AI通过指数q(t)的递归特性决定经济规模报酬性质；3. 自学习AI能使经济从规模报酬递减转变为递增；4. 数学证明该函数中奇点不可能发生。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将自学习AI作为独立生产要素纳入生产函数；2. 提出具有递归特性的生产函数结构；3. 建立AI专用性生产要素分类框架；4. 证明自学习AI能改变规模报酬性质的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供评估AI经济影响的量化工具；2. 帮助企业理解AI投资对产出的影响；3. 为跨国经济比较提供更准确的模型；4. 为AI时代的经济增长预测提供新框架。

contentFormat.other: Comments Regarding UK Department of Business and Trade working paper on options for reform of non-compete clauses

detail.abstract:
The UK Department for Business & Trade published a working paper and questions for comment regarding options for the reform of the law of non-compete clauses in employment contracts. In my comments, I recommended that all such clauses be banned. In the event that exceptions were created beyond the sale of a business or formation of a partnership, I argued against any exception based on the salary level of the employee. 

I further urged that a ban on non-compete clauses should encompass more than traditional employer-employee relationships. I separate discuss why such bans should cover de facto post-employment restrictions regardless of the labels and forms of such agreements.

Finally, I suggest that advance notice to the worker, a colling off period, and a clear burden of proof standard on the person seeking to enforce any such clauses are important procedural components of legal reform if non-compete clauses are permitted at all.

AI.findings: 1. 应全面禁止竞业禁止条款；2. 若需例外，不应基于员工薪资水平；3. 禁令应涵盖传统雇佣关系外的其他关系；4. 若允许竞业禁止条款，需建立程序性保障措施（提前通知、冷静期、举证责任标准）
