title: A Unified Fractal Processing Framework for Normalized AIS and ECDIS Ship Trajectories
affiliations: Kherson State Maritime Academy, Odesa National Maritime University, Odesa National Maritime University, Odessa National Maritime University, National University Odesa Maritime Academy, Odessa National Maritime University, Kherson State Maritime Academy and Kherson State University

detail.title: A Unified Fractal Processing Framework for Normalized AIS and ECDIS Ship Trajectories
detail.abstract: The article presents a unified fractal approach to processing and analyzing ship trajectories based on AIS and ECDIS data. A comprehensive algorithmic pipeline is proposed, which provides time normalization, coordinate transformation, calculation of dynamic motion characteristics, and application of fractal analysis in sliding windows. This approach allows for the stable calculation of key parameters (course, angular velocity, deviation from the route) and detection of local changes in movement complexity that are not recorded by classical methods. The fractal indicators used (Higuchi, Katz, Petrosyan, DFA dimensions) demonstrate high reproducibility and resistance to typical navigation data shortcomings. The proposed framework is primarily intended for onboard and post-voyage analysis, supporting navigational performance assessment, trajectory reconstruction, and detailed investigation of vessel motion dynamics based on the records from AIS and ECDIS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于AIS和ECDIS数据的船舶轨迹统一分形分析方法，通过时间归一化、坐标转换、动态运动特征计算和滑动窗口分形分析，稳定计算关键参数并检测传统方法无法识别的局部运动复杂度变化。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种统一的分形分析方法来处理和分析AIS和ECDIS数据中的船舶轨迹，以稳定计算关键导航参数并检测局部运动复杂度变化？
AI.motivation: 传统船舶轨迹分析方法无法有效检测局部运动复杂度变化，且对导航数据中的典型缺陷（如数据不完整、噪声等）敏感，需要一种更稳健的分析框架来支持导航性能评估和船舶运动动态详细研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分形理论（包括Higuchi、Katz、Petrosyan、DFA等多种分形维度计算方法），时间序列分析，动态系统理论，导航数据处理理论。
AI.method: 提出一个综合算法流程，包括：1）时间归一化处理；2）坐标转换；3）动态运动特征计算；4）滑动窗口分形分析；使用多种分形指标（Higuchi、Katz、Petrosyan、DFA维度）进行轨迹复杂度分析。
AI.findings: 所提出的分形指标表现出高再现性和对典型导航数据缺陷的抵抗力；能够稳定计算关键参数（航向、角速度、航线偏差）；能够检测到经典方法无法记录的局部运动复杂度变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将多种分形分析方法统一应用于船舶轨迹分析；2）提出了一个综合的算法流程框架；3）验证了分形指标在导航数据分析中的适用性和稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）支持船上和航后分析；2）可用于导航性能评估；3）支持轨迹重建；4）基于AIS和ECDIS记录进行船舶运动动态详细研究；5）为航海安全和管理提供技术工具。

title: Comment of the European Copyright Society on the request for preliminary ruling in Case C-250/25 (Like Company)
affiliations: University of Szeged, Institute of Comparative Law and Legal Theory; Vytautas Magnus University - Faculty of Law, University of Glasgow - School of Law, Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP), Faculty of Law - KU Leuven, Goethe University Frankfurt - Faculty of Law and University of Amsterdam - Institute for Information Law (IViR)

detail.title: Comment of the European Copyright Society on the request for preliminary ruling in Case C-250/25 (Like Company)
detail.abstract:
The reference in Like Company v Google (Case C-250/25) is seen as a potential landmark case, giving the EU’s highest court the opportunity to define the scope and conditions of permitted artificial intelligence (AI) training and develop an infringement test for AI outputs. The European Copyright Society (ECS) urges the Court of Justice (sitting as a Grand Chamber) to exercise caution.

While the reference stems from a plausible complaint by a press publisher against the provider of an AI powered chatbot reproducing and communicating its editorial content, the implications of this problematic reference could be far-reaching.
(1) The reference is factually murky with respect to the technology and services at stake, conflating concepts of ‘chatbot’, ‘large language model’, and ‘search engine’.
(2) The reference fails to identify consistently the subject matter at stake, which is the press publishers’ right under Article 15 of the Copyright in the Digital Single Market Directive (2019/790/EU, hereinafter CDSMD), not authorial works.
Specifically, the reference conflates questions relating to the training phase (Questions 2 and 3) with the legal characterisation of the use of press publications by an LLM-based chatbot (Question 4 but also Question 1, referring to the right of communication to the public and the right of reproduction under Directive 2001/29/EC, hereinafter InfoSoc Directive).

If the reference is found admissible, it is suggested that the Court of Justice should address jointly Questions 4 and 1, which relate to the legal characterisation of the use of press publications in the display. Here it is important to correctly understand next-token prediction in large language models, augmented retrieval technology (where the use of data does not generally form part of the learning process) as well as ‘online use’, defining the scope of the press publishers’ right under Article 15 of the CDSMD.

In the Opinion of the ECS, the ambiguous characterisation of a fast-moving technology may result in the failure to realise the societal benefits of AI as a potential general-purpose technology. There are risks that a rash decision will push Europe towards a licensing economy in which AI systems are offered as a service by (non-European) multinationals, without solving issues of equity such as creator consent and distribution of revenues.

AI.tldr: 欧盟法院正在审理一起关于AI训练版权边界的潜在里程碑案件，欧洲版权协会呼吁法院谨慎处理，避免因对快速发展的技术做出草率决定而阻碍AI的社会效益，并推动欧洲走向由非欧洲跨国公司主导的许可经济。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院应如何界定AI训练的法律边界，特别是在使用新闻出版商内容进行大型语言模型训练和输出时，如何平衡版权保护与AI技术发展？
AI.motivation: Like Company诉谷歌案可能成为欧盟AI版权法的里程碑，但案件事实模糊、技术概念混淆，且可能对AI作为通用目的技术的发展产生深远影响，需要法院谨慎处理以避免阻碍技术创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 欧盟数字单一市场版权指令第15条（新闻出版商权）；2) 信息社会版权指令中的向公众传播权和复制权；3) AI训练的法律定性框架；4) 大型语言模型的下一个令牌预测技术理论；5) 增强检索技术理论。
AI.method: 法律案例分析法和文本分析法，通过分析欧盟法院的初步裁决请求，识别其中的概念混淆和技术误解，并提出重新构建法律问题的建议。
AI.findings: 1) 案件事实模糊，混淆了"聊天机器人"、"大型语言模型"和"搜索引擎"概念；2) 未能明确区分AI训练阶段和使用阶段的法律问题；3) 错误地将作者作品权利与新闻出版商权利混为一谈；4) 需要正确理解下一个令牌预测技术和增强检索技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了AI训练与使用阶段的法律区分框架；2) 明确了新闻出版商权在AI语境下的适用边界；3) 构建了快速变化技术环境下版权法的适应性分析框架；4) 为AI作为通用目的技术的法律规制提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为欧盟法院审理AI版权案件提供具体建议；2) 避免草率决定导致欧洲走向由非欧洲跨国公司主导的AI许可经济；3) 保护创作者同意权和收入分配公平性；4) 促进AI技术的社会效益实现。

title: The Measurement Error Random Utility Model
affiliations: , Ohio State University (OSU), Ohio State University (OSU) - Economics and University of Western Ontario - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Measurement Error Random Utility Model
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the measurement error random utility model (MERUM) as a generalization of the standard random utility model. In the MERUM, we suppose there is "measurement error" on choice probabilities and characterize the model with an ε-Axiom of Revealed Stochastic Preference. The MERUM is also expressible by linear inequalities. The linear inequalities allow us to define a natural measure of stochastic choice consistency which finds the minimal measurement error (MME) needed to find a MERUM rationalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了测量误差随机效用模型(MERUM)作为标准随机效用模型的推广，通过引入选择概率的"测量误差"，并建立ε-显示随机偏好公理和线性不等式表征，定义了最小测量误差(MME)来衡量随机选择一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何将测量误差纳入随机效用模型框架，并建立相应的理性化条件和一致性度量？
AI.motivation: 标准随机效用模型假设观察到的选择概率是精确的，但实际数据往往存在测量误差。需要发展一个能够容纳测量误差的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量误差随机效用模型(MERUM)，ε-显示随机偏好公理，随机效用理论，显示偏好理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过线性不等式表征MERUM，定义最小测量误差(MME)作为一致性度量。
AI.findings: MERUM可以表达为线性不等式，允许定义自然的一致性度量MME，即找到MERUM理性化所需的最小测量误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了随机效用模型框架以容纳测量误差；2. 提出了ε-显示随机偏好公理；3. 建立了MERUM的线性不等式表征；4. 定义了最小测量误差作为一致性度量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为处理实际数据中的测量误差提供了理论工具，允许研究者量化数据与理论模型之间的不一致程度。

reference: Halim, S., Haque, F., Alam, M. S., & Puwanenthiren, P. (2026). Managerial tone and audit outcomes: Do information environment and governance monitoring matter? Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation, Forthcoming
title: Managerial Tone and Audit Outcomes: Do Information Environment and Governance Monitoring Matter?
affiliations: Manchester Metropolitan University, University of Southampton, University of Derby and Westminster University

detail.title: Managerial Tone and Audit Outcomes: Do Information Environment and Governance Monitoring Matter?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Halim, S., Haque, F., Alam, M. S., & Puwanenthiren, P. (2026). Managerial tone and audit outcomes: Do information environment and governance monitoring matter? Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation, Forthcoming

detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between managerial tone and audit outcomes.  We employ 42,250 firm-year observations from United States non-financial firms from 2000 through 2020. Our results show that firms with a more positive managerial tone in their 10-K filings tend to experience more favorable audit outcomes. This is evidenced by fewer financial restatements, fewer adverse opinions on the strength of internal controls, lower audit fees, less audit effort, and fewer going concern opinions. We also find that such favorable impacts are more pronounced in financially non-distressed firms, thereby reinforcing the credibility of the positive managerial tone as perceived by auditors. Our main findings are robust across various sensitivity tests and alternative variable approaches. Our analysis also suggests that the relationship between managerial tone and audit outcomes is more pronounced for firms with a poorer quality information environment and weaker governance monitoring. Finally, our findings suggest that a positive managerial tone is negatively associated with both earnings management and the likelihood of whistleblowing, which in turn have a positive influence on audit outcomes. Overall, our study contributes to the literature and practice by demonstrating the significant role that client-firm managerial tone plays in audit outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了管理层语气与审计结果之间的关系，发现管理层在10-K文件中使用更积极的语气会导致更有利的审计结果，包括更少的财务重述、更少的内控缺陷意见、更低的审计费用、更少的审计努力和更少的持续经营疑虑意见。
AI.research_question: 管理层语气如何影响审计结果？
AI.motivation: 理解管理层在财务报告中的语气如何被审计师解读，并影响审计决策和结果，这对审计实践和公司治理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、信号理论和审计风险评估框架，探讨管理层语气作为信息质量信号如何影响审计师的风险评估和决策。
AI.method: 使用2000-2020年美国非金融公司的42,250个公司年度观察数据，通过文本分析测量管理层语气，并采用回归分析检验其与各种审计结果指标的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 更积极的管理层语气与更有利的审计结果相关；2. 这种关系在财务非困境公司中更明显；3. 在信息环境较差和治理监督较弱的企业中更显著；4. 积极语气通过减少盈余管理和降低举报可能性间接改善审计结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了管理层语气在审计领域的研究；2. 揭示了语气作为信息质量信号的作用机制；3. 提供了管理层沟通影响审计师风险评估的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理层提供了改善审计结果的沟通策略；2. 为审计师提供了评估客户风险的额外维度；3. 为监管机构提供了理解公司信息披露质量的新视角。

title: The Stability of Known Risk: Decision Stability and Informal Risk Acceptance under Normative Uncertainty

detail.title: The Stability of Known Risk: Decision Stability and Informal Risk Acceptance under Normative Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Organisations systematically identify, document, and evaluate risks, yet many of these risks remain untreated for years. Legacy systems continue to operate beyond support, security measures are postponed, and temporary exceptions are routinely extended, even though their dangers are widely acknowledged. This article explains the persistence of such known risks as a problem of decision stability rather than misperception or ignorance. Under conditions of normative uncertainty, multiple legitimate principles-such as security, performance, efficiency, and loyalty-coexist without clear hierarchical ordering. In these constellations, the option that is affectively relieving, cognitively plausible, and normatively justifiable tends to prevail, so that the recognised risk loses priority as a guide for action. Drawing on the Emotion-Bias-Principle (EBP) effect model, the paper conceptualises decision stability as the interdependent convergence of affective, cognitive, and normative processes and interprets recurring non-treatment as informal risk acceptance. It proposes that, in addition to probability and impact, the stability of a risk state should be treated as a distinct analytical dimension, offering a general framework for understanding the endurance of acknowledged risks in organisational risk governance.

AI.tldr: 本文解释了组织为何长期不处理已知风险，认为这不是认知偏差或无知，而是决策稳定性问题。在规范不确定性下，多个合法原则并存，情感缓解、认知合理且规范可辩护的选项会胜出，导致已知风险失去行动优先级。作者提出风险状态稳定性应作为独立分析维度。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织会长期不处理已知且公认的风险？如何解释这种已知风险的持续性？
AI.motivation: 组织系统性地识别、记录和评估风险，但许多风险（如遗留系统超期运行、安全措施推迟、临时例外延长）却多年未得到处理，尽管其危险性已被广泛认知。这种现象需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策稳定性理论、规范不确定性理论、情感-偏见-原则（EBP）效应模型、非正式风险接受概念
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，基于EBP效应模型概念化决策稳定性为情感、认知和规范过程的相互依赖收敛
AI.findings: 已知风险的持续性是决策稳定性问题而非误判或无知。在规范不确定性下，多个合法原则（安全、性能、效率、忠诚）并存且无明确等级排序，情感缓解、认知合理且规范可辩护的选项会胜出，导致已知风险失去行动优先级。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将已知风险的持续性重新概念化为决策稳定性问题；2）提出风险状态稳定性应作为独立于概率和影响的分析维度；3）提供理解组织风险治理中已知风险持久性的通用框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织风险管理者提供新视角：需要关注决策稳定性维度，识别情感、认知和规范过程的相互作用，理解非正式风险接受机制，从而更有效地处理已知风险。

title: Rent Now, Pain Later: How "Rent Now, Pay Later" Loans Put Working People at Risk
affiliations: and

detail.title: Rent Now, Pain Later: How "Rent Now, Pay Later" Loans Put Working People at Risk
detail.abstract: Amid rising housing costs in the United States, a new market of “Rent Now, Pay Later” (RNPL) loans has emerged, offering short-term credit to tenants struggling to meet rent payments. This paper examines the structure and practices of RNPL lenders, drawing on market analysis, consumer complaints, and publicly available financial and regulatory data. The findings indicate that RNPL products often replicate payday lending models while obscuring their true costs through complex fees and misleading disclosures, with some loans reaching effective annual percentage rates above 180 percent. The analysis also identifies significant consumer risks, including payment stacking, repeated debit practices, operational errors that may expose renters to eviction, and bank–fintech partnerships that may enable lenders to bypass state consumer protections. The paper concludes that RNPL loans represent a growing form of high-cost, potentially predatory credit embedded within rent payment systems, raising urgent regulatory and consumer protection concerns.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了美国新兴的"先租后付"贷款市场，发现这些产品往往采用发薪日贷款模式，通过复杂费用和误导性披露掩盖真实成本，年化利率可达180%以上，存在严重消费者风险。
AI.research_question: "先租后付"贷款市场的结构、实践和消费者风险是什么？这些贷款如何复制发薪日贷款模式并规避消费者保护？
AI.motivation: 美国住房成本上升催生了"先租后付"贷款市场，为难以支付租金的租户提供短期信贷，但缺乏对该市场结构、实践和风险的系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发薪日贷款理论、掠夺性贷款理论、消费者保护理论、金融科技监管理论、租金支付系统嵌入性理论
AI.method: 市场分析、消费者投诉分析、公开财务数据、监管数据分析、多源数据三角验证
AI.findings: 1. RNPL产品复制发薪日贷款模式；2. 通过复杂费用和误导性披露掩盖真实成本，年化利率超180%；3. 存在支付叠加、重复扣款、操作错误等消费者风险；4. 银行-金融科技合作可能规避州级消费者保护；5. RNPL贷款成为租金支付系统中嵌入的高成本掠夺性信贷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将发薪日贷款理论扩展到租金支付领域；2. 提出"租金支付系统嵌入性"概念；3. 深化对金融科技-银行合作规避监管的理解；4. 扩展掠夺性贷款理论在住房金融中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示RNPL贷款的具体风险和运作机制；2. 为监管机构提供政策建议；3. 为消费者提供风险警示；4. 为消费者保护组织提供行动依据；5. 推动对租金支付系统中金融产品的监管关注。

title: Tracking U.S. Hog and Pig Inventory in Real-time using Nowcasting

detail.title: Tracking U.S. Hog and Pig Inventory in Real-time using Nowcasting

declarations.funderStatement: Xiong, He, and Ma acknowledge the support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Project No. 72171099 and 72303075).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Department of Agriculture on a quarterly basis. During disruptions in the pork value chain, such as the initial outbreak of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus and the COVID-19 pandemic, there is a need for more frequent reporting of inventory levels. These more frequent estimates, if accurate, would improve production and marketing decisions, aid in policy assessments, and help reduce price volatility. This study proposes a mixed-frequency dynamic factor model to nowcast inventory estimates published in Quarterly Hogs and Pigs reports from 1993 to 2024, using more frequent published hog production and price data. In each round of nowcasting between two consecutive Quarterly Hogs and Pigs reports, we obtain ten nowcasting predictions of hog and pig inventory with progressively updated data. Our results show that reasonably accurate predictions can be obtained as early as two months before the release of a Quarterly Hogs and Pigs report, and they improve further as new information becomes available. The dynamic factor model outperforms several alternative methods and yields superior forecasts compared to analysts' pre-report expectations during extreme events. Government agencies and market participants could utilize our nowcasting model framework to publish inventory estimates more frequently and at relatively low cost.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种混合频率动态因子模型，利用更频繁发布的生猪生产和价格数据，对美国农业部季度生猪和猪只报告中的库存数据进行实时预测。该模型能够在季度报告发布前两个月提供准确预测，并在极端事件期间优于分析师预期。
AI.research_question: 如何利用更频繁发布的生猪生产和价格数据，准确预测美国农业部季度生猪和猪只报告中的库存水平？
AI.motivation: 在猪流行性腹泻病毒爆发和COVID-19大流行等猪肉价值链中断期间，需要更频繁地报告库存水平。更频繁且准确的库存估计可以改善生产和营销决策、帮助政策评估并减少价格波动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合频率动态因子模型，用于处理不同频率的时间序列数据，实现实时预测。
AI.method: 使用1993年至2024年的季度生猪和猪只报告数据，结合更频繁发布的生猪生产和价格数据，构建混合频率动态因子模型。在每两个连续季度报告之间进行十轮实时预测，随着新数据的获得逐步更新预测结果。
AI.findings: 1. 在季度报告发布前两个月就能获得合理准确的预测，随着新信息的获得预测精度进一步提高；2. 动态因子模型优于多种替代方法；3. 在极端事件期间，该模型的预测优于分析师在报告发布前的预期。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一种适用于农业库存预测的混合频率动态因子模型框架，扩展了实时预测方法在农业经济领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 政府机构和市场参与者可以利用该模型框架，以相对较低的成本更频繁地发布库存估计，从而改善决策制定、政策评估和市场稳定性。

title: Prompting as Governance: Behavioral Gaps and Control System Failures in AI-Assisted Infrastructure Operations
affiliations: The Algorithm

detail.title: Prompting as Governance: Behavioral Gaps and Control System Failures in AI-Assisted Infrastructure Operations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None. The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involved controlled testing of AI systems using synthetic infrastructure scenarios. No human subjects, patient data, or personally identifiable information was used in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently by The Algorithm.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether prompt engineering can function as a reliable governance control mechanism in AI-assisted infrastructure operations. Through 570 controlled experiments using GPT-4 and Claude Sonnet 4 across 90 infrastructure scenarios, we evaluate governance quality under four prompting strategies and three operational pressure conditions. Governance was measured using a weighted composite metric covering auditability, rollback planning, idempotency, validation, and documentation. We document a 973% gap between technically achievable governance (mean = 0.975, σ = 0.042) and baseline user behavior (mean = 0.091, σ = 0.067). Under simulated high-pressure conditions, governance degrades 46% from baseline (p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 2.91), with idempotency-a prerequisite for safe retry behavior-dropping from 95% to 0%. Statistical analysis confirms these effects are not artifacts of sample size or model selection. These findings suggest that prompting introduces behavioral variability into what enterprises typically treat as deterministic control requirements. The results challenge assumptions that interaction discipline can substitute for architectural enforcement in production systems requiring compliance documentation, change control, and operational safety guarantees. We interpret these findings through a control-systems lens, discussing implications for system design where governance is a non-negotiable requirement rather than a best-effort outcome.

AI.tldr: 研究通过570个实验发现，提示工程作为AI辅助基础设施治理控制机制存在重大缺陷：治理质量在高压下下降46%，技术可实现治理与用户实际行为间存在973%差距，挑战了交互纪律可替代架构强制的假设。
AI.research_question: 提示工程能否作为AI辅助基础设施运营中可靠的治理控制机制？
AI.motivation: 企业在AI辅助基础设施运营中需要可靠的治理控制，但现有研究假设交互纪律可以替代架构强制，这种假设在需要合规文档、变更控制和运营安全保证的生产系统中是否成立尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制理论视角，将治理视为非协商性要求而非尽力而为的结果；基础设施治理的关键维度包括可审计性、回滚规划、幂等性、验证和文档化。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4和Claude Sonnet 4进行570个受控实验，覆盖90个基础设施场景，评估四种提示策略和三种运营压力条件下的治理质量。治理质量采用加权综合指标测量，涵盖五个维度。
AI.findings: 1. 技术可实现治理（均值0.975）与基线用户行为（均值0.091）间存在973%差距；2. 高压条件下治理质量下降46%（p<0.001）；3. 幂等性从95%降至0%；4. 这些效应不是样本量或模型选择的伪影。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了交互纪律可替代架构强制的理论假设；将控制理论应用于AI辅助基础设施治理；揭示了提示工程引入的行为变异性对确定性控制要求的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为需要合规文档、变更控制和运营安全保证的生产系统设计提供指导；强调在治理作为非协商性要求的场景中，架构强制优于交互纪律；为AI辅助基础设施治理实践提供实证依据。

reference: U of Penn, Inst for Law & Econ Research Paper No. 26-05; Georgetown Law Journal, forthcoming, 2026
title: Engines of External Governance
affiliations: Harvard Law School and University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School; Co-Director, University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School - Institute for Law and Economics; European Corporate Governance Institute

detail.title: Engines of External Governance

publicationDetails.detailsText: U of Penn, Inst for Law & Econ Research Paper No. 26-05
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School, Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Traditional accounts of corporate governance focus on internal actors and largely neglect external governance: the ways in which actors outside the firm seek to embed broader objectives into corporate decision-making. This Article argues that nonprofits are now among the most important engines of external governance and taking their role into account sheds critical light on corporate governance developments in the past, present, and future.

We make three primary contributions. First, we identify the range of nonprofits that engage in external governance, discuss their defining features, and explain why governance-related activism occurs through nonprofit vehicles. Second, we examine their strategic playbook, which includes legislative advocacy, litigation, shareholder proposals, and soft law and shaming campaigns. We analyze how these strategies have contributed to key corporate governance shifts, from global supply chain and benefit corporation legislation to the rise and backlash against CSR, ESG, DEI, and climate-related agendas. Third, we explore the broader implications of this phenomenon for reform proposals and the future of corporate governance.

Nonprofits have consistently operated to expand the scope of corporate governance beyond shareholder-manager dynamics, thus challenging traditional conceptions of corporate governance, incorporating competing ideologies, and fueling unpredictable chain reactions. Their global reach and varied strategies create a hydraulic effect—when one avenue of influence is constrained, nonprofits redirect efforts through alternative mechanisms. Nonprofits also help explain why twenty-first-century corporate governance developments have diverged from predictions of an “end of history,” instead reflecting a global trend toward broader and more contested models of governance. Finally, shining a light on nonprofits as engines of external governance reveals a range of normative perspectives on both their constructive and concerning dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文认为非营利组织已成为企业外部治理的重要引擎，挑战了传统企业治理理论，并分析了非营利组织如何通过立法倡导、诉讼、股东提案等策略推动企业治理变革。
AI.research_question: 非营利组织在企业外部治理中扮演什么角色？它们如何影响企业治理的发展轨迹？
AI.motivation: 传统企业治理理论主要关注内部参与者（股东、管理层、董事会），忽视了外部治理机制。非营利组织作为重要的外部治理力量，对理解企业治理的过去、现在和未来发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业治理理论、外部治理理论、非营利组织理论、利益相关者理论、企业社会责任（CSR）、ESG（环境、社会和治理）、DEI（多元、公平和包容）
AI.method: 概念性分析、理论构建、案例分析（通过考察非营利组织的策略和影响）
AI.findings: 1. 非营利组织通过多种策略（立法倡导、诉讼、股东提案、软法和羞辱运动）推动企业治理变革；2. 它们扩大了企业治理的范围，超越了传统的股东-管理层动态；3. 非营利组织的全球影响力和多样化策略产生了"液压效应"——当一种影响途径受阻时，它们会转向其他机制；4. 这解释了为什么21世纪企业治理发展偏离了"历史终结"的预测，而是走向更广泛、更具争议的治理模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将非营利组织纳入企业治理理论框架，填补了外部治理研究的空白；2. 挑战了传统企业治理的狭隘概念；3. 解释了企业治理发展的动态性和不可预测性；4. 提出了"液压效应"概念来描述非营利组织的策略适应性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供了理解外部治理压力的框架；2. 为政策制定者展示了非营利组织在推动企业治理改革中的作用；3. 为非营利组织提供了战略参考；4. 为投资者和利益相关者理解企业治理变革提供了新视角。

title: Work from Home and Fertility
affiliations: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, ITAM - Business School, Stanford University - Department of Economics, Stanford University, University of Chicago, Ifo Institute and Princeton University - Princeton University

detail.title: Work from Home and Fertility

publicationDetails.journalName: European Bank for Reconstruction & Development Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We investigate how fertility relates to work from home (WFH) in the post-pandemic era, drawing on original data from our Global Survey of Working Arrangements and U.S. Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes. Realized fertility from 2023 to early 2025 and future planned fertility are higher among adults who WFH at least one day a week and, for couples, higher yet when both partners do so. Estimated lifetime fertility is greater by 0.32 children per woman when both partners WFH one or more days per week as compared to the case where neither does. The implications for national fertility rates differ across countries due mainly to large differences in WFH rates. In a complementary analysis using other U.S. data, one-year fertility rates in the 2023-2025 period rise with WFH opportunities in one's own occupation and, for couples, in the partner's occupation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在疫情后时代，每周至少一天远程办公（WFH）与生育率提升相关。当夫妻双方都远程办公时，生育率更高，预计每位女性终身生育数增加0.32个孩子。不同国家的生育率影响因远程办公普及率而异。
AI.research_question: 远程办公（WFH）如何影响疫情后时代的生育率？
AI.motivation: 疫情后远程办公成为新常态，但对其如何影响生育决策的研究不足。理解这一关系对预测人口趋势和制定相关政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作-家庭平衡理论，时间分配理论，生育决策理论。远程办公可能通过增加灵活性、减少通勤时间、改善工作-家庭平衡来影响生育决策。
AI.method: 使用全球工作安排调查和美国工作安排与态度调查的原始数据，分析2023年至2025年初的实际生育率和未来计划生育率。采用补充分析使用其他美国数据，考察职业远程办公机会与生育率的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 每周至少一天远程办公的成年人实际和计划生育率更高；2. 夫妻双方都远程办公时生育率最高；3. 夫妻双方都远程办公比都不远程办公的女性终身生育数多0.32个孩子；4. 不同国家的影响因远程办公普及率而异；5. 职业远程办公机会与2023-2025年生育率正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究疫情后远程办公与生育率的关系；2. 扩展了工作-家庭平衡理论在数字时代的表现；3. 为生育决策理论提供了新的解释机制（时间灵活性）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供通过推广远程办公应对低生育率的策略；2. 帮助企业理解灵活工作安排对员工家庭决策的影响；3. 为国家人口预测提供新的影响因素考虑。
