title: Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda
affiliations: Universitas Islam Indonesia - Faculty of Economics, University of Southampton Business School, UK and University of Southampton

detail.title: Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures: A Systematic Literature Review and Future Research Agenda

publicationDetails.detailsText: Business Strategy and the Environment, volume 34, issue 8, 2025[10.1002/bse.70112]

detail.abstract: We conduct a timely comprehensive review of the existing literature on Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD). Our aim is to provide a synthesis and extension of the current literature as follows: (i) review theoretical (i.e., socio-political, economic-based, and market-based) perspectives employed by existing studies; (ii) critique methodological aspects and contextual design of past studies; and (iii) discuss empirical findings on the determinants and consequences of TCFD reporting. Consulting three authoritative databases of "Scopus", "Web of Science", and "Business Source Complete", we employ a three-stage systematic literature review (SLR) method with a PRISMA and content analysis strategy to review 230 papers published in 101 high-quality journals from 2016 to January 2025. Our findings are fourfold. First, the majority of the studies reviewed are descriptive in nature, with limited theoretical insights. Second, we find that existing studies are predominantly narrative reports in nature that focus on the extent of TCFD implementation. By contrast, empirical evidence on the determinants and consequences of TCFD reporting is rare. Third, the existing studies have focused on few developed countries, whilst crosscountry comparative studies remain limited. Finally, we outline a number of promising opportunities for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文对TCFD（气候相关财务信息披露工作组）文献进行了系统性综述，分析了现有研究的理论视角、方法论和实证发现，并指出了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: TCFD相关文献在理论视角、方法论和实证发现方面有哪些主要特征和局限性？未来研究有哪些有前景的方向？
AI.motivation: TCFD作为气候相关财务信息披露的重要框架，相关研究迅速增长但缺乏系统性梳理。本文旨在对现有文献进行全面综述，识别研究空白并为未来研究提供方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要从三个理论视角分析：社会政治视角、经济基础视角和市场基础视角。这些理论框架用于理解TCFD报告的决定因素和后果。
AI.method: 采用三阶段系统性文献综述方法，结合PRISMA和内容分析策略，检索Scopus、Web of Science和Business Source Complete三个权威数据库，筛选2016年至2025年1月发表的230篇高质量期刊论文。
AI.findings: 1. 多数研究为描述性，缺乏理论深度；2. 现有研究主要是叙述性报告，关注TCFD实施程度，而关于TCFD报告决定因素和后果的实证证据稀少；3. 研究集中在少数发达国家，跨国比较研究有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了TCFD研究的理论视角，识别了理论应用的局限性，为未来研究提供了理论整合和发展的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构和公司提供了TCFD实施现状的全面图景，指出了实证研究的不足，帮助利益相关者更好地理解和改进TCFD报告实践。

title: Housing, Land and Property Rights as War-financing Commodi;es: A typology with lessons from Darfur, Colombia and Syria

detail.title: Housing, Land and Property Rights as War-financing Commodi;es: A typology with lessons from Darfur, Colombia and Syria
detail.abstract: The ongoing use of landscape-based conflict commodi@es-diamonds and other minerals, @mber, wildlife, etc.-to finance wars con@nues to evolve. The success with which such commodi@es can be transacted to support militaries, mili@as and insurgencies has led belligerents to innovate with addi@onal commodi@es. Housing, land and property (HLP) rights within war zones have belatedly joined the list of conflict commodi@es that are subject to transac@on, and to such an extent as to warrant significant concern. However, the use of 'conflict HLP rights' has not yet been opera@onally described in the way that other conflict commodi@es have been. This is a necessary first step towards deriving and designing countermeasures. This ar@cle makes a preliminary aSempt to delineate the exploita@on of conflict HLP rights by examining how they are transacted to support belligerent groups in three conflicts: Darfur, Colombia and Syria.

AI.tldr: 本文首次尝试将战争地区的住房、土地和财产权作为冲突商品进行操作性描述，通过分析达尔富尔、哥伦比亚和叙利亚三个冲突案例，揭示了这些权利如何被交易以支持交战方。
AI.research_question: 战争地区的住房、土地和财产权如何作为冲突商品被交易以支持交战方？
AI.motivation: 虽然钻石、矿产、木材、野生动物等冲突商品已被广泛研究，但住房、土地和财产权作为冲突商品的现象尚未得到操作性描述，而这是制定应对措施的必要第一步。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突商品理论，重点关注住房、土地和财产权在战争环境中的商品化过程。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，分析达尔富尔、哥伦比亚和叙利亚三个冲突地区的HLP权利交易模式。
AI.findings: 住房、土地和财产权已成为重要的冲突商品，交战方通过多种方式交易这些权利来获取战争资金，其运作模式在不同冲突地区存在差异但具有共同特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将住房、土地和财产权纳入冲突商品理论框架，扩展了冲突商品的研究范畴，为理解战争经济提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际组织、政府和民间社会制定针对冲突地区HLP权利交易的应对措施提供了实证基础，有助于保护战争受害者的财产权利。

title: The Regulatory Architecture of Hire-Purchase Repossession in Malaysia: A Critical Analysis of the Hire-Purchase Act 1967 and the Non-Waiver of Statutory Protections

detail.title: The Regulatory Architecture of Hire-Purchase Repossession in Malaysia: A Critical Analysis of the Hire-Purchase Act 1967 and the Non-Waiver of Statutory Protections

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am independent researcher. I have no financial relationship with anyone.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is doctrinal legal research. It has no relation with patients.
declarations.funderStatement: The research is not funded. Originally, it was my assignment for my study.

contentType.other: It is not published. I want to publish it electronically on SSRN.

detail.abstract: The article undertakes a critical doctrinal and socio-legal examination of the Hire-Purchase Act 1967, with particular emphasis upon the repossession framework and the imperative of non-waiver under Section 34. It evaluates whether the Act's procedural architecture forged in an era predating digital commerce and complex financial products remains adequate to protect consumers in Malaysia's contemporary credit market. It commences with an examination of definitional boundaries and the mandatory formalities of formation. It proceeds to a granular dissection of the three-stage repossession procedure mandated by Sections 16 through 19. It thereafter undertakes a critical evaluation of Section 34 as a legislative bar against contracting out. It concludes with an analysis of systemic failures; unethical agent conduct, administrative paralysis upon a hirer's death, shortfall debt cycles, and antiquated notice systems and proposes targeted reforms. It further argues that while the HPA 1967 remains a sophisticated remedial instrument, its efficacy is critically compromised by enforcement deficits and legislative inertia, necessitating digitalisation of notices, vicarious liability for financiers, a statutory moratorium for deceased estates, mandatory AKPK referrals, and formal regulation of voluntary returns.

AI.tldr: 本文对马来西亚1967年《分期付款购买法》进行了批判性分析，特别关注收回程序框架和第34条的非弃权规定，评估该法在数字商务时代是否仍能有效保护消费者，并提出改革建议。
AI.research_question: 1967年《分期付款购买法》在数字商务和复杂金融产品时代是否仍能充分保护马来西亚当代信贷市场中的消费者？
AI.motivation: 该法制定于数字商务和复杂金融产品出现之前，其程序架构可能已无法适应当代信贷市场的需求，需要评估其有效性并提出改革建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性法律学说分析、社会法律分析、消费者保护理论、合同法原则
AI.method: 批判性法律学说分析和社会法律分析，包括：定义边界和强制形式要求审查、第16-19条三阶段收回程序详细分析、第34条作为立法禁止弃权的批判性评估
AI.findings: 虽然1967年《分期付款购买法》仍是一个复杂的补救工具，但其效力因执行不足和立法惰性而严重受损；存在系统性失败：不道德的代理人行为、承租人死亡时的行政瘫痪、短缺债务循环、过时的通知系统
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对马来西亚分期付款购买法律框架的批判性分析，特别关注消费者保护机制在数字时代的适应性，发展了关于立法滞后性和法律现代化需求的理论见解
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体改革建议：通知数字化、金融家替代责任、死者遗产法定暂停期、强制AKPK转介、自愿返还的正式监管

title: Information Acquisition and Misreporting: A Research Note
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Accounting, Auditing and Law, University of Amsterdam - Amsterdam Business School and NHH Norwegian School of Economics

detail.title: Information Acquisition and Misreporting: A Research Note
detail.abstract: For their strategic and operational decision making, managers often need to rely on information reported by their subordinates. However, these subordinates sometimes have incentives to misreport information. We examine whether the process through which employees acquire the information they need to report affects the likelihood that they selfishly misreport this information to their manager. We argue that employees are more likely to misreport information that they chose to collect compared to information that they were endowed with, and that this difference will be larger if acquiring the information requires costly effort. The reason is that as the information acquisition process becomes more convoluted, employees will find it easier to come up with benevolent explanations for their misstated reports, which reduces the psychological costs of misreporting. Using a lab experiment, we find no effect of information acquisition discretion on misreporting, but we do find that information acquisition effort increases misreporting.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨员工获取信息的方式如何影响其向上级误报信息的可能性。研究发现，相比被动获得信息，员工主动收集信息时更可能误报，且获取信息所需努力越大，误报倾向越强。
AI.research_question: 员工获取信息的过程（主动收集vs被动获得）如何影响他们向管理者自私地误报信息的可能性？
AI.motivation: 管理者依赖下属报告的信息进行战略和运营决策，但下属有时有动机误报信息。理解信息获取过程如何影响误报行为对组织管理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理学成本理论，认为员工会为误报行为寻找"善意解释"来降低心理成本。信息获取过程越复杂，员工越容易合理化自己的误报行为。
AI.method: 采用实验室实验方法，通过控制信息获取方式（自主选择vs被动赋予）和获取努力程度来检验假设。
AI.findings: 信息获取自主性对误报行为没有显著影响，但信息获取努力程度显著增加了误报行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对误报行为的理解，强调信息获取过程（特别是努力成本）如何通过心理合理化机制影响道德决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者设计信息报告系统提供启示：减少信息获取的复杂性可能降低员工误报倾向，提高组织决策质量。

title: Designed Uncertainty in Mystery Products
affiliations: Humboldt University of Berlin - School of Business and Economics, Humboldt University of Berlin - School of Business and Economics, University of Würzburg - Business Administration & Economics and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)

detail.title: Designed Uncertainty in Mystery Products

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project-ID 280092119 – TRR 190 is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: Mystery products deliberately hide key attributes until after purchase and have become a common strategy in retail and services, yet systematic evidence on how to design them effectively remains limited. This research studies two managerial levers-outcome-set composition and uncertainty framing (risk vs. ambiguity)-in two incentive-aligned choice experiments: an induced-value lab study with vertically differentiated outcomes and a large-scale choice-based conjoint on apparel with horizontally differentiated brands. Willingness-to-pay is shaped primarily by the structure of the outcome set: when a dominant outcome is included, consumers discount the mystery product; when outcomes are similar in value, a premium can emerge. Ambiguity reduces valuation primarily when outcome differentiation is high, and it shifts attention away from brand and "mystery" cues toward tangible attributes such as fit and color. In market simulations, mystery products are more price-elastic than fully specified alternatives and shift profits toward participating brands, especially weaker ones, while non-participants lose. Overall, the results inform when and how designed uncertainty can be used as a marketing instrument.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了神秘产品（隐藏关键属性直到购买后）的设计策略，发现结果集结构（是否包含主导结果）是影响支付意愿的主要因素，而模糊性（vs.风险）在高差异化情境下会降低估值。神秘产品价格弹性更高，能帮助弱势品牌获利。
AI.research_question: 如何有效设计神秘产品？具体研究两个管理杠杆：结果集构成和不确定性框架（风险vs.模糊性）如何影响消费者支付意愿和市场表现。
AI.motivation: 神秘产品已成为零售和服务业的常见策略，但关于如何有效设计它们的系统性证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性经济学（风险与模糊性的区别）、消费者决策理论（结果集结构对估值的影响）、品牌竞争理论。
AI.method: 采用两个激励相容的选择实验：1）实验室诱导价值研究（垂直差异化结果）；2）大规模选择联合分析（服装品类，水平差异化品牌）。
AI.findings: 1）支付意愿主要由结果集结构决定：包含主导结果时消费者会折价，结果价值相似时可能出现溢价；2）模糊性主要在高差异化时降低估值，并将注意力从品牌和"神秘"线索转向具体属性（如合身性、颜色）；3）市场模拟显示神秘产品比完全指定产品价格弹性更高，将利润转向参与品牌（尤其是弱势品牌），非参与者受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）明确了神秘产品设计中结果集构成的关键作用；2）区分了风险与模糊性在不同差异化情境下的不同影响；3）揭示了神秘产品如何改变消费者注意力分配。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为管理者提供设计神秘产品的具体指导：避免包含主导结果，在结果价值相似时可能获得溢价；2）帮助品牌（尤其是弱势品牌）通过神秘产品策略获利；3）识别了神秘产品的价格弹性特征，为定价策略提供依据。

title: Barriers to the Effective Implementation of Affordable Housing Policies in Canada and Strategies for Overcoming Them

detail.title: Barriers to the Effective Implementation of Affordable Housing Policies in Canada and Strategies for Overcoming Them
detail.abstract:
This dissertation examines the growing Canadian housing crisis by exploring the structural, economic, and policy factors contributing to the lack of affordable and accessible housing. Despite ongoing federal and provincial efforts, many individuals and families continue to experience instability, financial strain, and limited access to safe and appropriate housing. This study aims to analyze the barriers, lived realities, and policy gaps affecting housing affordability while identifying strategic opportunities to strengthen housing support systems and sustainable policy responses.

A mixed-methods research design was employed, integrating a review of national housing data with qualitative insights from community perspectives, policy documents, and practitioner observations. Findings reveal three core challenges: escalating housing costs outpacing income growth, insufficient affordable housing supply, and systemic policy misalignment between government levels and service delivery organizations. These factors collectively exacerbate vulnerability, particularly for low-income households, newcomers, and marginalized populations. 

The study highlights the need for coordinated public policy reform, increased investment in social and affordable housing, and community-based strategies that foreground equity, inclusion, and long-term sustainability. Beyond identifying challenges, the research contributes evidence-informed recommendations to help guide policymakers, housing advocates, and community organizations in developing responsive and humane housing solutions. 

This dissertation underscores that addressing Canada’s housing crisis requires more than infrastructure expansion; it demands integrated policy frameworks and collaborative approaches grounded in social justice, human dignity, and community well-being.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加拿大住房危机，分析导致住房可负担性和可及性不足的结构性、经济性和政策因素，并提出政策改革建议。
AI.research_question: 加拿大住房危机的结构性、经济性和政策因素是什么？如何通过政策改革和社区策略解决住房可负担性和可及性问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管联邦和省级政府持续努力，许多加拿大人仍面临住房不稳定、财务压力和缺乏安全适当住房的问题，需要深入分析政策差距和现实挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房政策分析框架、社会正义理论、系统性政策错位理论、社区参与理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：整合国家住房数据审查与定性分析（社区视角、政策文件、从业者观察）
AI.findings: 三个核心挑战：1) 住房成本增速超过收入增长；2) 可负担住房供应不足；3) 政府层级与服务提供组织间的系统性政策错位，这些因素加剧了低收入家庭、新移民和边缘群体的脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合社会正义、人类尊严和社区福祉的政策框架，强调系统性政策协调的重要性，为住房危机研究提供了多维分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、住房倡导者和社区组织提供基于证据的建议：协调公共政策改革、增加社会住房投资、发展基于社区的公平包容策略，推动可持续住房解决方案。

title: When the Mission Runs on One Person: Compensation, Governance, and the "Directing Mind" in Small Charitable Nonprofits

detail.title: When the Mission Runs on One Person: Compensation, Governance, and the "Directing Mind" in Small Charitable Nonprofits

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: Small charitable nonprofits are operating in an era of heightened compliance expectations, chronic volunteer fatigue, and shrinking operational capacity. At the same time, leadership transitions and board turnover have become more frequent, increasing the risk of retrospective governance disputes over past practices that were never formally articulated or documented. As funders demand professionalized administration while boards remain formally volunteer, the gap between legal form and operational reality has widened. This article addresses that gap by examining how conditional compensation for essential managerial and administrative labor-distinct from governance-can function as both a survival mechanism and a dispute-prevention strategy. At a moment when nonprofits are asked to do more with less, clarity about compensation, benefit, and fairness is no longer theoretical; it is a governance necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了小型慈善非营利组织如何通过条件性补偿机制来弥合法律形式与运营现实之间的差距，将其作为生存机制和争议预防策略。
AI.research_question: 条件性补偿如何帮助小型慈善非营利组织应对合规压力、志愿者疲劳和运营能力缩减，同时预防治理争议？
AI.motivation: 小型非营利组织面临合规要求提高、志愿者疲劳、运营能力缩减、领导层频繁更替等挑战，法律形式与运营现实之间的差距扩大，需要解决补偿、福利和公平性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织治理理论、非营利组织管理理论、代理理论、合规与风险管理理论
AI.method: 概念性分析，基于文献综述和理论框架构建，探讨条件性补偿机制的设计和实施
AI.findings: 条件性补偿机制能够区分治理工作与必要的管理和行政劳动，帮助组织在资源有限的情况下维持运营，同时预防因过去实践未正式记录而引发的治理争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了条件性补偿作为非营利组织治理理论的新视角，弥合了法律形式与运营现实之间的理论差距，为非营利组织治理提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小型非营利组织提供了具体的生存策略和争议预防工具，帮助组织在资源紧张的情况下明确补偿机制，提高治理透明度，减少法律风险。

title: Going Public in a Vertically Related Market with Common Ownership

detail.title: Going Public in a Vertically Related Market with Common Ownership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number JP25K23140.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the welfare implications of firms' going-public decisions in a vertically related market with common ownership. Specifically, an upstream supplier interacts with two downstream manufacturers through linear wholesale pricing, and firms make endogenous listing decisions. Listed firms can invest in deterministic cost-reducing R&D with the large-scale financing through the public market. We find that when the supplier has no market power (i.e., under upstream perfect competition), there exists a unique equilibrium in which both manufacturers go public. By contrast, when the supplier has market power (i.e., under upstream monopoly), one of three equilibria could arise: The supplier remains public in all cases, while none, one, or both manufacturers go public. These results suggest that the market structure is a key factor in firms' decisions to go public. We also find that the recent Japanese policy intervention, which led to higher common ownership rates and a smaller financing gap between listed and unlisted firms, may discourage downstream firms from going public, thereby reducing welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在垂直相关市场和共同所有权背景下，企业上市决策的福利影响。研究发现，上游市场结构是影响企业上市决策的关键因素：上游完全竞争时，两家下游制造商都会上市；上游垄断时，则可能出现多种均衡。日本政策干预提高了共同所有权率、缩小了上市与非上市企业融资差距，可能抑制下游企业上市，从而降低福利。
AI.research_question: 在垂直相关市场和共同所有权背景下，企业的上市决策如何影响社会福利？
AI.motivation: 理解企业在垂直市场结构中的上市决策及其福利影响，特别是考虑到共同所有权和融资约束的现实背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直相关市场理论、共同所有权理论、企业融资理论（上市决策）、产业组织理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建垂直市场模型，上游供应商与两家下游制造商通过线性批发定价互动，企业内生性上市决策，上市企业可通过公开市场大规模融资进行确定性成本降低型研发投资。
AI.findings: 1. 上游完全竞争时，存在唯一均衡：两家制造商都上市。2. 上游垄断时，可能出现三种均衡：供应商在所有情况下都保持上市，而制造商可能都不上市、一家上市或两家都上市。3. 日本政策干预（提高共同所有权率、缩小融资差距）可能抑制下游企业上市，从而降低福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了市场结构对企业上市决策的关键影响。2. 在垂直相关市场和共同所有权背景下，建立了企业上市决策与福利分析的理论框架。3. 识别了不同市场结构下的均衡多样性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于企业上市决策福利影响的洞见。2. 揭示了日本政策干预可能产生的意外负面后果。3. 为企业战略决策（是否上市）提供了理论参考。

title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Total Insurance Premiums in Nigeria: Evidence from 1996-2024
affiliations: Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu

detail.title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Total Insurance Premiums in Nigeria: Evidence from 1996-2024

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: his study is based entirely on secondary data obtained from publicly available and credible sources, including [CBN Statistic Bulletin; World Bank, Macrotrends , National Bureau of Statistics, published academic articles, etc.]. No human participants or personally identifiable information were involved in the research. As such, ethical approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Insurance industry plays important roles in a country's growth and development and as well a critical segment of the financial sector. This study examines the impact of macroeconomic variables on total insurance premiums in Nigeria covering 1996-2024. Specifically, the study's objectives were to examine the impact of gross domestic product, inflation rate and unemployment rate on total insurance premium in Nigeria. Secondary data used for the study was sourced from CBN statistical bulletin and Annual Reports and macrotrends.net while hypotheses formulated were tested using regression techniques with the aid of e-view version 13 which resulted in the findings that: Gross domestic product has a significant positive impact on total insurance premium in Nigeria with a p-value of 0.0000; While Inflation rate with a p-value of 0.9018 and Unemployment rate with a p-value of 0.9398 had no significant impact on total insurance premium in Nigeria at 5% significance level. Overall, p-value 0.000 showed it has a significant effect. SWOT and PESTEL analyses highlighted internal strengths and weaknesses, as well as external opportunities and threats influencing total insurance premiums. The study came to the conclusion that gross domestic product has a significant positive impact on Total Insurance Premium in Nigeria while Inflation and unemployment rate do not. The study therefore recommended that policymakers and insurers should focus on fostering economic growth as a means of enhancing the growth of the insurance industry and that insurers may need to reassess the degree to which inflation is currently factored into premium pricing and reducing unemployment could indirectly increase the demand for non-life insurance products.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1996-2024年尼日利亚宏观经济变量对总保险保费的影响，发现GDP对保险保费有显著正向影响，而通货膨胀率和失业率无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚的宏观经济变量（GDP、通货膨胀率、失业率）如何影响总保险保费？
AI.motivation: 保险业在尼日利亚的经济发展和金融体系中扮演重要角色，了解宏观经济因素对保险业的影响对政策制定和行业发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论，研究GDP、通货膨胀率、失业率等关键经济指标对保险需求的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1996-2024年的二手数据（来自CBN统计公报、年度报告和macrotrends.net），采用回归分析技术（E-views 13）检验假设，并辅以SWOT和PESTEL分析。
AI.findings: 1. GDP对尼日利亚总保险保费有显著正向影响（p=0.0000）；2. 通货膨胀率（p=0.9018）和失业率（p=0.9398）在5%显著性水平下无显著影响；3. 整体模型显著（p=0.000）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了GDP作为保险需求关键驱动因素的理论，挑战了传统认为通货膨胀和失业率直接影响保险需求的观点，为新兴市场保险需求理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议政策制定者和保险公司应重点促进经济增长以推动保险业发展；2. 保险公司需重新评估当前保费定价中对通货膨胀因素的考量；3. 降低失业率可能间接增加非寿险产品的需求。

title: Assessment of the Effectiveness of Monitoring and Evaluation Tools on Donor-Funded Programmes: The Case of Giz Malawi
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Assessment of the Effectiveness of Monitoring and Evaluation Tools on Donor-Funded Programmes: The Case of Giz Malawi
detail.abstract: Malawi continues to experience persistent underperformance of donor funded projects. Both theoretical and empirical literature have not produced a general agreement on the effectiveness of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) tools on determining projects performance. This study examines the effectiveness of monitoring and evaluation (M&E) tools on donor funded programmes in Malawi. The study was centered on main tool of monitoring and evaluation which is: Data collection tools effectiveness. This was guided by the objective: to analyze the perceived effectiveness of data collection tools in enhancing outcomes in GIZ-funded programmes in Malawi. The study sampled 140 respondents which include: GIZ Officers, Project partners and Beneficiaries from Lilongwe and Mzuzu, 35 respondents per project. The crosssection data was collected by Likert scale questionnaire and document analysis. The study employed TwoStage Least (2SLS) approach to fulfill its objective. The results show a significant impact of data collection tool effectiveness on projects performance and that projects with effective data collection tool potentially increases performance by 0.509 than those not used effective data collection tool. The study recommended that all the concerned should be empowered with skills and knowledge in order to have grasp of how monitoring and evaluation tools can be utilized to achieve the targeted project outcome. The study also recommended reduced project duration as such projects performs, as the results show a highly significant of -0.013 per additional month at 1% level of significant.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了马拉维捐助资金项目中监测与评估工具（特别是数据收集工具）的有效性对项目绩效的影响。研究发现，有效的数据收集工具能显著提升项目绩效0.509个单位，而项目持续时间每增加一个月，绩效会显著降低0.013个单位。
AI.research_question: 数据收集工具的有效性如何影响马拉维GIZ资助项目的绩效？
AI.motivation: 马拉维捐助资金项目持续表现不佳，且现有理论和实证文献对监测与评估工具在决定项目绩效方面的有效性尚未达成共识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监测与评估（M&E）理论，特别是数据收集工具在项目绩效管理中的作用。
AI.method: 采用横截面数据收集方法，通过李克特量表问卷和文件分析，从140名受访者（GIZ官员、项目合作伙伴和受益者）收集数据，并使用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）进行分析。
AI.findings: 数据收集工具的有效性对项目绩效有显著影响：使用有效数据收集工具的项目绩效比未使用的项目高0.509个单位。同时，项目持续时间每增加一个月，绩效会显著降低0.013个单位（在1%显著性水平上）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监测与评估工具（特别是数据收集工具）在捐助资金项目绩效管理中的有效性提供了实证证据，填补了现有文献在此领域的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议为相关人员提供监测与评估工具使用的技能和知识培训，并缩短项目持续时间以提高绩效。

title: Narcissistic Wounds and Narcissistic Defenses in Clinical Work: A Psychoanalytic Inquiry into the Fragility of the Self in Culture and Therapy

detail.title: Narcissistic Wounds and Narcissistic Defenses in Clinical Work: A Psychoanalytic Inquiry into the Fragility of the Self in Culture and Therapy
detail.abstract: In the annals of psychoanalytic thought, the concept of narcissism has evolved from Freud's initial formulation in "On Narcissism: An Introduction" (1914) as a libidinal investment in the ego to a multifaceted clinical phenomenon encompassing both pathological distortions and universal human vulnerabilities. This essay draws upon a recent seminar by Nathan Kravis, a clinical professor of psychiatry at Weill Cornell Medical College and training analyst at Columbia University's Center for Psychoanalytic Training and Research, titled "Narcissistic Wounds and Narcissistic Defenses in Clinical Work." Delivered on October 7, 2023, and transcribed in Russian with English originals interspersed, Kravis's presentation serves as a fulcrum for exploring how narcissistic injuries-those inevitable assaults on self-esteem arising from life's "thousand natural shocks" as Hamlet laments (Shakespeare, 1603/2005, Act 3, Scene 1)-elicit a spectrum of defenses that range from the maladaptive to the potentially reparative. Kravis posits that narcissistic protections are "ubiquitous" not merely among those with narcissistic personality disorder but for all individuals, echoing Kohut's (1971) self-psychology assertion that "the disorders of the self are ubiquitous" in modern society, where the self's cohesion is perpetually at risk from cultural imperatives of autonomy and achievement. Yet, this universality invites a philosophical scrutiny: if narcissism is the human condition, as Lacan (1953/2006) might frame it through the mirror stage's illusory wholeness, then clinical work becomes not just a containment of pathology but a dialectical engagement with the Real of lack and desire. Kravis's seminar, structured as a thought experiment on a disastrously received lecture, illustrates this by arraying responses from smug grandiosityinterpreting audience yawns as "awe-struck" silence-to depressive self-loathing and, finally, guilt-laden introspection enabling growth. This progression mirrors Kernberg's (1975) object-relations model, where primitive defenses like splitting and projection yield to depressive-position integration (Klein, 1946/1975). Philosophically, it resonates with Nietzsche's (1887/2003) critique in On the Genealogy of Morality of ressentiment as a slave morality's inversion of weakness into vengeful superiority, suggesting that

AI.tldr: 这篇论文基于Nathan Kravis的研讨会，探讨了自恋伤害如何引发从适应不良到潜在修复性的防御机制，认为自恋保护是普遍的人类现象，而不仅仅是自恋型人格障碍的特征。
AI.research_question: 自恋伤害如何引发不同的防御机制？这些防御机制如何从适应不良发展到潜在修复性？自恋保护在多大程度上是普遍的人类现象而非病理特征？
AI.motivation: 自恋概念从弗洛伊德最初的理论发展到现代临床现象，需要更深入理解自恋伤害与防御机制之间的关系，以及这些机制在临床工作中的实际应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弗洛伊德的自恋理论、科胡特的自体心理学、拉康的镜像阶段理论、克恩伯格的客体关系模型、克莱因的抑郁位整合、尼采的道德谱系学中的怨恨概念。
AI.method: 基于Nathan Kravis 2023年10月7日研讨会的分析，该研讨会以思想实验的形式，通过一个演讲失败的案例来展示自恋伤害引发的各种防御反应。
AI.findings: 自恋保护是普遍现象，不仅限于自恋型人格障碍患者；自恋伤害会引发从自大狂想（将观众打哈欠解释为"敬畏的沉默"）到抑郁性自我憎恨，再到促进成长的内省等防御机制；这些防御反应反映了从原始防御（分裂、投射）到抑郁位整合的进展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自恋概念从病理特征扩展到普遍人类现象；整合了精神分析不同流派（经典精神分析、自体心理学、客体关系理论）对自恋的理解；提出了自恋防御机制的连续谱概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床工作者提供了理解自恋伤害与防御机制的理论框架；展示了如何通过思想实验方法分析临床情境；强调了内省和整合在治疗过程中的重要性。

title:
The Newtonian Architecture of the Social Sciences: Force, Equilibrium and the Mechanical Imagination 
From Classical Mechanics to the Age of Complexity
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title:
The Newtonian Architecture of the Social Sciences: Force, Equilibrium and the Mechanical Imagination 
From Classical Mechanics to the Age of Complexity
detail.abstract: This paper argues that the modern social sciences consolidated within a Newtonian intellectual order. Following the publication of Principia in 1687, classical mechanics became the authoritative model of lawful explanation in Europe. Its structural commitments-proportional causation, system isolation, determinacy and equilibrium-diffused beyond physics into law, economics, sociology and political theory. These disciplines absorbed not merely metaphor but architecture. Legal positivism reduced law to command backed by sanction. Marginalist economics modelled markets as equilibrium systems. Sociology formalised social forces and systemic stability. Political theory institutionalised balance-of-power reasoning. This convergence reflects epistemic inheritance rather than coincidence. Twentieth-century science later displaced simple equilibrium thinking through nonlinear dynamics, thermodynamics and network analysis, yet the social sciences largely retained their mechanical foundations. Contemporary systemic instability exposes the limits of that inheritance. A reconstruction grounded in complexity science represents continuation of scientific evolution rather than its rejection.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为现代社会科学是在牛顿式知识秩序中形成的。自1687年《自然哲学的数学原理》出版后，经典力学成为欧洲权威的法律解释模型。其结构承诺——比例因果关系、系统隔离、确定性和均衡——从物理学扩散到法学、经济学、社会学和政治理论中。这些学科吸收的不仅是隐喻，更是架构。20世纪科学通过非线性动力学、热力学和网络分析取代了简单均衡思维，但社会科学仍保留其机械基础。当代系统不稳定性暴露了这一知识遗产的局限性。基于复杂性科学的重建代表了科学演化的延续而非拒绝。
AI.research_question: 现代社会科学如何以及为何在牛顿式知识秩序中形成？这种机械基础在当代系统不稳定性背景下的局限性是什么？如何基于复杂性科学重建社会科学？
AI.motivation: 现代社会科学建立在经典力学的结构承诺之上，但20世纪科学已经发展出非线性动力学、热力学和网络分析等更复杂的理论框架。当代社会面临系统性不稳定，暴露了传统机械基础的局限性，需要基于现代科学进展进行理论重建。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 牛顿经典力学（比例因果关系、系统隔离、确定性、均衡）
2. 法律实证主义（法律简化为命令加制裁）
3. 边际主义经济学（市场作为均衡系统）
4. 社会学形式化（社会力量与系统稳定性）
5. 政治理论（权力平衡推理）
6. 复杂性科学（非线性动力学、热力学、网络分析）
AI.method: 概念分析与历史分析：追溯牛顿经典力学从物理学向法学、经济学、社会学和政治理论的跨学科扩散过程，分析其结构承诺如何被这些社会科学学科吸收，并评估这种知识遗产在当代的局限性。
AI.findings:
1. 现代社会科学确实在牛顿式知识秩序中形成，吸收了经典力学的结构承诺
2. 这种跨学科扩散是知识遗产而非巧合
3. 20世纪科学已经发展出更复杂的理论框架，但社会科学仍保留机械基础
4. 当代系统性不稳定暴露了传统机械基础的局限性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了现代社会科学与牛顿经典力学之间的深层知识联系
2. 提出了社会科学的知识谱系分析框架
3. 论证了基于复杂性科学重建社会科学的理论必要性
4. 建立了从机械范式向复杂系统范式的理论转型路径
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解当代社会系统不稳定性提供新的分析框架
2. 为政策制定者提供基于复杂性科学的决策工具
3. 为社会科学教育改革提供方向
4. 为跨学科研究提供方法论基础

title: Why EU Capital Markets Union has become a "Must have" and how to get there
affiliations: Bruegel

detail.title: Why EU Capital Markets Union has become a "Must have" and how to get there
detail.abstract:
Five proposals for policymakers 

1. Harmonise the key elements of corporate insolvency proceedings and consider adopting an opt-in regime based on international standards, perhaps by “enhanced co-operation” among a willing group of Member States 

2. Create the conditions for securitisations to become a complement to bank finance 

3. Stimulate retail investment via an array of actions including tax incentives and more autoenrollment in pension funds 

4. Empower ESMA to become the supervisor of wholesale capital markets via joint supervisory teams with national competent authority (NCA) staff 

5. Investigate the feasibility of developing the ultimate High Quality Liquid Asset for financial institutions – a “safe asset” in the form of a Eurobill fund 

Five reasons why CMU has moved from being `nice to have’ to `must have’: 

1. Europe’s green and digital ambitions require more private capital and a more efficient deployment of the existing stock 

2. Efficient financial markets with modest asset management fees can produce and protect wealth for ageing populations 

3. Mature capital markets provide cheaper and more diversified sources of funding, spurring innovation and economic growth 

4. Developed capital markets promote Europe’s strategic autonomy 

5. Deep and integrated capital markets strengthen financial stability by facilitating risk-sharing, reducing the strong reliance on bank finance and pricing risks efficiently

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了推动欧洲资本市场联盟（CMU）的五项政策建议，并阐述了CMU从"可有可无"变为"必须拥有"的五个原因，强调资本市场对欧洲绿色转型、数字发展、老龄化社会财富保护和经济自主性的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过政策改革推动欧洲资本市场联盟（CMU）建设，以及为什么CMU对欧洲经济发展变得至关重要？
AI.motivation: 欧洲面临绿色和数字转型的资金需求、老龄化社会的财富保护需求、降低对银行融资的过度依赖、增强战略自主性以及促进金融稳定等挑战，需要深化资本市场一体化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本市场发展理论、金融一体化理论、金融稳定理论、战略自主性理论和绿色金融理论，探讨资本市场在经济发展中的多重作用。
AI.method: 政策分析研究，通过文献综述和现状分析，提出具体的政策建议框架，采用描述性和规范性分析方法。
AI.findings: 提出了五项具体政策建议：1）协调公司破产程序；2）发展证券化市场；3）刺激零售投资；4）加强ESMA监管权力；5）开发欧元安全资产。同时识别了CMU变得至关重要的五个原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对资本市场一体化多重效益的理论理解，特别是在绿色转型、老龄化社会、战略自主性和金融稳定方面的理论联系，为CMU建设提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲政策制定者提供了具体的、可操作的政策建议路线图，有助于推动CMU实际建设，促进欧洲资本市场深度整合，支持经济转型和发展。

title: Modeling Abuses of Dominance in Digital Platform Ecosystems: Tying and Data Exploitation
affiliations: and Solve Economics

detail.title: Modeling Abuses of Dominance in Digital Platform Ecosystems: Tying and Data Exploitation
detail.abstract: Antitrust enforcement in digital markets increasingly addresses abuses of dominance by online platforms. The European Commission's 2024 Facebook Marketplace decision sanctioned Meta for (i) abusive tying and (ii) data exploitation via unfair trading conditions. We develop two models to formalise anti-competitive effects of these distinct abuses. The first captures tying in two adjacent, two-sided markets, showing that leveraging user overlap to increase exposure among consumers already active in both markets creates a structural distribution advantage for the integrated firm. Tying may be profitable and lead to foreclosure based solely due to reach asymmetry among overlapping users. The second analyses strategic data exploitation, highlighting the integrated firm's trade-off between raising its own platform's competitiveness and reducing advertising revenues obtained from competitors. It demonstrates how exploitation raises competitors' effective advertising costs, induces heterogeneous competitor retreat, and reinforces the integrated platform's position. Together, the models provide a theoretical foundation for both abuses, complement the Commission's findings, and offer a generalisable framework for studying digital platform competition, while expanding the literature on non-price foreclosure and strategic, heterogeneous harm from data exploitation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两个理论模型形式化了数字平台反垄断中的两种滥用行为：捆绑销售和战略数据剥削。第一个模型展示了平台如何利用用户重叠创造结构性分销优势，第二个模型分析了数据剥削如何提高竞争对手的有效广告成本并导致异质性退出。研究为欧盟委员会对Meta的裁决提供了理论基础。
AI.research_question: 数字平台如何通过捆绑销售和战略数据剥削实施反竞争行为？这些滥用行为的具体机制和竞争效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字市场反垄断执法日益关注在线平台的滥用支配地位行为，特别是欧盟委员会2024年对Meta（Facebook Marketplace）的裁决，涉及捆绑销售和数据剥削两种滥用行为。需要理论模型来形式化这些行为的反竞争效应。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 双边市场理论（用于分析平台捆绑销售）
2. 非价格排挤理论
3. 战略数据剥削理论
4. 异质性竞争效应理论
AI.method:
开发两个理论模型：
1. 捆绑销售模型：分析两个相邻双边市场中，平台如何利用用户重叠创造结构性分销优势
2. 战略数据剥削模型：分析集成平台在提升自身竞争力与从竞争对手获取广告收入之间的权衡，以及如何提高竞争对手的有效广告成本
AI.findings:
1. 捆绑销售：仅凭重叠用户中的覆盖不对称，捆绑销售就可能有利可图并导致排挤效应
2. 数据剥削：数据剥削会提高竞争对手的有效广告成本，导致异质性竞争对手退出，从而强化集成平台的市场地位
3. 两种滥用行为相互强化，共同损害数字平台竞争
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为数字平台捆绑销售和数据剥削提供了理论形式化
2. 扩展了非价格排挤理论文献
3. 发展了战略数据剥削导致异质性损害的理论框架
4. 为研究数字平台竞争提供了可推广的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为欧盟委员会对Meta的裁决提供了理论支持
2. 为反垄断执法机构分析数字平台滥用行为提供了分析工具
3. 为政策制定者理解数字平台竞争效应提供了理论依据
4. 为企业合规和竞争策略提供了参考

title: Chinese Patent in Google Patent Public Data: A Guide to Processing and Validation
affiliations: and Digital Economy Lab, BIMSA

detail.title: Chinese Patent in Google Patent Public Data: A Guide to Processing and Validation
detail.abstract: This paper provides a validated, research-ready dataset of Chinese invention patents derived from Google Patent Public Data (GPPD). We develop a parallelized pipeline to transform 2.5T of nested JSON data into structured relational format, and systematically benchmark GPPD against official records from CNIPA. We find GPPD achieves 99.96% coverage of the official patent universe, with high field-level integrity for core metadata and examiner information. However, we identify a 23% missingness rate in IPC classifications and document limitations regarding entity disambiguation, machine translation quality, and reporting lags. We make publicly available the cleaned dataset, open-source processing scripts, and a GPPD-ADCP Master Key to facilitate transparent and reproducible research on Chinese innovation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提供了一个经过验证、可用于研究的中国发明专利数据集，源自Google专利公共数据(GPPD)。作者开发了并行化处理流程，将2.5T的嵌套JSON数据转换为结构化关系格式，并系统性地将GPPD与CNIPA官方记录进行基准测试。
AI.research_question: Google专利公共数据(GPPD)在覆盖中国发明专利方面的完整性和准确性如何？GPPD数据相对于中国国家知识产权局(CNIPA)官方记录的质量和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 缺乏高质量、易于访问的中国专利数据限制了创新研究的进展。虽然GPPD提供了大规模专利数据，但其对中国专利的覆盖范围、数据质量和可靠性尚未得到系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据质量评估框架、专利数据标准化理论、大数据处理技术、数据验证方法学
AI.method: 1) 开发并行化数据处理管道，将2.5T嵌套JSON数据转换为结构化关系格式；2) 系统性地将GPPD数据与CNIPA官方记录进行基准测试和比较；3) 评估数据覆盖范围、字段完整性和准确性
AI.findings: 1) GPPD覆盖了官方专利库的99.96%；2) 核心元数据和审查员信息具有较高的字段完整性；3) IPC分类存在23%的缺失率；4) 存在实体消歧、机器翻译质量和报告延迟等局限性
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了评估大规模专利数据质量的系统框架；2) 提供了GPPD对中国专利数据覆盖的量化分析；3) 识别了专利数据转换和标准化过程中的关键挑战
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 公开了清洗后的中国发明专利数据集；2) 提供了开源处理脚本；3) 创建了GPPD-ADCP主键以促进透明和可重复的研究；4) 为研究者提供了数据质量评估的具体指标和局限性说明

title: Building a Private Credit Index for Alternative Lending Markets
affiliations: , Cornell University - Cornell Tech NYC, Cornell University, Cornell University, Cornell University and Cornell University

detail.title: Building a Private Credit Index for Alternative Lending Markets
detail.abstract:
Private credit has grown into one of the fastest-expanding segments of alternative finance, surpassing $1.5 trillion in AUM and serving as a critical source of capital for middle-market firms. Unlike public debt markets, private credit operates with limited transparency, infrequent valuations, and heterogeneous disclosure standards, making systematic performance measurement difficult. Investors, regulators, and asset managers lack a unified benchmark to evaluate risk, returns, and exposure across the private lending landscape. The absence of standardized performance data remains a central barrier to effective monitoring and market-wide comparability.

Business Development Companies (BDCs) offer a unique opportunity to address this opacity. As publicly regulated vehicles under the Investment Company Act of 1940, BDCs disclose loan-level information—including fair value, cost, coupon structures, PIK/PIC features, industry classifications, and maturity profiles - through quarterly 10-Q and annual 10-K filings. These disclosures provide rare transparency into the private credit ecosystem, enabling empirical measurement of risk and performance dynamics across thousands of underlying loans.

This project leverages that regulatory transparency. Between 2023Q1 and 2025Q2, the team extracted over 5,400 filings (approximately 5GB of raw data) and processed more than 300,000 investment records, including a substantial subset of iXBRL filings that offer machine-readable financial tagging. The availability of iXBRL significantly improved data consistency and reduced noise, forming the foundation for benchmarking private credit performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用商业发展公司（BDCs）的监管披露数据，构建了首个系统性的私募信贷基准，解决了该市场因透明度不足而难以进行绩效衡量的核心问题。
AI.research_question: 如何利用商业发展公司（BDCs）的监管披露数据，为缺乏透明度的私募信贷市场构建系统性的绩效衡量基准？
AI.motivation: 私募信贷已成为增长最快的另类金融领域之一（AUM超过1.5万亿美元），但市场缺乏透明度、估值不频繁、披露标准不统一，导致投资者、监管机构和资产管理人难以进行系统性绩效衡量和市场比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和市场效率理论，研究利用监管强制披露机制（1940年投资公司法）来克服私募信贷市场的信息不透明问题，通过公开监管工具（BDCs）的贷款级数据来构建市场基准。
AI.method: 研究团队在2023年第一季度至2025年第二季度期间，提取了超过5,400份监管文件（约5GB原始数据），处理了超过300,000条投资记录，特别利用了iXBRL格式的机器可读财务标签来提高数据一致性和减少噪音。
AI.findings: BDCs的季度10-Q和年度10-K文件提供了贷款层面的详细信息（公允价值、成本、息票结构、PIK/PIC特征、行业分类、到期概况等），为私募信贷生态系统提供了罕见的透明度，使数千笔基础贷款的风险和绩效动态能够进行实证测量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为私募信贷市场的信息不对称问题提供了实证解决方案；2）展示了监管披露如何能够被创新性地用于构建另类资产类别的市场基准；3）扩展了市场效率理论在非公开交易资产中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资者、监管机构和资产管理人提供了首个统一的私募信贷绩效基准；2）提高了私募信贷市场的透明度和可比性；3）为风险管理和投资决策提供了数据支持；4）展示了iXBRL等结构化数据格式在金融分析中的价值。

title: Selective Europeanization in Turkish Merger Control
affiliations: European University Institute - Department of Law (LAW)

detail.title: Selective Europeanization in Turkish Merger Control
detail.abstract: Modern competition policy is enforced by national authorities facing parallel jurisdiction and overlapping analytical challenges. This raises a basic question: how do competition authorities learn from each other, considering that convergence obligations are soft and non-binding? This paper examines that question in the context of merger control, using the EU-Turkey relationship as an empirical setting in which alignment pressures exist but enforcement autonomy is preserved. Drawing on a hand-coded dataset of all Turkish merger decisions between 1995 and 2025 that cite the European Commission, the paper moves beyond counting citations and instead analyses their substantive depth. Citations are classified as formal, interpretive, or operative depending on the extent to which Commission practice structures enforcement reasoning. Using regression analysis, the paper explores the institutional and case-level factors associated with deeper engagement. The results reveal a pattern of selective learning rather than linear convergence. Citation depth is significantly higher when the Turkish Competition Authority (TCA) relies on Commission decisions as analytical precedents rather than merely acknowledging parallel proceedings, and when citations relate to core analytical stages such as market definition and competitive assessment. Deeper engagement correlates with industries that the TCA itself classifies as technologically complex, but not with industries deemed high-tech under EU classifications. Time trends, leadership, and divergence from Commission practice do not systematically explain citation depth. These findings suggest that enforcement learning operates through problem-driven analytical borrowing rather than mechanical emulation. They also highlight the limits of formal alignment as a proxy for convergence in global competition policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析土耳其竞争管理局在1995-2025年间引用欧盟委员会的所有合并决定，发现竞争执法机构的学习模式是选择性、问题驱动的分析借鉴，而非机械模仿或线性趋同。
AI.research_question: 在趋同义务软性且无约束力的情况下，竞争执法机构如何相互学习？特别是在合并控制领域，土耳其竞争管理局如何引用欧盟委员会的决定？
AI.motivation: 现代竞争政策由面临平行管辖和重叠分析挑战的国家机构执行，但趋同义务是软性且无约束力的，需要理解竞争机构如何在实际中相互学习。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争政策趋同理论、执法学习理论、机构间知识转移理论、选择性借鉴与机械模仿的区别。
AI.method: 手工编码1995-2025年间土耳其所有引用欧盟委员会的合并决定数据集，将引用分类为形式性、解释性或操作性，使用回归分析探讨与深度引用相关的制度和案件层面因素。
AI.findings: 土耳其竞争管理局表现出选择性学习模式而非线性趋同。引用深度在以下情况显著更高：1) 将欧盟决定作为分析先例而非仅承认平行程序；2) 引用涉及市场定义和竞争评估等核心分析阶段；3) 涉及土耳其自认为技术复杂的行业（而非欧盟定义的高科技行业）。时间趋势、领导层变动和与欧盟实践的差异对引用深度无系统性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出执法学习通过问题驱动的分析借鉴而非机械模仿运作；2) 挑战形式趋同作为全球竞争政策趋同代理指标的有效性；3) 深化对竞争机构间知识转移机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为竞争机构提供关于如何有效借鉴他国经验的实际指导；2) 帮助政策制定者理解趋同的实际限制；3) 为欧盟-土耳其关系中的竞争政策协调提供实证依据。

title: Partial Identification under Missing Data Using Weak Shadow Variables from Pretrained Models
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering and Emory University

detail.title: Partial Identification under Missing Data Using Weak Shadow Variables from Pretrained Models
detail.abstract: Estimating population quantities such as mean outcomes from user feedback is fundamental to platform evaluation and social science, yet feedback is often missing not at random (MNAR): users with stronger opinions are more likely to respond, so standard estimators are biased and the estimand is not identified without additional assumptions. Existing approaches typically rely on strong parametric assumptions or bespoke auxiliary variables that may be unavailable in practice. In this paper, we develop a partial identification framework in which sharp bounds on the estimand are obtained by solving a pair of linear programs whose constraints encode the observed data structure. This formulation naturally incorporates outcome predictions from pretrained models, including large language models (LLMs), as additional linear constraints that tighten the feasible set. We call these predictions weak shadow variables: they satisfy a conditional independence assumption with respect to missingness but need not meet the completeness conditions required by classical shadow-variable methods. When predictions are sufficiently informative, the bounds collapse to a point, recovering standard identification as a special case. In finite samples, to provide valid coverage of the identified set, we propose a set-expansion estimator that achieves slower-than-√ n convergence rate in the set-identified regime and the standard √ n rate under point identification. In simulations and semisynthetic experiments on customer-service dialogues, we find that LLM predictions are often ill-conditioned for classical shadow-variable methods yet remain highly effective in our framework. They shrink identification intervals by 75-83% while maintaining valid coverage under realistic MNAR mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种部分识别框架，通过线性规划获得估计量的尖锐边界，利用预训练模型（如LLM）的预测作为弱影子变量约束来缩小可行集，在MNAR数据下提供有效覆盖。
AI.research_question: 如何在缺失非随机（MNAR）数据下，利用预训练模型预测作为弱影子变量来获得人口统计量的部分识别边界？
AI.motivation: 平台评估和社会科学研究中，用户反馈经常存在缺失非随机问题，传统估计器会产生偏差且需要强参数假设或特殊辅助变量，实际应用中这些条件往往难以满足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分识别理论、影子变量方法、线性规划优化、弱影子变量概念（满足条件独立性但不需要完备性条件）。
AI.method: 通过线性规划对偶问题获得尖锐边界，将预训练模型预测作为线性约束纳入框架，提出集合扩展估计器处理有限样本下的有效覆盖问题。
AI.findings: LLM预测虽然不满足经典影子变量方法的完备性条件，但在本框架中仍高度有效，能将识别区间缩小75-83%，同时在现实MNAR机制下保持有效覆盖。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出弱影子变量概念；2) 建立部分识别线性规划框架；3) 开发集合扩展估计器，在部分识别和点识别下分别达到次√n和√n收敛率。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供无需强参数假设的实用方法；2) 有效利用LLM等预训练模型预测；3) 在客户服务对话等实际场景中验证有效性。

title: The Core Value of Public Policy Should be Equality
affiliations: University of Utah - College of Social & Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics, University of Utah - College of Social & Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics and University of Houston Law Center

detail.title: The Core Value of Public Policy Should be Equality
detail.abstract: Research in biology and anthropology shows that humans evolved in largely egalitarian small groups; occasional selfishness was punished. Aversion to inequality is thus an inherited human characteristic. In unequal societies, humans experience stress, leading to many social pathologies, as shown by extensive literature in epidemiology. Well-being can be increased by reducing inequality, independent of increases in GDP. This is obscured by current economic theories, which use unrealistic assumptions and an empirically completely unsupported "equity-efficiency tradeoff" to justify ignoring distribution. Finally, we show that public policy can have an enormous impact on income inequality and has done so in the past.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文认为人类天生厌恶不平等，不平等会导致社会病理问题，减少不平等能提升福祉，而当前经济理论错误地使用"公平效率权衡"来忽视分配问题，公共政策对收入不平等有巨大影响。
AI.research_question: 如何理解不平等对人类福祉的影响？公共政策在减少收入不平等方面能发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 当前经济理论使用不现实的假设和缺乏实证支持的"公平效率权衡"来为忽视收入分配问题辩护，这掩盖了不平等对社会福祉的负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 进化生物学和人类学视角：人类在平等的小群体中进化，厌恶不平等是遗传特征；2) 流行病学视角：不平等导致压力和社会病理问题；3) 对主流经济理论的批判：特别是对"公平效率权衡"假设的质疑。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，综合生物学、人类学、流行病学和经济学的跨学科证据。
AI.findings: 1) 人类天生厌恶不平等；2) 不平等社会导致压力和社会病理问题；3) 减少不平等能提升福祉，与GDP增长无关；4) 公共政策对收入不平等有巨大历史影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战主流经济学的"公平效率权衡"假设，提出基于进化生物学和流行病学的跨学科不平等理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理论依据，支持通过公共政策减少收入不平等来提升社会福祉，而不必担心损害经济效率。

title: Concentration of AI Power
affiliations: University of Nebraska College of Law

detail.title: Concentration of AI Power
detail.abstract: This article makes a simple argument. AI is coming, and it is dangerous. To prevent that danger many well-meaning people are proposing regulations. Most of these regulations would make things worse because they would concentrate AI's power in the hands of fewer individuals, either in government or corporations. Bans and moratoriums created the greatest risks for concentration of power, but other regulations increase the risks of oligarchal control. Concentrated power over advanced AI would empower those with access to AI to restrict the civil liberties or quality of life of those without AI. The unique features of AI would make these imbalances durable. Regulations should be weighed on how they concentrate power.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为AI具有危险性，但大多数监管提案反而会加剧风险，因为它们会将AI权力集中在少数政府或企业手中，导致权力失衡和公民自由受限。
AI.research_question: AI监管政策如何影响权力分配？哪些监管措施会加剧AI权力的集中化？
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展带来潜在危险，许多善意人士提出监管方案，但作者担心这些监管措施可能适得其反，导致AI权力过度集中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力集中理论、监管经济学、技术治理理论、AI伦理框架
AI.method: 概念分析和逻辑论证，通过理论推理评估不同监管措施对权力分配的影响
AI.findings: 禁令和暂停令会造成最大的权力集中风险，其他监管措施也会增加寡头控制的可能性。权力集中会使掌握AI的人限制未掌握AI者的公民自由和生活质量，且AI的独特特性会使这种不平衡持久化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI监管的权力集中分析框架，强调监管评估应关注权力分配效应而非单纯风险控制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供监管评估标准：应优先考虑那些不会导致AI权力过度集中的监管方案，避免禁令等极端措施

title: Beyond the Digital Fortress: Europe's Quest for Open Strategic Autonomy

detail.title: Beyond the Digital Fortress: Europe's Quest for Open Strategic Autonomy
detail.abstract: Europe's digital policy is pulled between two intuitions. The first is Hobbesian: security requires control of the infrastructure and data on which modern life depends. The second is Kantian: cybersecurity is an ecosystem problem, and durable security comes from rules, reciprocity, and cross-border cooperation. The European Union (EU) faces a sovereignty-security paradox: autonomy reduces coercive dependencies, yet cyber defence works best when information, standards, and response capacity circulate beyond borders. This work argues for, and operationalises, open strategic autonomy as a design discipline rather than a slogan. Europe should define a limited "sovereign core" (functions that must remain operable under EU control during a crisis) and, outside that core, deliberately engineer interdependence to maximise resilience. The goal is not digital autarky, but the ability to choose dependencies: which to accept, which to mitigate, and which to refuse.

AI.tldr: 欧盟面临主权-安全悖论：自主性减少胁迫依赖，但网络安全最佳实践需要跨境信息共享与合作。本文提出"开放战略自主"作为设计原则，主张定义有限的"主权核心"功能，并在核心外刻意构建相互依赖以最大化韧性。
AI.research_question: 欧盟如何在数字政策中平衡霍布斯式的主权控制需求与康德式的跨境合作需求，以解决主权-安全悖论？
AI.motivation: 欧洲数字政策面临两种直觉的拉扯：霍布斯式（安全需要控制基础设施和数据）vs康德式（网络安全是生态系统问题，需要规则、互惠和跨境合作）。欧盟面临主权-安全悖论：自主性减少胁迫依赖，但网络防御在信息、标准和响应能力跨境流通时效果最佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 霍布斯式安全观（主权控制）vs康德式安全观（合作生态系统）；主权-安全悖论；开放战略自主理论；战略相互依赖理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，提出"开放战略自主"作为设计原则，并操作化实施方法，包括定义"主权核心"和刻意构建相互依赖。
AI.findings: 欧盟不应追求数字自给自足，而应采用"开放战略自主"原则：定义有限的"主权核心"功能（危机期间必须在欧盟控制下保持运行），在核心外刻意构建相互依赖以最大化韧性。目标是能够选择依赖关系：接受哪些、缓解哪些、拒绝哪些。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"开放战略自主"从口号发展为设计原则；提出主权-安全悖论的概念框架；为数字政策中的主权与合作平衡提供理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟数字政策制定者提供具体实施框架：如何定义"主权核心"功能，如何在核心外构建战略相互依赖，如何实现依赖关系的有意识选择而非被动接受。

title: What is an Enduring Impact Organization?
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: What is an Enduring Impact Organization?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This article introduces and describes a new concept of organizational management, enduring impact organizations, which are organizations dedicated to fulfilling unmet social needs through the identification and deployment of innovative and entrepreneurial solutions and operating through ethical governance and responsible management, intentionally designed from inception to preserve mission fidelity and institutional capacity so that their contribution to stakeholders endures through decades of inevitable political, financial, market and cultural volatility. They treat endurance as a design objective. Governance architecture, financial systems, leadership continuity and organizational culture are deliberately engineered from inception to withstand instability, manage dependency risk by diversifying resources and prevent strategic drift. Their defining characteristic is not simply the persistence of outcomes, but the organizational durability required to continue delivering meaningful impact across generations. Impact may be achieved. Endurance must be built.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"持久影响组织"新概念，指那些致力于通过创新方案解决未满足社会需求、从创立之初就设计为能够承受数十年政治、金融、市场和文化波动、保持使命忠诚度和机构能力的组织。
AI.research_question: 什么是持久影响组织？如何设计和构建能够跨越数十年波动、持续产生社会影响的组织？
AI.motivation: 许多组织在面临政治、金融、市场和文化波动时难以维持其社会使命，需要新的组织管理概念来确保社会影响的持久性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 持久影响组织理论、组织耐久性理论、使命忠诚度理论、组织设计理论、治理架构理论
AI.method: 概念性分析、理论构建、组织设计原则阐述
AI.findings: 持久影响组织具有四个关键设计要素：治理架构、财务系统、领导连续性和组织文化，这些要素需要从组织创立之初就精心设计以抵御不稳定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"持久影响组织"这一新概念，扩展了组织理论，强调耐久性作为设计目标而非偶然结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计者提供了构建能够跨越世代、持续产生社会影响的组织的具体指导原则和设计框架。

title: Reliable Empirical Accounting Research in the Age of Generative AI
affiliations: , University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business and VU University Amsterdam

detail.title: Reliable Empirical Accounting Research in the Age of Generative AI
detail.abstract: Despite the swift advancements in LLM-enhanced abilities, general generative AI models still hallucinate and cannot reliably distinguish theoretically plausible from implausible foundations. To determine whether domain-specific generative AI can consistently improve academic research in empirical accounting, we construct a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) system based on an extensive corpus of accounting, finance, and economics papers and code. Compared with standalone commercial LLMs, the system nearly eliminates hallucinations, retrieves more relevant prior literature, and produces faster and more reliable replications. Our findings suggest that a domainspecific knowledge base enhances the reliability of AI agents in conducting empirical accounting research, opening a path forward by automating transparent and theoretically grounded analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于会计、金融、经济学论文和代码的检索增强生成(RAG)系统，相比独立商业LLM，该系统几乎消除了幻觉，检索到更相关的先前文献，并产生更快、更可靠的复制结果。
AI.research_question: 领域特定的生成式AI能否持续改进会计实证研究？
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM能力快速进步，但通用生成式AI模型仍存在幻觉问题，无法可靠区分理论上合理与不合理的基础。需要探索领域特定的AI系统是否能提高学术研究的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成(RAG)框架，结合领域特定知识库，提高AI在专业领域的可靠性和准确性。
AI.method: 构建基于会计、金融、经济学论文和代码的RAG系统，与独立商业LLM进行对比实验。
AI.findings: 相比独立商业LLM，RAG系统几乎消除了幻觉，检索到更相关的先前文献，产生更快、更可靠的复制结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了领域特定知识库能显著提高AI在专业学术研究中的可靠性，为AI辅助学术研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可用于会计实证研究的AI工具，能够自动化透明且理论基础扎实的分析，提高研究效率和可靠性。

title: Strategic Adoption of Digital Traceability in Supply Chains
affiliations: , Simon Fraser University, Columbia University - Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research and Columbia University - Department of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research (IEOR)

detail.title: Strategic Adoption of Digital Traceability in Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Digital tracing technologies, such as tokenization, allow supply chains to shift from inefficient batch recalls to precise unit-level tracking. While these technologies improve operational efficiency by reducing disruption costs, their adoption in competitive supply chains creates a strategic tension: improved traceability makes suppliers more reliable but also more similar in their risk profiles, which intensifies price competition and reduces profit margins. We develop a game-theoretic model of a three-tier supply chain where competing suppliers choose between batch and tokenized recall technologies, and characterize the equilibrium adoption strategies via two sufficient statistics: i) the surplus asymmetry, and ii) risk heterogeneity. We show that the tension between operational efficiency and competitive intensity can prevent adoption of tokenization as a recall technology. Surprisingly, for certain parameter regimes, tokenization can induce monopolization by eliminating the hedging value of dual sourcing. In high-volatility environments, tokenization can restore competition by reducing tail risk sufficiently to make diversification viable.

AI.tldr: 数字追踪技术（如代币化）使供应链能从低效的批量召回转向精确的单位级追踪。虽然这些技术通过降低中断成本提高了运营效率，但在竞争性供应链中的采用会产生战略紧张：改进的可追溯性使供应商更可靠，但也使他们的风险状况更相似，从而加剧价格竞争并降低利润率。
AI.research_question: 在竞争性供应链中，数字追踪技术（如代币化）的采用如何影响供应商的战略决策和市场竞争结构？
AI.motivation: 数字追踪技术能提高供应链运营效率，但在竞争环境中可能产生意想不到的战略后果，需要研究其采用如何影响供应商的竞争策略和市场结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析三层次供应链中竞争供应商在批量召回和代币化召回技术之间的选择决策。
AI.method: 开发博弈论模型，通过两个充分统计量（盈余不对称性和风险异质性）来表征均衡采用策略。
AI.findings: 1. 运营效率与竞争强度之间的紧张关系可能阻碍代币化作为召回技术的采用；2. 在某些参数范围内，代币化可能通过消除双重采购的对冲价值而导致垄断；3. 在高波动性环境中，代币化可以通过充分降低尾部风险来恢复竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了数字追踪技术采用与市场竞争结构之间的理论联系；2. 识别了阻碍技术采用的关键战略紧张关系；3. 揭示了技术采用可能产生的非预期垄断效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为供应链管理者提供技术采用决策的框架；2. 帮助政策制定者理解数字追踪技术对市场竞争的影响；3. 为企业在高波动性环境中采用追踪技术提供指导。

title: Career Choices, Timing of Childbirth, and Perceptions of Fecundity

detail.title: Career Choices, Timing of Childbirth, and Perceptions of Fecundity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest

detail.abstract: How does the perception of age-dependent ability to bear children, which may not align with the medical data, affect the optimal reproductive decisions of households and career development of women? We build a life cycle model that endogenizes decisions of marriage and childbirth, as well as women's career choices, and quantify how the awareness of fecundity affects these decisions. Our findings reveal that aligning optimistic beliefs in fecundity with medical data encourages households to opt for childbirth at younger ages, when fecundity is higher. This shift results in more women making earlier decisions about marriage and childbirth, subsequently altering their employment choices from regular to contingent jobs or opting out of the workforce altogether. Additionally, we incorporate decisions about infertility treatments and study how the government subsidy affects the take-up rates and decisions of households.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了人们对生育能力的认知（可能与医学数据不符）如何影响家庭的最优生育决策和女性的职业发展。通过构建生命周期模型，发现将乐观的生育能力认知与医学数据对齐会促使家庭在更年轻时生育，这导致更多女性选择从正规工作转向临时工作或退出劳动力市场。
AI.research_question: 人们对生育能力的认知（可能与医学数据不符）如何影响家庭的最优生育决策和女性的职业发展？
AI.motivation: 现实中人们对生育能力的认知往往与医学数据存在偏差，这种认知偏差可能影响家庭的生育时机决策和女性的职业选择，需要系统研究这种影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期理论，内生决策模型（婚姻、生育、职业选择），生育能力认知偏差理论
AI.method: 构建内生化的生命周期模型，量化分析生育能力认知对决策的影响，并纳入不孕治疗决策和政府补贴政策分析
AI.findings: 1. 将乐观的生育能力认知与医学数据对齐会鼓励家庭在更年轻时生育；2. 这导致更多女性更早做出婚姻和生育决策；3. 职业选择从正规工作转向临时工作或退出劳动力市场；4. 政府补贴影响不孕治疗的采纳率和家庭决策
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将生育能力认知偏差纳入生命周期决策模型；2. 建立了生育认知、家庭决策和女性职业发展的理论联系；3. 扩展了内生决策模型的应用范围
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改善生育认知的教育依据；2. 帮助企业理解女性职业选择的变化；3. 为不孕治疗补贴政策提供量化分析支持

title: Strategy and Structured Management
affiliations: University of Toronto - Strategic Management, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Leeds School of Business, University of Colorado, Boulder

detail.title: Strategy and Structured Management
detail.abstract: We explore the alignment between irreversible strategic commitments and more-malleable management practices—providing rare large-scale evidence of the costs and drivers of misalignment. Leveraging a unique data set designed for this question, we capture irreversible investments in process strategy for over 30,000 manufacturing establishments in the U.S. We distinguish among process designs that strike distinct trade-offs between production efficiency and flexibility. Built into a given facility at founding, these are quasi-fixed and argued to arise from the firm’s product market strategy. We further observe details of the facility's reliance on structured management and can estimate dimensions of misalignment between production strategy and its  management practices. We find that the extent of structured management varies systematically with process strategy across the sector. Yet misalignment is associated with significantly lower productivity. Exploring potential sources of misalignment, we find evidence that both unionization and peer effects (of nearby and similarly-positioned plants) can cause firms to adopt management practices that are not optimal in light of prior strategic commitments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可逆战略承诺与可变管理实践之间的匹配问题，发现错配会导致显著的生产率下降，并识别了工会化和同伴效应作为错配的潜在来源。
AI.research_question: 不可逆的战略承诺（生产流程设计）与更易调整的管理实践之间的匹配如何影响企业绩效？哪些因素会导致这种匹配错配？
AI.motivation: 企业面临战略承诺（如生产流程设计）与管理实践之间的匹配挑战，但缺乏大规模实证证据来理解错配的成本和驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略匹配理论、资源基础观、组织设计理论，强调战略承诺与管理实践的一致性对绩效的重要性。
AI.method: 利用美国30,000多家制造工厂的独特数据集，量化不可逆的生产流程投资（在效率与灵活性之间的权衡），并测量结构化管理的程度，估计战略与管理之间的错配维度。
AI.findings: 1) 结构化管理的程度在不同生产策略间存在系统性差异；2) 战略与管理错配与显著更低的生产率相关；3) 工会化和同伴效应（邻近及类似工厂的影响）会导致企业采用非最优的管理实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供大规模实证证据，量化战略承诺与管理实践错配的成本；识别工会化和同伴效应作为组织设计错配的新驱动因素；深化对战略执行中匹配机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业识别和纠正战略与管理错配；提醒管理者注意工会化和同伴效应对管理决策的潜在扭曲影响；为组织设计提供实证指导。

title: Institutional Legitimacy as a Heuristic for Following Digital Financial Advice: Evidence from a Preregistered Two-Module Experiment
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Department of Management

detail.title: Institutional Legitimacy as a Heuristic for Following Digital Financial Advice: Evidence from a Preregistered Two-Module Experiment

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study received ethics review by the Sottocommissione Etica per la Ricerca (SER) at Ca’ Foscari University of Venice (reference 92374; decision: approved with reservations).
declarations.funderStatement: Funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU. This project is funded by the European Union’s NextGenerationEU plan under the Italian Ministry of Universities and Research (MUR) “Young Researchers – Seal of Excellence” grant (Project SOE_0000193; CUP H73C22001440001). Funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU. Views and opinions expressed are however those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Commission. Neither the European Union nor the European Commission can be held responsible for them.

detail.abstract: We study how institutional identity cues, transparency disclaimers, and access rules to human support shape adherence to standardized digital financial advice. In a preregistered experiment with an interactive portfolio task (N = 403 in the pre-final analysis sample), we randomize advisor identity (bank vs independent) and disclaimer presence, and independently randomize a policy describing equal versus wealth-gated access to human support. Primary outcomes measure divergence from the recommendation (L1 and Euclidean distances) and exact adherence. We report confirmatory tests with Holm correction for the identity effect across divergence measures, and assess distributional robustness via hurdle and Tobit models. The access-policy manipulation strongly affects perceived fairness/legitimacy/inclusion (FALI), while identity effects on divergence are small and statistically indistinguishable from zero in the pre-final dataset. Results shown are simulated placeholders for workflow/testing only.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验检验了机构身份线索、透明度声明和人工支持访问规则如何影响用户对标准化数字金融建议的遵从度。研究发现，人工支持访问政策对公平性/合法性/包容性感知有显著影响，而机构身份对建议遵从度的影响很小且统计上不显著。
AI.research_question: 机构身份线索（银行vs独立顾问）、透明度声明以及人工支持访问规则（平等访问vs财富门槛访问）如何影响用户对标准化数字金融建议的遵从度？
AI.motivation: 随着数字金融建议的普及，了解影响用户接受和遵从这些建议的因素变得重要。特别是机构身份、透明度声明和人工支持访问政策可能影响用户对建议的信任和遵从行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论、信任理论和行为金融学，研究机构身份线索对用户信任的影响，以及公平性、合法性、包容性（FALI）在金融建议采纳中的作用。
AI.method: 采用预注册实验设计，403名参与者完成交互式投资组合任务。随机分配三个因素：顾问身份（银行vs独立）、透明度声明存在与否、人工支持访问政策（平等vs财富门槛）。主要测量指标为与建议的偏离度（L1和欧几里得距离）和完全遵从率。
AI.findings: 人工支持访问政策对公平性/合法性/包容性（FALI）感知有强烈影响。机构身份对建议偏离度的影响很小，在预最终数据集中统计上不显著。结果显示了模拟占位符用于工作流程测试。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对数字金融建议采纳中制度身份线索作用的理解，表明在标准化建议情境下，机构身份的影响可能有限，而访问政策对公平性感知的影响更为重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司和监管机构提供设计数字金融建议平台的参考：应更关注人工支持访问政策的公平性设计，而非过度依赖机构身份来建立信任。

title: Sovereign Foresight Without Control: A Governance-Safe Decision-Intelligence Layer for Long-Term Stability in Mature National Healthcare Systems (UAE as a Reference Case)
affiliations: Hoopoe Holding Ltd.

detail.title: Sovereign Foresight Without Control: A Governance-Safe Decision-Intelligence Layer for Long-Term Stability in Mature National Healthcare Systems (UAE as a Reference Case)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the content of this study. The analysis is based on internal professional experience within the healthcare sector and does not involve external sponsorship, commercial promotion, or third-party influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical interventions, or identifiable information. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was not funded by any external organization. It was developed independently based on internal professional experience and prior work within the healthcare and wellbeing sector.

detail.abstract:
Mature national healthcare systems rarely fail through sudden collapse. They erode through slow, distributed pressure: incremental cost drift, normalized workforce strain, scheduling inefficiency, and repeated utilization that does not reliably translate into improved outcomes. These pressures often remain invisible to conventional governance instruments because financial reports, clinical statistics, and operational KPIs observe the system in discrete slices rather than as a connected trajectory.

This paper reframes long-term health system stability as a visibility and decision-intelligence problem, not a capability or technology deficit. Building on resilience thinking, learning health system theory, and high-reliability principles, it introduces a governance-safe National Health Decision-Intelligence Layer: a neutral, non-intrusive capability designed to observe aggregated, non-identifiable signals and translate emerging patterns into policy-legible trajectories and scenario awareness, without prescribing actions, interfering with clinical autonomy, or imposing operational control. This paper is conceptual and design-oriented; it does not report empirical data or propose implementation mandates.

Crucially, the proposed layer is bounded by explicit red lines: no patient identity, no clinical judgment, no workflow control, no mandates, no enforcement, and no automated policy triggers. Insights are optional and non-binding; sovereignty remains fully with the appropriate government authorities. Using the UAE’s rapidly expanding healthcare and wellbeing ecosystem as a reference case, the paper specifies the conceptual architecture, governance boundaries, and an execution philosophy that is bottom-up, voluntary, and reversible. The contribution is a unifying framework for sovereign foresight without control, enabling earlier awareness of structural drift while preserving institutional legitimacy and autonomy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种"国家健康决策智能层"的概念框架，旨在通过非侵入性、非身份识别的信号聚合来监测医疗系统的结构性漂移，提供政策可读的轨迹和情景意识，而不干预临床自主权或实施控制。
AI.research_question: 如何在不侵犯临床自主权或实施控制的前提下，提高成熟国家医疗系统的长期稳定性，使其能够早期识别和应对结构性漂移？
AI.motivation: 成熟的国家医疗系统很少突然崩溃，而是通过缓慢、分布式的压力逐渐侵蚀：增量成本漂移、正常化的劳动力压力、调度效率低下以及重复利用但未可靠转化为改善结果。这些压力对传统治理工具往往不可见，因为财务报告、临床统计和运营KPI以离散切片而非连接轨迹的方式观察系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于韧性思维、学习型医疗系统理论和高可靠性原则，将长期医疗系统稳定性重新定义为可见性和决策智能问题，而非能力或技术缺陷。
AI.method: 概念性和设计导向的方法，不报告实证数据或提出实施授权。以阿联酋快速扩张的医疗和福祉生态系统为参考案例，详细说明概念架构、治理边界和执行哲学。
AI.findings: 提出了一个治理安全的"国家健康决策智能层"概念框架，该框架是中立的、非侵入性的能力，旨在观察聚合的、非身份识别的信号，并将新兴模式转化为政策可读的轨迹和情景意识。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一框架，用于实现无控制的自主预见，使结构漂移的早期意识成为可能，同时保持制度合法性和自主性。将医疗系统稳定性重新定义为可见性和决策智能问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的治理边界（红线）：无患者身份、无临床判断、无工作流程控制、无授权、无强制执行、无自动化政策触发。洞察是可选的、无约束力的，主权完全属于适当的政府当局。执行哲学是自下而上、自愿和可逆的。

title: The Fiscal Ratchet: Asymmetric State Tax Adjustment Over the Business Cycle

detail.title: The Fiscal Ratchet: Asymmetric State Tax Adjustment Over the Business Cycle
detail.abstract: Recessions persistently ratchet up state tax rates. I develop a model in which a crisis premium raises desired public spending during recessions while loss aversion over spending cuts prevents full reversal during recovery. Exploiting state-specific variation in recession timing across 50 U.S. states from 1960 to 2022, I find that on the extensive margin, recessions raise the probability of a state tax increase by 7.7 percentage points while recoveries produce no compensating tax cuts, and a formal test rejects symmetric fiscal adjustment. On the intensive margin, income tax rates rise by 0.67 percentage points during recessions and remain 0.36 percentage points elevated through recovery. The ratchet is concentrated among mild recessions that generate fiscal pressure without triggering federal intergovernmental transfers. State spending also ratchets upward but reverts 74 percent over three years compared to 46 percent for tax rates, consistent with the model's prediction that the ratchet is strongest where reversal requires affirmative legislative action. Political conditions suppress offsetting tax cuts but do not drive increases.

AI.tldr: 研究发现经济衰退会永久性地提高州税率，形成"棘轮效应"：衰退期税率上升，但复苏期税率不会对称下降，导致税率持续高于衰退前水平。
AI.research_question: 经济衰退是否会导致州税率永久性上升（棘轮效应）？如果是，其机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解财政政策的非对称调整模式，特别是为什么衰退期税率上升后不会在复苏期对称下降，这对理解政府财政行为的持久影响很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于危机溢价理论（危机期间公共支出需求增加）和损失厌恶理论（削减支出面临政治阻力），构建了财政棘轮效应的理论模型。
AI.method: 利用1960-2022年美国50个州特有的衰退时间差异进行实证分析，采用双重差分等方法检验衰退和复苏期税率调整的非对称性。
AI.findings: 1. 衰退使州增税概率增加7.7个百分点，但复苏期没有补偿性减税；2. 所得税率在衰退期上升0.67个百分点，复苏期仍保持0.36个百分点的永久性上升；3. 棘轮效应主要集中在轻度衰退；4. 支出也会上升但74%在三年内恢复，而税率仅恢复46%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了财政棘轮效应的理论解释框架，结合危机溢价和损失厌恶理论，解释了为什么税率调整具有非对称性和持久性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于衰退期财政决策长期后果的警示，特别是税率上升可能成为永久性负担，影响长期经济增长。

title: Navigating Compliance in a Geopolitical Era: The Case of Chinese Multinationals in the United States
affiliations: University of California, Irvine School of Law

detail.title: Navigating Compliance in a Geopolitical Era: The Case of Chinese Multinationals in the United States
detail.abstract: This Article examines how Chinese multinational companies (MNCs) approach compliance in the United States amid deepening geopolitical rivalry and intensified regulatory scrutiny. Drawing on original survey data, this Article maps variations in compliance structures, staffing, and governance mechanisms across Chinese firms and identifies key determinants such as industry-specific regulatory intensity, listing status, and organizational imprinting from headquarters. The analysis employs a dual institutional framework to explain how compliance systems emerge from the interplay between host-state regulatory demands and home-state institutional legacies, producing hybrid structures that blend local adaptation with headquarters-driven replication. Findings reveal that while certain compliance features-such as committee formation-are shaped primarily by U.S. regulatory pressure-others, such as joint legal-compliance departments, reflect Chinese organizational templates. Divergence between home and host institutions leaves Chinese MNCs with persistent gaps in areas such as training, specialized risk controls, and regulator engagement. The study contributes to corporate compliance scholarship by extending analysis to a transnational business context; to the literature on law and geopolitics by showing how MNCs navigate the legal and regulatory dimensions of great power rivalry; and to Global China studies by revealing how Chinese businesses cope with complex institutional pressures in sophisticated foreign markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国跨国公司在美合规策略，发现其合规体系是东道国监管压力与母国制度遗产互动的产物，形成混合结构，但在培训、风险控制和监管沟通方面存在持续差距。
AI.research_question: 中国跨国公司在美国如何应对地缘政治竞争加剧和监管审查加强的合规挑战？其合规结构、人员配置和治理机制的变化模式及关键决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着中美地缘政治竞争加剧，中国跨国公司在美面临日益严格的监管审查，需要理解这些公司如何建立合规体系来应对复杂的制度压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用双重制度框架，解释合规体系如何从东道国监管需求与母国制度遗产的互动中产生，形成混合结构（本地适应与总部驱动复制的结合）。
AI.method: 基于原始调查数据，分析中国跨国公司合规结构、人员配置和治理机制的变化，识别行业监管强度、上市状态、总部组织印记等关键决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 某些合规特征（如委员会组建）主要由美国监管压力塑造；2. 其他特征（如法律合规联合部门）反映中国组织模板；3. 母国与东道国制度差异导致中国跨国公司在培训、专业风险控制和监管沟通方面存在持续差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将公司合规研究扩展到跨国商业环境；2. 为法律与地缘政治文献展示跨国公司如何应对大国竞争的法律监管维度；3. 为全球中国研究揭示中国企业如何在复杂外国市场应对制度压力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国跨国公司提供在美合规策略的实证参考，帮助理解混合合规结构的形成机制，识别合规差距领域，为政策制定者和企业管理者提供实践指导。

title: The Economic Effects of ESG Reporting -Theoretical Insights for Empirical Exploration

detail.title: The Economic Effects of ESG Reporting -Theoretical Insights for Empirical Exploration

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge the financial support from the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) [10.55776/P35265] and the University of Graz.

detail.abstract: The economic effects of sustainability reporting have recently become a widely studied topic in the accounting literature. With new regulations underway, this study gives an overview of the analytical accounting literature providing a theoretical foundation for empirical testing and discusses future research opportunities. We examine the underlying economic effects and consequences of investor preferences for sustainability, mandated ESG reporting, and agency conflicts. The models reviewed in this paper can help explain some of the conflicting results found in recent empirical studies. Theory suggests that ESG reporting mandates can increase ESG investment even with weak enforcement, which allows for greenwashing. Also, increased accuracy of ESG reports may not be always optimal, as it creates inefficiencies if investor preferences for ESG are less pronounced. Theoretical findings also highlight the importance of not setting emission reporting standards in isolation and taking into account the financial reporting environment.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了会计文献中关于可持续发展报告经济效应的理论模型，探讨了投资者偏好、强制ESG报告和代理冲突的影响，为实证研究提供理论基础并指出未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 可持续发展报告的经济效应是什么？强制ESG报告如何影响企业行为和市场效率？投资者对ESG的偏好如何影响报告质量和投资决策？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续发展报告新规的推进，会计文献中涌现大量关于其经济效应的研究，但实证结果存在矛盾。需要理论模型来解释这些矛盾并为未来研究提供方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学、代理理论和投资者偏好理论，分析ESG报告的经济效应，包括信号传递、监管影响和代理冲突等理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统回顾和分析会计领域关于可持续发展报告经济效应的理论模型和研究成果。
AI.findings: 1. ESG报告强制规定即使执行不力也能增加ESG投资，但可能导致"洗绿"行为；2. ESG报告准确性提高并非总是最优，当投资者ESG偏好较弱时可能造成效率损失；3. 排放报告标准不应孤立制定，需考虑财务报告环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为实证研究中的矛盾结果提供理论解释；2. 构建了理解ESG报告经济效应的理论框架；3. 揭示了强制报告、投资者偏好和代理冲突之间的相互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计ESG报告制度提供理论依据；2. 帮助企业理解ESG报告的经济后果；3. 为投资者评估ESG信息价值提供分析框架；4. 指导未来研究方向。

detail.abstract: The concept of sustainability has undergone various transformations since the 1970s, gradually becoming an essential pillar of global and business development. Its earliest meanings limited sustainability to the boundaries of modern economic growth in the face of the evident scarcity of available resources. The MIT report proposed a study on the imminent dangers of accelerating unrestricted economic growth, as well as the potential devastating effects on the planet’s resources, outlining in a way that was unprecedented at the time, a solid foundation for future discussions about the intrinsic interconnection between economic development and the need to conserve the planet (Meadows et al, 1072). Hence, the objective of this chapter is to argue for corporate sustainability as the basis for deciphering the code of the new standard in decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张将企业可持续性作为新决策标准的基础，探讨可持续发展概念从1970年代以来的演变及其对企业决策的重要性。
AI.research_question: 企业可持续性如何成为新决策标准的基础？
AI.motivation: 可持续发展概念自1970年代以来经历了各种转变，逐渐成为全球和企业发展的基本支柱。MIT报告首次系统阐述了无限制经济增长对地球资源的潜在破坏性影响，为理解经济发展与资源保护之间的内在联系奠定了基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、企业社会责任理论、决策理论、资源稀缺性理论
AI.method: 文献综述、理论分析、历史演变分析
AI.findings: 可持续发展概念已从最初局限于现代经济增长边界的理解，演变为全球和企业发展的核心支柱。企业可持续性应成为决策的新标准，以应对资源稀缺和环境挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业可持续性作为决策理论基础的新框架，深化了对经济发展与资源保护内在联系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了将可持续性纳入决策过程的实践指导，帮助企业应对资源约束和环境挑战，实现长期可持续发展。

title: Legal Constructions of Gender Identity and Sexual Orientation in African Countries and their Implications on the Best Interests of the African Child
affiliations: Central European University (CEU)

detail.title: Legal Constructions of Gender Identity and Sexual Orientation in African Countries and their Implications on the Best Interests of the African Child

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Conversion therapy includes a range of variety of practices intended to change an individual's gender identity or sexual orientation to align with heteronormative standards. Cultural traditions, religious doctrines, and legal structures deeply influence the construction of gender and sexual orientation in African societies. These overlapping influences shape how masculinity and femininity are understood and enforced, with severe consequences for children who do not conform to rigid gender norms. This chapter explores how these legal and social constructs impact the well-being of African children, particularly in their best interests as outlined in national, regional, and international human rights instruments. The first section of this paper employs a multidisciplinary lens to explore how customary laws, religious laws, and statutory laws interact to influence policies and societal attitudes toward gender and sexual diversity. The second section evaluates the extent to which these constructs either support or undermine the protection, dignity, and development of children, especially those who identify outside conventional gender and sexual binaries. This paper maps these influences across various African contexts and highlights the need for legal and policy frameworks that prioritize the best interests of the African child. It advocates for an inclusive, rights-based approach to gender and sexual orientation in African societies to ensure all children are afforded dignity, protection, and the opportunity to thrive.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨非洲社会中法律与社会建构如何影响儿童的福祉，特别是针对性别认同和性取向不符合传统规范的儿童。文章分析习惯法、宗教法和成文法如何相互作用影响对性别多样性的态度，并评估这些建构对儿童保护、尊严和发展的影响。
AI.research_question: 非洲社会中法律和社会建构如何影响不符合传统性别规范的儿童的福祉？这些建构在多大程度上支持或破坏儿童的保护、尊严和发展？
AI.motivation: 转化治疗等实践试图改变个体的性别认同或性取向以符合异性恋规范，非洲社会的文化传统、宗教教义和法律结构深刻影响性别和性取向的建构，对不符合刚性性别规范的儿童造成严重后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多学科视角（法律、社会学、人权研究）；习惯法、宗教法和成文法的相互作用；儿童最佳利益原则；人权框架（国家、区域和国际层面）。
AI.method: 文献分析；法律文本分析；跨非洲不同背景的比较分析；多学科视角下的建构分析。
AI.findings: 非洲社会的法律和社会建构对不符合传统性别规范的儿童福祉产生负面影响；这些建构常常不支持儿童的保护、尊严和发展；需要以儿童最佳利益为中心的包容性法律和政策框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了非洲背景下法律与社会建构如何影响性别多样化儿童的理论分析框架；发展了多学科视角下理解习惯法、宗教法和成文法相互作用的分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定以儿童最佳利益为中心的包容性法律和政策框架提供建议；倡导基于权利的性别和性取向方法；为保护非洲所有儿童的尊严和发展提供实践指导。

title: Selective State Decomposition under Democratic Continuity: Executive Power, Deregulatory Acceleration, and Institutional Narrowing in Argentina (2023–2026)

detail.title: Selective State Decomposition under Democratic Continuity: Executive Power, Deregulatory Acceleration, and Institutional Narrowing in Argentina (2023–2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this work.
