title: The Biotech Valuation Puzzle: Why Pipeline Labels Predict Less than Pipeline Activity

detail.title: The Biotech Valuation Puzzle: Why Pipeline Labels Predict Less than Pipeline Activity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Arcline Research, a biotech decision intelligence platform. The research was conducted independently using publicly available data. No client relationships influenced the analysis or findings.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Standard risk-adjusted net present value frameworks predict that categorical pipeline characteristics — clinical development stage, therapeutic indication, and drug modality — should meaningfully differentiate biotech company valuations. Stage-specific success probabilities, indication-specific market sizes, and modality-specific development costs all enter valuation models as first-order parameters. I test this prediction using 4,117 biotech financing transactions spanning 2008 to 2026, sourced from SEC EDGAR filings and cross-referenced with ClinicalTrials.gov for independent clinical taxonomy assignment. The categorical labels collectively explain less than 5% of pre-money valuation variance beyond deal structure controls. However, continuous measures of the same underlying pipeline construct — the number of active clinical trials, the diversity of development phases represented, and maximum trial enrollment — explain substantially more, outperforming the categorical labels by a factor of 1.4 to 1.6 in partial R². On a matched sample of 1,630 transactions, pipeline activity measures achieve a cross-validated R² of 0.153, compared with 0.115 for the categorical labels. When both are included, the combined model reaches 0.172; activity contributes an incremental 0.057 beyond labels, while labels contribute only 0.019 beyond activity. The asymmetry is the puzzle: the pipeline predicts valuations, but its continuous dimensions carry substantially more information than its categorical classifications. A comprehensive screening of 65 candidate variables contextualizes these findings, revealing that calendar metadata — the day of the week a deal closes — achieves comparable explanatory power to therapeutic indication, a variable with direct theoretical relevance to drug economics. Twenty-five placebo variables confirm the methodology's specificity. These findings suggest that supplementing the comparable transaction framework's categorical filters with continuous pipeline activity measures, available at no cost from public clinical trial registries, could improve valuation precision.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在生物科技公司估值中，连续性的研发管线活动指标（如临床试验数量、阶段多样性、最大试验规模）比传统的分类标签（如临床阶段、治疗领域、药物类型）具有更强的解释力，能够显著提升估值精度。
AI.research_question: 在生物科技公司估值中，分类标签（临床阶段、治疗领域、药物类型）与连续性研发管线活动指标相比，哪个能更好地解释公司估值差异？
AI.motivation: 传统的风险调整净现值框架预测分类特征应显著影响生物科技公司估值，但这一预测缺乏实证检验。了解哪些管线特征真正影响估值对投资决策和估值模型改进至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险调整净现值（rNPV）框架，该框架将临床阶段成功率、治疗领域市场规模、药物类型开发成本作为估值的一阶参数。
AI.method: 使用2008-2026年间4,117个生物科技融资交易数据，来自SEC EDGAR文件并与ClinicalTrials.gov交叉验证。采用回归分析比较分类标签和连续活动指标对估值的解释力，并进行匹配样本分析和交叉验证。
AI.findings: 分类标签仅能解释不到5%的估值方差，而连续活动指标（临床试验数量、阶段多样性、最大试验规模）的解释力是分类标签的1.4-1.6倍。在匹配样本中，活动指标的交叉验证R²为0.153，分类标签为0.115。两者结合时，活动指标贡献了0.057的增量解释力，而分类标签仅贡献0.019。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统rNPV框架对分类特征的重视，提出了"连续性维度比分类标签更具信息价值"的估值理论新视角，为生物科技估值模型提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在可比交易估值框架中，用免费的公共临床试验注册数据中的连续活动指标补充传统分类筛选，可显著提升估值精度，为投资者和估值分析师提供实用工具。

title: From Black Box to Explainable Portfolio Optimization: Tracing Allocations to Views and Constraints
affiliations: BNP Paribas - BNP Paribas Asset Management, BNP Paribas Asset Management, BNP Paribas Asset Management and BNP Paribas Asset Management

detail.title: From Black Box to Explainable Portfolio Optimization: Tracing Allocations to Views and Constraints
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a comprehensive framework to make portfolio optimization fully transparent and explainable in the context of tactical asset allocation. The method breaks down the optimized multi-asset portfolio into a sum of intuitive sub-portfolios, each capturing a distinct driver of the final allocation. Specifically, the decomposition separates the contributions from: (i) a sub-portfolio that replicates the strategic allocation using the available funds, accounting for mismatches between the investable universe and the indices used for the strategic asset allocation; (ii) sub-portfolios with the tilts expressing the tactical allocation views; (iii) a sub-portfolio with tilts arising from expected fund alphas, net of fees; (iv) a set of sub-portfolios quantifying the impact of binding constraints; and (v) a funding sub-portfolio with the adjustment to ensure full investment. We introduce additional practical refinements to enhance the interpretability, robustness, and practical usability of the decomposition. These include a more intuitive normalization of the sub-portfolios and mechanisms for redistributing extreme constraint effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个使投资组合优化完全透明和可解释的框架，将优化的多资产组合分解为多个直观的子组合，每个子组合捕捉最终配置的不同驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 如何在战术资产配置背景下，使投资组合优化过程完全透明和可解释？
AI.motivation: 传统的投资组合优化通常是一个"黑箱"过程，投资经理难以理解优化结果背后的驱动因素，缺乏透明度和可解释性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合优化理论、战术资产配置理论、投资组合分解框架
AI.method: 将优化的多资产组合分解为五个直观的子组合：(i)复制战略配置的子组合；(ii)表达战术配置观点的子组合；(iii)反映基金超额收益的子组合；(iv)量化约束影响的子组合；(v)确保全额投资的资金调整子组合
AI.findings: 提出的分解框架能够清晰展示投资组合优化的各个驱动因素，增强了优化过程的透明度和可解释性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统性的投资组合分解理论框架，将复杂的优化过程转化为直观的组成部分，丰富了投资组合优化的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资经理提供了实用的工具，使他们能够理解优化结果背后的逻辑，增强决策信心，并改进投资组合管理流程。

title: Stagnant Income and Rising Vulnerability: An Assessment of Agricultural Households in the Period of Doubling Farmers' Income in India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Stagnant Income and Rising Vulnerability: An Assessment of Agricultural Households in the Period of Doubling Farmers' Income in India
detail.abstract: Vulnerability of agricultural households remains persistent, even after multiple policy initiatives in India. Using the Situation Assessment Survey of NSSO for the year 2012-13 and 2018-19, this paper sheds light on various forms of vulnerability faced by the agricultural households in India in the period of Doubling Farmers' Income initiative. Despite efforts, there is large scale prevalence of households with insufficient income to meet consumption expenditure, consequently increasing indebtedness. Moreover, the existing price policy, particularly concerning certain crops such as Minimum Support Price (MSP) falls short in alleviating vulnerability and thus warrants modification based on the recommendation of Swaminathan Committee.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用印度国家抽样调查办公室2012-13年和2018-19年的农业家庭状况评估调查数据，分析了在"农民收入翻倍"计划期间印度农业家庭面临的各种脆弱性形式，发现尽管有政策努力，但大量家庭仍存在收入不足以满足消费支出的问题，导致负债增加，现有价格政策特别是最低支持价格政策在缓解脆弱性方面效果有限。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业脆弱性理论，关注收入不足、消费支出、负债等维度，结合政策评估框架分析最低支持价格等政策效果。
AI.method: 使用印度国家抽样调查办公室（NSSO）2012-13年和2018-19年的农业家庭状况评估调查数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）大量农业家庭收入不足以满足消费支出；2）家庭负债增加；3）现有价格政策特别是最低支持价格政策在缓解脆弱性方面效果有限；4）需要根据Swaminathan委员会的建议修改政策。

title: Multi-Channel Composite Indicator for FX Portfolio Crises: Architecture, Evaluation, and the Limits of Small-Sample Calibration

detail.title: Multi-Channel Composite Indicator for FX Portfolio Crises: Architecture, Evaluation, and the Limits of Small-Sample Calibration
detail.abstract: This paper develops a Multi-Channel Composite Indicator (MCCI) for predicting FX portfolio crises using options-implied and geopolitical signals. The system constructs the MCCI from five channels, each targeting a distinct risk mechanism: geopolitical risk, tail-risk pricing, crash fear, market microstructure, and volatility divergence. Each channel is estimated via logistic regression with walk-forward validation, and the composite is formed by equal-weighted averaging of z-scored out-of-sample probabilities. The novel Volatility Divergence Index (VDX), which captures the implied-realized volatility spread as a crisis predictor rather than a volatility forecast, serves as the system's anchor signal and appears in all five channel models. Evaluated against expandingwindow crisis labels on a portfolio of nine G10 FX pairs over 2020-2025, the MCCI achieves strong discrimination (AUC 0.903 at the 90-day horizon, 0.769 at 30 days), significantly outperforming a naive CVIX benchmark at longer horizons (DeLong p < 0.001). However, with only three crisis episodes in the evaluation sample, probability calibration fails and no operationally useful alert threshold can be identified. Episode-level analysis reveals that aggregate discrimination is dominated by the 2020 COVID crisis, with substantially weaker performance during the 2022 rate shock and 2025 tariff episode. The comprehensive evaluation methodology itself constitutes a contribution, demonstrating that strong aggregate AUC can coexist with poor calibration and heterogeneous episode-level performance when crisis counts are small, and quantifying minimum data requirements for operational early warning deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个多通道复合指标(MCCI)来预测外汇投资组合危机，使用期权隐含信号和地缘政治信号。系统从五个通道构建MCCI，每个通道针对不同的风险机制。虽然MCCI在区分危机方面表现出色，但由于样本中只有三次危机事件，概率校准失败，无法确定操作上有用的警报阈值。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个有效的外汇投资组合危机预测系统，使用期权隐含信号和地缘政治信号？
AI.motivation: 现有危机预测系统往往依赖单一信号或缺乏综合评估框架，需要开发一个能够整合多种风险机制信号的复合指标系统，并系统评估其在实际操作中的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多通道风险机制理论，包括地缘政治风险、尾部风险定价、崩盘恐惧、市场微观结构和波动率差异等五个理论通道。
AI.method: 使用逻辑回归和向前滚动验证方法估计每个通道，通过等权重平均z标准化样本外概率形成复合指标。引入新颖的波动率差异指数(VDX)作为锚定信号。在2020-2025年期间对九个G10货币对的投资组合进行评估。
AI.findings: MCCI在区分危机方面表现强劲（90天期限AUC 0.903，30天期限AUC 0.769），显著优于基准模型。但由于样本中只有三次危机事件，概率校准失败，无法确定操作警报阈值。事件级分析显示，总体区分能力主要由2020年COVID危机主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了多通道复合指标(MCCI)框架；2. 引入了波动率差异指数(VDX)作为危机预测而非波动率预测的新指标；3. 提出了综合评估方法论，展示了强AUC与差校准共存的现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为外汇投资组合危机预测提供了实用的多信号系统；2. 量化了操作预警部署所需的最小数据要求；3. 揭示了在危机事件数量较少时，即使有强区分能力，也可能无法确定操作上有用的警报阈值。

title: Automated Decision-Making and the Limits of Law Designed for Humans
affiliations: Curtin University - Curtin Law School

detail.title: Automated Decision-Making and the Limits of Law Designed for Humans
detail.abstract: In the broader discussions surrounding artificial intelligence, this article examines the extent to which Australian administrative law is equipped to accommodate automated and AIassisted decision-making in tax administration. While such technologies promise gains in efficiency and scale, the avenues for challenging tax assessments and related decisions remain narrowly circumscribed. Under Part IVC of the Taxation Administration Act 1953 (Cth), assessment-making is insulated from scrutiny by the combined statutory effect that an assessment is prima facie valid and that a notice of assessment constitutes conclusive evidence of its due making. Judicial review of assessment-making may be available under s 75(v) of the Constitution and its statutory counterparts in s 39B of the Judiciary Act 1903 (Cth), but these provisions are difficult to apply in the absence of an identifiable officer in the case of automated tax administration. Certain non-assessment decisions are reviewable under the Administrative Decisions (Judicial Review) Act 1977 (Cth), yet prevailing authority requires a reviewable decision to involve a human mental process. Private law remedies are available, but their applications are practically limited. The article argues that targeted legislative reform, strengthened transparency obligations and clearer attribution of responsibility are required to ensure the safeguarding of taxpayer rights in an increasingly automated tax administration environment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨澳大利亚行政法如何适应税收管理中自动化和AI辅助决策，指出现有法律框架在保护纳税人权利方面存在不足，需要立法改革、加强透明度和明确责任归属。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚行政法在多大程度上能够适应税收管理中的自动化和AI辅助决策？
AI.motivation: 人工智能技术在税收管理中的应用承诺提高效率和规模，但现有法律框架对纳税人权利的保护存在缺陷，需要评估法律适应性并提出改革建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 澳大利亚行政法框架，包括《1953年税收管理法》第IVC部分、《1977年行政决定（司法审查）法》、《1903年司法法》第39B条以及宪法第75(v)条。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和判例法分析，评估现有法律框架对自动化决策的适应性。
AI.findings: 1. 税收评估决策受法律保护难以审查；2. 司法审查在自动化决策中难以适用；3. 行政审查要求人类思维过程；4. 私法救济实际应用有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了澳大利亚行政法在适应自动化决策方面的结构性缺陷，为行政法与人工智能交叉研究提供理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项改革建议：1. 针对性立法改革；2. 加强透明度义务；3. 明确责任归属，以保护纳税人权利。

title: Loss-Leader Pricing on Hybrid Platforms: A Multiproduct Perspective
affiliations: ,  and Graduate School of Business Administration, Kobe University

detail.title: Loss-Leader Pricing on Hybrid Platforms: A Multiproduct Perspective
detail.abstract: We develop a model of a hybrid platform that hosts multiple products and enables consumers to fill their baskets through one-stop shopping. Each product is supplied by a manufacturer and sold via competing third-party sellers, while the platform also enters as a first-party seller. One-stop shopping turns otherwise independent products into effective complements, creating a cross-product demand externality (the Cournot externality). We show that the platform may optimally price one product below cost (loss-leader pricing) to internalize this Cournot externality, particularly when manufacturers' wholesale prices are high. Ceteris paribus, loss-leader pricing benefits the platform, consumers, and manufacturers, yielding a Pareto improvement. However, this positive outcome may fail to arise---and indeed leave all parties worse off---when manufacturers strategically raise wholesale prices in anticipation of the platform's loss-leading. Our analysis finds that whenever loss-leading is profitable for the platform, it also benefits consumers and manufacturers, providing a procompetitive rationale for first-party selling by hybrid platforms.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个混合平台模型，平台既作为第一方卖家销售产品，也允许第三方卖家竞争销售。研究发现，平台可能采用低于成本的亏本定价策略来内部化跨产品需求外部性，这种策略在制造商批发价高时尤其有效。虽然亏本定价通常能使平台、消费者和制造商三方受益，但当制造商预期平台会采用亏本定价而策略性提高批发价时，可能导致三方都受损。
AI.research_question: 混合平台在同时作为第一方卖家和第三方卖家平台时，如何通过定价策略（特别是亏本定价）来内部化跨产品需求外部性？这种策略对平台、消费者和制造商的福利影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 混合平台（如亚马逊、京东等）同时作为第一方卖家和第三方卖家平台，这种模式创造了跨产品需求外部性（Cournot外部性）。一站式购物使原本独立的产品变成有效互补品，平台需要设计定价策略来内部化这种外部性。然而，制造商可能策略性地调整批发价来应对平台的定价策略，这会影响各方福利。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 混合平台理论：平台同时作为第一方卖家和第三方卖家平台
2. 跨产品需求外部性（Cournot外部性）：一站式购物使独立产品成为互补品
3. 亏本定价策略：平台可能低于成本销售某些产品
4. 批发价策略性调整：制造商对平台定价策略的响应
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建一个混合平台模型，平台销售多种产品，每种产品由制造商供应并通过竞争的第三方卖家销售，平台同时作为第一方卖家。分析平台的最优定价策略，特别是亏本定价的条件和效果。考察制造商批发价策略性调整对均衡结果的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 平台可能最优地采用亏本定价策略来内部化跨产品需求外部性，特别是在制造商批发价较高时
2. 在其他条件不变的情况下，亏本定价能使平台、消费者和制造商三方受益，实现帕累托改进
3. 但当制造商预期平台会采用亏本定价而策略性提高批发价时，可能导致三方都受损
4. 只要亏本定价对平台有利可图，它也会使消费者和制造商受益
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为混合平台的第一方销售提供了竞争性理论依据
2. 阐明了跨产品需求外部性在平台定价策略中的作用机制
3. 揭示了亏本定价策略在内部化外部性方面的经济学原理
4. 分析了制造商策略性响应如何影响平台定价策略的有效性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为混合平台管理者提供了定价策略指导，特别是何时采用亏本定价
2. 帮助政策制定者理解平台亏本定价的竞争效应
3. 为制造商提供了应对平台定价策略的决策参考
4. 揭示了平台第一方销售可能带来的消费者福利改善

title: The Quantum Blind Spot: A Fiduciary's Guide to Bitcoin's Existential Risk
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Quantum Blind Spot: A Fiduciary's Guide to Bitcoin's Existential Risk
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether quantum computing represents a material risk requiring attention from institutional investors holding Bitcoin allocations. Through analysis of recent technical developments, expert assessments, and governance structures, the research demonstrates that quantum computing poses a potential existential threat to Bitcoin's cryptographic foundation within a timeframe that now overlaps with the governance timeline required for implementing protective measures. Crucially, the study argues that this risk extends beyond direct on-chain ownership to include spot ETFs and corporate proxies; these instruments face a compounding "custodial-quantum" risk where centralized pools of assets are vulnerable to both underlying network failure and the potential inability of custodians to migrate vast holdings before a cryptographic breach. The analysis reveals that fiduciaries face an unprecedented challenge: responsibility for assets secured by software they cannot control, maintained by developers they cannot direct, and governed by a decentralized community resistant to institutional influence. The paper concludes with specific action items for investment committees, board trustees, and institutional fund managers to fulfill their fiduciary obligations considering this emerging risk.

AI.tldr: 量子计算对比特币构成实质性风险，机构投资者需关注其加密基础可能被破解的时间窗口与治理实施时间重叠，且风险不仅限于链上资产，还包括ETF和托管资产面临的双重风险。
AI.research_question: 量子计算是否构成需要持有比特币配置的机构投资者关注的实质性风险？
AI.motivation: 量子计算技术发展可能威胁比特币的加密基础，而机构投资者（包括ETF持有者和公司代理）面临独特的"托管-量子"双重风险，且治理结构与技术时间窗口存在冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论、加密安全理论、治理理论，特别是关注去中心化系统的治理挑战与机构投资者受托责任之间的理论冲突。
AI.method: 分析近期技术发展、专家评估和治理结构，通过时间窗口分析（量子破解时间与治理实施时间的重叠）和风险传导机制分析（从链上资产到金融工具的风险扩展）。
AI.findings: 量子计算对比特币构成潜在生存威胁，其时间窗口与实施保护措施的治理时间线重叠；风险扩展到现货ETF和公司代理，面临"托管-量子"双重风险；受托人面临无法控制软件、无法指导开发者、无法影响去中心化社区的独特挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"托管-量子风险"概念框架，扩展了加密资产风险理论；分析了去中心化系统治理与机构受托责任的理论冲突；为量子时代加密资产风险管理提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资委员会、董事会受托人和机构基金经理提供具体的行动项目清单；帮助机构投资者履行受托责任；为监管机构和行业标准制定提供参考。

title: Enhancing Child Protection: Private International Law on Filiation and the European Commission's Proposal COM/2022/695 Final
affiliations: University of Bonn, Institut für Internationales Familienrecht, Swiss Institute of Comparative Law, University of Liège, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Faculty of Law, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Uppsala University and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Enhancing Child Protection: Private International Law on Filiation and the European Commission's Proposal COM/2022/695 Final

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No declaration of interest
declarations.funderStatement: The report is the result of a project of the European Law Institute (ELI) and was funded by the ELI

detail.abstract:
This Report examines the Commission Proposal COM/2022/695 and its critical role in advancing fundamental rights within the EU. While preserving the Commission’s Proposal’s core vision and framework, this analysis recommends strategic refinements that strengthen alignment with the existing EU acquis, foster deeper European integration, and enhance the protection of children’s fundamental rights.
In addition, it expands upon the Proposal’s initial emphasis on the EU Strategies for children’s rights and LGBTIQA+ equality by incorporating a comprehensive women’s rights perspective

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了欧盟委员会提案COM/2022/695，在保留其核心框架的同时，建议通过战略调整来加强其与现有欧盟法律的协调性，促进更深层次的欧洲一体化，并增强对儿童基本权利的保护。报告还扩展了提案最初对儿童权利和LGBTIQA+平等战略的关注，纳入了全面的妇女权利视角。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会提案COM/2022/695如何有效推进欧盟基本权利保护，特别是在儿童权利、LGBTIQA+平等和妇女权利方面？
AI.motivation: 欧盟需要加强基本权利保护框架，特别是在儿童权利、性别平等和LGBTIQA+权利方面，以促进更深层次的欧洲一体化和社会公正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟基本权利理论、欧洲一体化理论、儿童权利保护理论、性别平等理论、LGBTIQA+权利理论
AI.method: 政策分析、法律文本分析、比较分析（提案与现有欧盟法律框架的协调性分析）
AI.findings: 提案COM/2022/695在推进基本权利方面具有重要价值，但需要战略调整以更好地与现有欧盟法律框架协调，加强儿童权利保护，并应扩展纳入妇女权利视角以实现更全面的平等保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了欧盟基本权利保护的理论框架，将儿童权利、LGBTIQA+权利和妇女权利整合到一个统一的分析框架中，为欧洲一体化理论提供了权利保护维度的补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了具体的战略调整建议，有助于加强提案与现有欧盟法律的协调性，促进更有效的儿童权利保护，并为纳入妇女权利视角提供了操作路径。

title: Remote Work, Office Demand, and REIT Returns: A Quasi-Experimental Analysis of Property-Type Differences
affiliations: and Olin Business School, Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: Remote Work, Office Demand, and REIT Returns: A Quasi-Experimental Analysis of Property-Type Differences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No external funding
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether shifts in return-to-office (RTO) expectations were associated with differential return performance across commercial real estate sectors. We construct a panel of U.S. publicly traded equity REITs using historical constituent holdings of the Vanguard Real Estate ETF (VNQ) and obtain daily adjusted price data from public market sources, including Yahoo Finance. The sample spans January 1, 2022 through January 1, 2025. We implement a quasi-experimental framework combining difference-indifferences estimation with a dynamic event-study design around January 3, 2023, RTO expectation shift. Office REITs are compared with Industrial, Data Center, and broader non-office REIT sectors. We find a positive and statistically significant post-event differential return for Office REITs, though the economic magnitude is modest. Event-study estimates indicate gradual relative performance adjustment rather than immediate repricing. The results remain statistically similar when we change the control group and when we estimate the model using firm and date fixed effects. This suggests that the findings are not driven by a specific comparison group or model specification and instead reflect gradual market reassessment of long-run office space demand relative to other property sectors.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在2023年1月3日RTO预期转变后，办公类REITs相对于其他房地产板块（工业、数据中心、非办公类）表现出正向但幅度有限的超额回报，市场对办公空间需求的重新评估是渐进的而非立即的。
AI.research_question: RTO（返回办公室）预期的转变是否与商业房地产不同板块之间的差异化回报表现相关？
AI.motivation: 疫情后工作模式的转变对商业房地产需求产生了重大影响，特别是办公空间。理解市场如何重新评估不同房地产板块的长期需求对投资者和政策制定者都很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场效率理论和事件研究方法，研究市场对RTO预期转变的反应，以及不同房地产板块之间的相对表现差异。
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，结合双重差分法（difference-in-differences）和动态事件研究法，以2023年1月3日为事件日，比较办公类REITs与工业、数据中心及其他非办公类REITs的表现。使用Vanguard房地产ETF（VNQ）成分股构建面板数据，样本期为2022年1月1日至2025年1月1日。
AI.findings: 办公类REITs在事件后表现出正向且统计显著的超额回报，但经济幅度有限。事件研究显示相对表现的调整是渐进的而非立即的。结果在不同控制组和固定效应模型下保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了市场对RTO预期转变反应的实证证据，表明市场对办公空间需求的重新评估是渐进的，支持了市场效率理论中的渐进调整观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产投资者提供了关于不同板块相对表现的信息，帮助理解市场对工作模式转变的反应模式，对资产配置和投资决策有参考价值。

title: Adapt to a Harsher World: Memo to the High Representative for Foreign and Security Policy
affiliations: Bruegel, Bruegel and Bruegel

detail.title: Adapt to a Harsher World: Memo to the High Representative for Foreign and Security Policy
detail.abstract:
The job of High Representative for Foreign and Security Policy and Vice-President of the European Commission (HRVP) was designed for a different world than the one the European Union now grapples with: a world built on principles and governed by law, in which the EU was a force of attraction because of its mass, prosperity and good governance. 

Today’s EU is weaker. It faces Russian aggression on its borders and a conflict in the Middle East where it has little influence. Economic security has become a much bigger priority. Whoever is elected as the next US president will continue the rivalry with China and be more absorbed with the Indo-Pacific than with Europe. In the EU, China is widely acknowledged to be a rival, and even a threat. Yet it remains an essential trade partner and has also become a formidable economic competitor. 

The HRVP’s role is constrained by a confusing and contested institutional structure, with prominent roles for the President of the Commission and President of the European Council in EU external representation. At the same time, the EU’s external policy is more important than ever. A stark choice must be made on how to adapt the HRVP role to a world dominated by intimidation and brute force. There are two possible options. 

The first and best option is for the European Council to give the HRVP a stronger mandate to act on matters on which member states have decided to take common action. This would require stronger legal and financial capabilities to coordinate relevant policies in the EU institutions. In this model, the HRVP would be ‘first among equals’, both among the foreign ministers and among all commissioners with portfolios that touch on EU external relations. 

A second option would be to accept that the authority of the HRVP is more circumscribed than envisaged by the Lisbon Treaty, but to clarify the functions that the HRVP will keep. This requires a clear division of labour with other commissioners whose portfolios have an external dimension and implies forsaking responsibility for trade policy, development, enlargement and neighbourhood, and even defence procurement. 

We believe the first model is preferable. But most important is that the EU makes a choice and breaks the bad habit of nominally assigning powers to the HRVP while depriving her of the ability to exercise them in practice. Disempowering the HRVP’s position would make the system even more dysfunctional.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表兼欧盟委员会副主席（HRVP）职位在当前地缘政治挑战下的困境，提出了两种改革方案：一是强化HRVP在成员国共同行动事项上的授权；二是明确界定HRVP的有限职能范围。作者认为第一种方案更优，但最重要的是欧盟必须做出明确选择。
AI.research_question: 在当今以威慑和武力为主导的世界中，如何调整欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表兼欧盟委员会副主席（HRVP）的角色以适应新的地缘政治现实？
AI.motivation: HRVP职位是为基于原则和法治的世界设计的，而当今欧盟面临俄罗斯侵略、中东冲突、中美竞争等挑战，欧盟实力相对减弱。HRVP角色受到混乱和争议的制度结构制约，而欧盟对外政策却比以往任何时候都更重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟制度设计理论、地缘政治分析、国际关系中的制度适应理论、欧盟对外政策协调机制。
AI.method: 政策分析、制度比较分析、基于地缘政治现实的规范性论证。
AI.findings: 提出了两种改革HRVP角色的方案：1）强化HRVP在成员国共同行动事项上的授权，赋予其更强法律和财政能力；2）明确界定HRVP的有限职能范围，与其他委员分工。第一种方案更优，但关键是欧盟必须做出明确选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 为欧盟制度适应理论提供了实证案例，分析了制度设计如何应对地缘政治变化，提出了"名义授权与实际能力脱节"的制度功能障碍理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟决策者提供了具体的HRVP改革方案，指出了当前制度设计的问题，强调了做出明确制度选择的重要性，以避免系统功能失调。

title: Segmented Exchange Markets and U.S. Monetary Spillovers: Beyond the Trilemma
affiliations: Kenyon College and Citigroup, Inc.

detail.title: Segmented Exchange Markets and U.S. Monetary Spillovers: Beyond the Trilemma

declarations.declarationOfInterest: assistance. The authors’ institutional affiliations are provided for identification purposes only. Views expressed are solely those of the authors. All remaining errors are our own.

detail.abstract: This paper re-evaluates the international macroeconomic trilemma by embedding segmented foreign exchange markets into a constant elasticity of substitution (CES) interest parity framework. Using a novel panel of implied parallel exchange rates, we analyze the transmission of U.S. monetary policy shocks across exchange rate and capital control regimes. Static estimates demonstrate that monetary autonomy is not merely a discrete policy choice, but is fundamentally conditioned on the elasticity of substitution between official and shadow markets. Dynamically, local projections reveal that parallel markets absorb external pressures when official channels are constrained, and expose stark asymmetric responses driven by a "fear of appreciation." Nominally flexible regimes with capital controls maintain autonomy during U.S. tightening but aggressively import U.S. rate cuts during easing, highlighting the practical limits of monetary independence.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估国际宏观经济三难困境，通过将分割的外汇市场嵌入CES利率平价框架。使用隐含平行汇率的新面板数据，分析美国货币政策冲击在不同汇率和资本管制制度下的传导。静态估计显示货币政策自主性不仅是离散的政策选择，更根本上取决于官方与影子市场间的替代弹性。动态分析揭示平行市场在官方渠道受限时吸收外部压力，并暴露由"升值恐惧"驱动的显著不对称反应。名义灵活汇率制度加资本管制在美国紧缩时保持自主性，但在宽松时积极输入美国降息，突显货币政策独立性的实际限制。
AI.research_question: 在不同汇率制度和资本管制环境下，美国货币政策冲击如何通过分割的外汇市场传导？货币政策自主性在多大程度上受到官方与平行外汇市场间替代弹性的制约？
AI.motivation: 传统国际宏观经济三难困境（trilemma）假设统一的外汇市场，但现实中许多国家存在官方与平行市场的分割。这种分割如何影响货币政策传导和自主性，特别是在资本管制和不同汇率制度下，需要重新评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际宏观经济三难困境理论，CES（常替代弹性）利率平价框架，分割外汇市场理论，平行汇率市场动态
AI.method: 使用隐含平行汇率的新面板数据，结合静态估计和动态本地投影法，分析美国货币政策冲击在不同汇率制度（固定vs灵活）和资本管制程度下的传导效应

title: Simpson's Paradox in Monetary Policy: A Textual Analysis of FOMC Inflation Decompositions, 1973-2025
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Simpson's Paradox in Monetary Policy: A Textual Analysis of FOMC Inflation Decompositions, 1973-2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author operates the FOMC Insight Engine (causalityineconomics.com), a semantic search platform indexing Federal Reserve documents. The platform was used as the primary research tool for this study. The author has no financial relationships with the Federal Reserve System, any Federal Reserve Bank, or any entity that would benefit from a particular finding regarding Federal Reserve communication practices. The author holds no positions in instruments that would be affected by changes in Federal Reserve communication policy.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All infrastructure and development costs were self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The Federal Reserve possesses multiple internally consistent inflation measures and systematically presents the public with whichever aggregation supports accommodation. Across five chairmanships and six inflation episodes (1973-2025), the committee operationalized dovish decomposition-arguments that measured inflation overstates true price pressure-as public frameworks, congressional testimony, and policy anchors. When the same analytical toolkit produced hawkish decompositions-arguments that measured inflation understates true pressure-the committee discussed the findings internally and declined to adopt them. Staff built three hawkish analytical frameworks (the Bubble Policy, asset-inclusive inflation indices, Market-Based PCE as binding target); all three were rejected. The two major preemptive tightening cycles in the post-Volcker era (1994 and 2015-2016) employed no compositional analysis at all, relying on Phillips Curve projections-while dovish decomposition ran in parallel. The asymmetry operates not through direction of individual claims, which run both ways, but through which claims become policy output. The mechanism is institutional preservation of discretion: the committee rejects any framework that constrains future options, and because the path of least resistance defaults to 1 Simpson's Paradox in Monetary Policy accommodation, preserving discretion produces accommodative bias as a downstream consequence. The choice of which inflation average to present publicly functions as a de facto policy instrument, operating parallel to the federal funds rate.

title: Unpacking China’s Industrial Policy and its Implications for Europe
affiliations: Bruegel and Bruegel

detail.title: Unpacking China’s Industrial Policy and its Implications for Europe
detail.abstract:
China is often credited with a successful application of industrial policy. One important particularity of China’s industrial policy is that it aims at levelling the playing field between the state economy and the private economy in access to finance, yet within a framework of strategic goals. This aim is not relevant for market economies, such as those of the European Union, but only for those where state enterprises are clearly privileged. 

Notwithstanding the difficulties in making valid comparisons, our analysis of how China conducts industrial policy in a variety of sectors points to success in some sectors but not all. More importantly, productivity growth in China has already been declining for two decades. 

Given the very large resources that China has put into industrial policy, with subsidies being only one part, it is surprising that success is not more evident. This relates partly to factors including cronyism and regional protectionism. While the former might be less relevant for the EU given the different institutional background, the latter certainly is relevant since the EU faces the potential consequences of member country-level industrial policy for its single market. A lesson from China seems to come from the sectoral focus, with a long-term and economic-security mindset. The EU is far from this, but it is in the process of linking economic security to industrial policy. 

Finally, responding to China’s industrial policy involves diverse investigations and challenges in measuring subsidies accurately. Understanding China’s very diverse and complex approach to helping companies achieve the government’s industrial policy goals is crucial for anticipating the consequences of China’s actions. These could be positive, such as cheaper imports of green technology, or negative, such as Chinese overcapacity spilling over to the EU single market.

title: The Private Enforcer: Algorithmic Deterrence and the Shadow Tax on Insider Trading
affiliations: , University of Chicago, Boston College and

detail.title: The Private Enforcer: Algorithmic Deterrence and the Shadow Tax on Insider Trading

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper No. 26-4
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Chicago Law School, Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Can transparent order-flow environments discipline informed trading even in the absence of public enforcement? We study a DeFi market in which sandwich-capable MEV searchers impose immediate, state-dependent execution losses on aggressive informational trading. In a baseline equilibrium execution model, predation risk enters the trader’s problem through a predictable attack intensity and state-contingent jump/loss terms, generating an endoge nous shadow tax on aggressive trading and a safe-harbor region of near-zero execution. We then discipline these reduced-form objects through a bot-side partial-observation impulse control problem, which rationalizes how greater trading aggressiveness and detectability increase predation exposure. As a pricing extension, we show that the same predation channel can load equilibrium prices with additional jump-driven tail risk under a pro jected Cox representation and an LP-based pricing kernel. Our contribution shows that transparent DeFi microstructure can implement a private deterrence technology with real distributional and pricing consequences

title: Transparency of Carbon-Neutral Labels: Evidence from a Choice Experiment
affiliations: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology

detail.title: Transparency of Carbon-Neutral Labels: Evidence from a Choice Experiment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: I acknowledge financial support from Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether transparency affects consumers’ willingness to pay for carbon-neutral labels. Many companies label products as carbon neutral, yet these labels do not disclose the shares of CO₂ offsetting and CO₂ reduction underlying the claim. The EU has recently adopted rules to prohibit environmental claims that rely on CO₂ offsetting, while other jurisdictions, such as the UK, have issued guidance recommending disclosure. Using a discrete choice experiment with 1,339 UK tea consumers, I compare willingness to pay for standard versus transparent carbon-neutral labels that disclose the offset–reduction composition. I find no evidence that transparency increases willingness to pay or that consumers prefer CO₂ reductions over offsets. Furthermore, organic and ethical trade labels crowd out the value of the carbon-neutral claim but do not change the null effect of transparency. These findings suggest that disclosure alone may not be sufficient to ensure quality differentiation in carbon-neutral labeling and that additional regulation may be needed.

AI.tldr: 研究发现碳中性标签的透明度（披露抵消与减排比例）并不增加消费者支付意愿，消费者对减排和抵消无偏好差异，有机和道德贸易标签会削弱碳中性标签的价值，但透明度效应仍为零。
AI.research_question: 透明度是否影响消费者对碳中性标签的支付意愿？消费者是否更偏好二氧化碳减排而非抵消？

AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、消费者偏好理论、标签认证经济学、环境信息披露效应
AI.method: 使用离散选择实验，对1339名英国茶叶消费者进行调查，比较标准碳中性标签与披露抵消-减排构成的透明标签的支付意愿。
AI.findings: 1. 无证据表明透明度增加支付意愿；2. 消费者对减排和抵消无显著偏好差异；3. 有机和道德贸易标签会削弱碳中性标签的价值；4. 透明度效应不受其他标签影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了透明度必然提升消费者信任和支付意愿的假设，揭示了碳中性标签与其他可持续标签的竞争关系，为环境标签信息披露理论提供实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明仅靠披露可能不足以确保碳中性标签的质量区分，需要额外监管；为政策制定者提供关于碳中性标签透明度的实证依据；帮助企业理解消费者对碳中性标签的真实反应。

title: Territorial Tensions: Rainforest Conservation, Post-Conflict Recovery, and Land Tenure in Liberia
affiliations: and

detail.title: Territorial Tensions: Rainforest Conservation, Post-Conflict Recovery, and Land Tenure in Liberia
detail.abstract:
Since the cessation of the civil conflict in 2003, the Liberian government is poised to 
expand greatly its protected area network to conserve the country's remaining rainforest. Liberia 
holds within its borders nearly half of the remaining Guinean rainforest, a global biodiversity 
hotspot. The planning process for this effort has been a central part of rebuilding Liberia's 
forestry sector, which helped fuel past conflict. The process, known as the Liberia Forestry 
Initiative (LFI), is widely considered to have been exemplary with regard to multi-stakeholder 
dialogue and policy making. Because the issue of land tenure remains widely contested however, 
the initiative risks seriously aggravating land rights problems, complicating the prospects for a 
durable peace. This article focuses on the process through which land was zoned for strict 
protection and how this process is likely to exacerbate land tenure conflict in Liberia’s priority 
conservation areas. Although the international conservation community sees post-conflict 
scenarios as opportune for promoting conservation initiatives, unresolved land tenure issues 
make for problematic outcomes, including land disputes and legal disarray. Such problems can 
result in significant volatility, and can make the peace process and recovery much more, not less 
difficult. Key Words: Postwar, Liberia, forests, tenure, conservation

detail.title: Linkages Between Large-Scale Infrastructure Development and Conflict Dynamics in East Africa
detail.abstract: With the rapid increase in the number of mega-infrastructure projects underway across East Africa, understanding how the social, economic, political and environmental repercussions of these projects intersect with ongoing conflict dynamics, is a poorly understood topic. Although recent interest in large-scale land acquisitions has led to a number of detailed investigations into specific projects and trends, there has not yet been a broad, systematic review of how large-scale infrastructure developments in East Africa interact with previous, ongoing and potential conflict in their areas of operation. The objective of this article is to report on an analysis of 26 megainfrastructure projects across Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, and Uganda, with an explicit focus on the common tension points that contribute to security dynamics. The methodology used involved two composite indicators of risk-a conflict risk score, and a project impact score. The study found seven common tensions across all projects: in-migration, population displacement and relocation, a negative history of community relations with previous or follow-on developments, 4) land rights, securitization, environmental degradation, and expectations of the local population relative to benefits delivered by the project. The study recommends increased attention on prior assessments that focus on the broader and more interconnected impacts in addition to those confined to the immediate project location, as well as in-depth examination of possible mitigation measures. 'Social license' refers to the approval or acceptance of a company and it's activities by a local community, which exists outside 1 of formal regulatory processes.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了东非26个大型基础设施项目，识别出7个常见的冲突风险点，并建议加强事前评估和缓解措施，以获取社区的"社会许可"。
AI.research_question: 东非大型基础设施项目如何与所在地区的现有、持续和潜在冲突动态相互作用？
AI.motivation: 随着东非大型基础设施项目迅速增加，这些项目的社会、经济、政治和环境影响如何与持续冲突动态相互作用，是一个理解不足的话题。虽然已有对具体项目的研究，但缺乏对东非大型基础设施发展与冲突相互作用的系统性综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会许可理论（Social License）——指社区对公司和其活动的认可或接受，存在于正式监管程序之外；冲突风险与项目影响评估框架。
AI.method: 对肯尼亚、坦桑尼亚、埃塞俄比亚和乌干达的26个大型基础设施项目进行分析，使用两个综合风险指标：冲突风险评分和项目影响评分。
AI.findings: 研究发现所有项目存在7个共同紧张点：1)人口迁入，2)人口流离失所和搬迁，3)社区与先前或后续发展的负面关系史，4)土地权利，5)安全化，6)环境退化，7)当地人口对项目带来利益的期望与实际交付的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会许可理论应用于东非大型基础设施项目的冲突分析；建立了系统性评估基础设施项目与冲突动态相互作用的方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强事前评估，关注超出项目直接影响范围的更广泛、相互关联的影响；深入考察可能的缓解措施；为政策制定者和项目开发者提供识别和管理冲突风险的具体指导。

title: Pricing Protection: Credit Scores, Disaster Risk, and Home Insurance Affordability
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, The Wharton School - University of Pennsylvania, Real Estate Department, University of Wisconsin-Madison and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Pricing Protection: Credit Scores, Disaster Risk, and Home Insurance Affordability
detail.abstract:
We use 70 million policies linked to mortgages and property-level disaster risk to show that credit scores impact homeowners insurance premiums as much as disaster risk. Homeowners with low credit pay 24% more for identical coverage than high–credit score homeowners. Leveraging a natural experiment in Washington State, we find that banning the use of credit information considerably weakens the relationship between credit score and pricing. We discuss the role of credit information in pricing and show that, although insurance is often overlooked in discussions of home affordability, a low credit score increases premiums roughly as much as it raises mortgage rates.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现信用评分对房主保险费率的影响与灾害风险相当，低信用评分房主比高信用评分房主多支付24%的保费。通过华盛顿州的自然实验，禁止使用信用信息显著减弱了信用评分与定价之间的关系。

title: Environmental Change and Adaptation in Degraded Agro-Ecosystems: The Case of Highland Madagascar
affiliations: , Indiana University and Indiana University

detail.title: Environmental Change and Adaptation in Degraded Agro-Ecosystems: The Case of Highland Madagascar
detail.abstract: While the view that the poorer agricultural populations in developing countries will be at the forefront of negative consequences due to environmental change is widely accepted, this perspective must become considerably more nuanced in order to recognize and take advantage of emerging opportunities for realistic adaptation. This paper presents a case from Madagascar which suggests that adaptation opportunities involve more than looking for alternatives to what are presently perceived to be negative socio-ecologic processes. In Madagascar the severe erosion occurring on the deforested central plateau actually appear to create, over time, opportunities for increased food security and environmental management compared to un-eroded portions of the same landscape. The paper proposes that while concern and action is needed to attend to the problems that the poor of the developing world will face due to impacts from environmental change, the repercussions of such change on agricultural systems also need to be looked at in ways that involve recognizing the local and aggregate potential opportunities that they may present in certain systems, in order to realize the prospects for adaptation.

AI.tldr: 马达加斯加案例研究表明，严重侵蚀虽然带来问题，但长期来看反而创造了提高粮食安全和环境管理的机遇，挑战了传统认为环境变化对贫困农业人口只有负面影响的观念。
AI.research_question: 环境变化对发展中国家贫困农业人口的负面影响是否过于简化？环境变化是否在某些系统中也能创造适应机会？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为发展中国家贫困农业人口将首当其冲承受环境变化的负面影响，但这种观点需要更细致地考虑环境变化可能带来的适应机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境变化适应理论、社会生态系统理论、机会识别框架、农业系统韧性理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以马达加斯加中央高原的侵蚀现象为研究对象，比较侵蚀区域与非侵蚀区域的粮食安全和环境管理状况。
AI.findings: 马达加斯加中央高原的严重侵蚀区域，随着时间的推移，反而比未侵蚀区域创造了更好的粮食安全和环境管理机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了环境变化对贫困人口只有负面影响的简化观点，提出了环境变化可能创造适应机会的理论框架，丰富了社会生态系统适应理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的视角：在关注环境变化问题的同时，也需要识别和利用可能出现的适应机会；为发展中国家农业适应策略提供了实证参考。

title: From the Administrative Presidency to Personalist Consolidation: Trumpism and Executive Control of the Regulatory State

detail.title: From the Administrative Presidency to Personalist Consolidation: Trumpism and Executive Control of the Regulatory State
detail.abstract: This essay investigates the evolving relationship between Trumpism and the United States regulatory state, focusing on how Donald Trump has reshaped American administrative governance to one of personalist consolidation. Drawing on scholarship of the administrative presidency, I argue that Trumpism represents a strategic fusion of structural deregulation in sectors like environmental protection, energy, and finance with robust state intervention in domains tied to a right-wing populist definition of national sovereignty. Trumpism reflects a personalist style of governance rooted in the exploitation of institutional tools of the administrative presidency that have developed across both Democratic and Republican administrations over the past century. By situating Trump within the broader institutional evolution of executive power, I highlight how his manipulation of the regulatory state entrenches executive dominance and preserves an illiberal reform in governance through electoral legitimation paired with the erosion of liberal-democratic accountability standards in administration (Bauer & Becker, 2020; Bauer et al., 2021; Bauer, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨特朗普主义与美国监管国家的关系，认为特朗普通过行政总统制的制度工具，将个人主义治理风格与结构性放松管制及右翼民粹主义国家主权干预相结合，巩固了行政主导并侵蚀了自由民主的问责标准。
AI.research_question: 特朗普主义如何重塑美国行政治理，实现个人主义巩固，以及这种转变如何影响美国的监管国家结构？
AI.motivation: 理解特朗普主义对美国行政治理的深刻影响，特别是其如何利用行政总统制的制度工具，将个人主义治理风格与结构性政策变革相结合，从而改变美国监管国家的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政总统制理论，个人主义治理理论，监管国家理论，右翼民粹主义理论，制度演化理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合历史制度主义方法，分析特朗普政府时期行政权力的演变和监管政策的变化。
AI.findings: 特朗普主义代表了结构性放松管制（如环境、能源、金融领域）与右翼民粹主义国家主权干预的战略融合；特朗普利用行政总统制的制度工具，发展出个人主义治理风格；这种治理模式巩固了行政主导，通过选举合法化与侵蚀自由民主问责标准相结合，保留了非自由主义的治理改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了行政总统制理论，提出了特朗普主义作为个人主义治理与监管国家变革的新分析框架；深化了对右翼民粹主义与行政权力关系的理解；为理解当代美国政治中的非自由主义转向提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了特朗普政府如何实际运作行政权力；为政策制定者和公民社会理解监管国家变革提供了分析工具；对维护民主问责制和保护行政治理的规范性标准具有警示意义。

title: Position Auctions with Organic Search
affiliations: and

detail.title: Position Auctions with Organic Search
detail.abstract: Recent regulatory actions, such as the FTC v. Amazon antitrust case, have raised concerns about the impact of sponsored advertisements on consumer welfare in online search platforms. While theoretical models of position auctions typically predict that sellers are ranked by consumer-match/seller-quality in equilibrium, these models often abstract from the coexistence of sponsored and organic listings. We develop a model in which sellers can appear in both sponsored and organic positions and examine how this affects equilibrium outcomes and consumer welfare. Our model captures a key tradeoff: high-quality sellers value the visibility from sponsored placement but also expect to appear prominently in organic rankings. As a result, under certain conditions, lower-quality sellers may outbid them to obtain the sponsored position-lending some support to the FTC's concern. However, we show that this outcome only arises when all sellers are relatively high-quality, which limits potential consumer harm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线搜索平台中赞助广告与自然排名的共存如何影响均衡结果和消费者福利。研究发现，在某些条件下，低质量卖家可能出价超过高质量卖家获得赞助位置，但这仅在所有卖家质量都较高时发生，限制了潜在的消费者损害。
AI.research_question: 当卖家可以同时出现在赞助广告和自然排名位置时，这会如何影响均衡结果和消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 近期监管行动（如FTC诉亚马逊反垄断案）引发了对在线搜索平台中赞助广告对消费者福利影响的担忧。传统的拍卖理论模型通常假设卖家按消费者匹配度/卖家质量排名，但这些模型往往忽略了赞助广告和自然排名的共存。
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置拍卖理论、卖家质量差异模型、赞助广告与有机排名共存框架
AI.method: 理论建模方法，开发了一个卖家可以同时出现在赞助广告和自然排名位置的模型，分析均衡结果
AI.findings: 1. 高质量卖家重视赞助位置的可见性，但也期望在自然排名中占据显著位置；2. 在某些条件下，低质量卖家可能出价超过高质量卖家获得赞助位置，这支持了FTC的担忧；3. 但这种结果仅在所有卖家质量都相对较高时才会出现，从而限制了潜在的消费者损害
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了位置拍卖理论，考虑了赞助广告和自然排名的共存；2. 揭示了卖家质量与竞价行为之间的新关系；3. 为监管担忧提供了理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构（如FTC）提供了分析在线平台广告对消费者影响的理论工具；2. 帮助平台设计更有效的广告拍卖机制；3. 为政策制定者评估平台竞争政策提供参考

title: The Relationship Between Indigenous Pastoralist Resource Tenure and State Tenure in Somalia

detail.title: The Relationship Between Indigenous Pastoralist Resource Tenure and State Tenure in Somalia
detail.abstract: Indigenous resource tenure systems in Africa have evolved to meet the constraints and opportunities of often difficult biophysical environments, while facilitating the operation of complex spatial and temporal land use patterns. Traditional systems provide security of tenure in culturally relevant ways that permit adaptation to new circumstances. On the other hand imposed tenure structures in Africa have often not strengthened individual rights and have often blocked indigenous tenure development and adaptation in response to new situations. Pastoralists in Africa have in particular been negatively impacted by the imposition of national tenure systems which in many cases have served to marginalize nomadic populations, with repercussions in land degradation, food security, and instability. In Somalia the transient resource rights and resource use arrangements that are critical to transhumant pastoralism were ignored in the formulation of the national tenure regime which favored crop cultivation. The results were increased land degradation, resource use conflicts, declines in pastoral production, and impacts on Somali clan alliances which in many cases regulate rational resource access and use. Somalia posses the greatest proportion of pastoralists in Africa. Transhumant pastoralism, as the most widespread agricultural enterprise in the country, will play a critical role in food production for the foreseeable future. However the relationship between indigenous pastoralist tenure and state imposed tenure, has in many locations decreased the ability of pastoralism to reproduce itself, thereby compromising the rational utilization of very large areas of rangeland interior, which have very few alternative uses.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了非洲土著资源权属系统与政府强加的土地权属制度之间的冲突，特别关注索马里的游牧民族。研究发现，忽视传统游牧权属制度会导致土地退化、资源冲突和生产下降。
AI.research_question: 国家强加的土地权属制度如何影响非洲土著游牧民族的资源使用权和土地管理实践？
AI.motivation: 非洲土著资源权属系统已适应恶劣的生物物理环境，但政府强加的权属制度往往阻碍传统系统的发展，特别是对游牧民族造成负面影响，导致土地退化、粮食安全和稳定问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土著资源权属理论、制度变迁理论、土地权属与资源管理关系理论、游牧生态学理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和案例研究分析，特别是索马里案例，比较土著权属系统与国家权属制度的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 土著权属系统能灵活适应环境变化，而国家强加的制度往往阻碍这种适应；2. 索马里忽视游牧权属导致土地退化、资源冲突和生产力下降；3. 传统氏族联盟在调节合理资源使用中起关键作用；4. 权属冲突损害了游牧业的可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了土著权属系统适应性的理论理解；2. 揭示了制度冲突对资源管理的负面影响机制；3. 提出了游牧权属与土地退化关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供整合传统权属系统的建议；2. 帮助改善游牧民族的资源使用权；3. 为减少土地退化和资源冲突提供实践指导；4. 支持非洲游牧业的可持续发展。

title: Learning-Based Portfolio Policies: Risk-Sensitive Control, Distributional Stability, and Representation Geometry

detail.title: Learning-Based Portfolio Policies: Risk-Sensitive Control, Distributional Stability, and Representation Geometry
detail.abstract: We develop a mathematical framework for learning-based portfolio policies in environments characterized by tail risk, distributional uncertainty, and high-capacity machine learning models. Rather than treating portfolio optimization as a static problem, we model learning systems as operators mapping observable information into predictive probability laws and study how portfolio policies act on these learned distributions. The analysis integrates risk-sensitive stochastic control, distributional stability, and representation geometry. We show that portfolio performance depends not only on predictive accuracy but also on stability of learned distributions and geometric properties of the representation manifold. In particular, distributional drift and curvature effects can induce nonlinear amplification of tail risk, leading to unstable policy behavior. The framework provides theoretical guidance for constructing robust learning-based portfolio policies and offers practical diagnostics for monitoring stability under regime shifts. The results position portfolio learning within a broader mathematical program linking stochastic control, optimal transport, and information geometry for robust financial decision-making. Disclaimer: The views and opinions expressed in this paper are solely those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the views of any affiliated institution, employer, or organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数学框架，用于分析在尾部风险、分布不确定性和高容量机器学习模型环境中的学习型投资组合策略。该框架将投资组合优化视为动态学习系统，研究策略如何作用于学习到的概率分布，并揭示性能不仅取决于预测准确性，还受分布稳定性和表示几何性质的影响。
AI.research_question: 在尾部风险、分布不确定性和高容量机器学习模型环境下，如何构建稳健的学习型投资组合策略？这些策略的性能如何受到学习系统的分布稳定性、表示几何性质以及环境动态变化的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合优化方法在面临尾部风险、分布不确定性和复杂机器学习模型时存在局限性。需要一个新的数学框架来理解学习系统如何将可观测信息映射到预测概率分布，以及投资组合策略如何作用于这些学习到的分布，特别是在动态变化的环境中保持稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险敏感随机控制、分布稳定性理论、表示几何学、最优传输理论、信息几何学。该框架将投资组合学习置于连接随机控制、最优传输和信息几何的更广泛数学程序中。
AI.method: 数学框架开发，将学习系统建模为从可观测信息到预测概率定律的算子，分析投资组合策略如何作用于学习到的分布。整合风险敏感随机控制、分布稳定性和表示几何的分析方法。
AI.findings: 投资组合性能不仅取决于预测准确性，还受到学习分布稳定性和表示流形几何性质的影响。分布漂移和曲率效应可能导致尾部风险的非线性放大，引发策略行为不稳定。框架为构建稳健学习型投资组合策略提供理论指导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了学习型投资组合策略的数学分析框架；2. 揭示了分布稳定性和表示几何对策略性能的关键影响；3. 将投资组合学习置于随机控制、最优传输和信息几何的交叉理论框架中；4. 识别了分布漂移和曲率效应导致尾部风险放大的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为构建稳健学习型投资组合策略提供理论指导；2. 提供监测制度转换下稳定性的实用诊断工具；3. 帮助从业者理解机器学习模型在动态金融环境中的行为特征；4. 为风险管理提供新的分析视角。

title: The Impact of Auction Timing on Bidding Behaviors: Evidence from the Chinese Land Market

detail.title: The Impact of Auction Timing on Bidding Behaviors: Evidence from the Chinese Land Market
detail.abstract: This study examines how changes in auction timing affect bidding behavior, using data from Chinese land market transactions. In 2021, a new policy mandated that 22 cities shift from sequential to simultaneous auctions for residential land. Using an event study approach, I find simultaneous auctions lead to higher prices and a greater auction failure rate. Additionally, I examine testable implications related to the mechanism behind the policy effect: auction prices rise more for higher-quality land and in cities with higher land quality variance; moreover, the auction failure rate increases more for lower-quality land. I then developed a model of bidding that rationalizes my main findings and offers some policy suggestions.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国土地市场数据，分析了拍卖时间安排从顺序拍卖改为同时拍卖对竞价行为的影响，发现同时拍卖导致价格更高、流拍率增加，并建立了理论模型解释这些现象。
AI.research_question: 拍卖时间安排（顺序拍卖vs同时拍卖）如何影响竞价行为和拍卖结果？
AI.motivation: 2021年中国22个城市实施新政策，要求住宅用地拍卖从顺序拍卖改为同时拍卖，这为研究拍卖时间安排对市场行为的影响提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拍卖理论、竞价行为理论、事件研究法
AI.method: 事件研究法，利用政策变化作为自然实验，分析中国土地市场交易数据
AI.findings: 同时拍卖导致：1) 拍卖价格更高；2) 流拍率增加；3) 高质量土地价格上升更明显；4) 土地质量方差大的城市价格上升更明显；5) 低质量土地流拍率增加更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了能够解释同时拍卖效应的竞价模型，为拍卖时间安排的理论研究提供了新的实证证据和理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于拍卖时间安排影响的实证依据，提出了具体的政策建议，有助于优化土地拍卖制度设计

title: Introduction to The Public Pension Crisis: Contractual Rights and Constitutional Limits
affiliations: Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Introduction to The Public Pension Crisis: Contractual Rights and Constitutional Limits
detail.abstract: This book critically examines the legal challenges surrounding public pensions, focusing on the Contract Clause and its role in pension reform. An ideal resource for legal scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and professionals, it analyzes over 70 cases, presenting a unified contract theory to balance employee benefits and government flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本书批判性地审视了公共养老金的法理挑战，聚焦于合同条款在养老金改革中的作用，通过分析70多个案例提出统一合同理论来平衡雇员福利与政府灵活性。
AI.research_question: 合同条款如何在公共养老金改革中发挥作用？如何通过统一合同理论平衡雇员养老金权益与政府财政灵活性？
AI.motivation: 公共养老金面临日益严峻的财政压力和法律挑战，需要找到既能保障雇员权益又能维持政府财政可持续性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同条款理论、统一合同理论、养老金法理框架、政府契约责任理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，系统分析70多个相关法律案例，进行法理比较和理论构建
AI.findings: 合同条款在养老金改革中具有关键作用，统一合同理论能够有效平衡雇员权益与政府财政需求，为养老金改革提供法理依据
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一合同理论框架，深化了合同条款在养老金领域的法理理解，为养老金改革提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律学者、从业者、政策制定者提供实用的分析框架，帮助平衡养老金权益与财政可持续性，指导养老金改革实践

title: Refugee Resettlement on the Horn of Africa: The Integration of Host and Refugee Land-Use Patterns

detail.title: Refugee Resettlement on the Horn of Africa: The Integration of Host and Refugee Land-Use Patterns
detail.abstract: The enormity of the African refugee problem underscores the importance of resettlement issues in land use planning. Efforts to resettle subsistence-oriented agricultural populations have often come into conflict with host, or in-place land uses as competition for scarce resources lead to land degradation, violence, and the failure of resettlement schemes. The success of refugee resettlement will depend to a large extent on the degree to which host and refugee land-use patterns can become integrated or reconciled. The majority of African refugee populations reside on the Horn and in the Sahel, where arid and semi-arid ecologies predominate and pastoralism is a major form of land-use. This study considers a resettlement design which integrates refugee agricultural land-use patterns with those of the host pastoralist land-use in the context of the frequent droughts which visit the area. Given the magnitude of dislocation problems on the continent, successful resettlement will play an important role in African agriculture and development.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨如何整合难民农业土地利用模式与东道主牧民土地利用模式，以解决非洲干旱地区难民安置中的土地冲突和资源竞争问题。
AI.research_question: 在非洲干旱和半干旱地区，如何设计难民安置方案，使难民农业土地利用模式与东道主牧民土地利用模式有效整合，以应对频繁干旱并减少资源竞争冲突？
AI.motivation: 非洲难民问题严重，难民安置常因与东道主土地利用模式冲突导致土地退化、暴力冲突和安置计划失败，特别是在干旱的非洲之角和萨赫勒地区，难民农业与牧民土地利用的整合对成功安置至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地利用整合理论、资源竞争理论、难民安置理论、干旱地区可持续发展理论。
AI.method: 研究采用案例分析方法，在非洲之角和萨赫勒地区干旱生态背景下，分析难民农业与牧民土地利用模式的整合设计。
AI.findings: 成功的难民安置在很大程度上取决于东道主和难民土地利用模式能否有效整合或协调，特别是在干旱地区，整合农业和牧业土地利用模式可以减少资源竞争、土地退化和暴力冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了干旱地区难民安置的土地利用整合理论框架，丰富了资源竞争和冲突管理理论在难民研究中的应用，为跨文化土地利用协调提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲干旱地区难民安置提供了具体的土地利用整合设计方案，有助于减少安置冲突、提高安置成功率，对非洲农业发展和区域稳定具有重要实践意义。

title: Restocking Refugee Pastoralists on the Horn of Africa

detail.title: Restocking Refugee Pastoralists on the Horn of Africa
detail.abstract: Repeated and lingering famine on the Horn of Africa has produced enormous pastoralist refugee populations in a region where livestock production is a major form of land use. Permanently settling destitute pastoralists into pursuits other than herding has a record of failure, can disrupt host land-uses causing social and ecological problems, and can deny utilization of very large grazing areas where pastoralism may be the only ecologically and economically sustainable land-use. Herd reconstitution needs to be considered an option in relief and rehabilitation programs for pastoralists. This paper examines a design where the most proven and immediate way of sustaining stockless pastoralists-farming-can be used to facilitate restocking objectives. With data gathered in Somalia, estimates of livestock carrying capacity are linked with: characteristics of forage resources, land area, livestock units, and frequency of good, average, and poor (drought) water years, in order to explore the possibilities for incorporating restocking into refugee rehabilitation efforts.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨如何将畜群重建纳入非洲之角牧民难民的恢复计划中，通过农业活动支持牧民重新获得牲畜，实现可持续的土地利用。
AI.research_question: 如何将畜群重建（restocking）纳入非洲之角牧民难民的恢复计划中，使其成为可行的选择？
AI.motivation: 非洲之角反复发生的饥荒导致大量牧民成为难民，永久性安置牧民从事非畜牧业活动往往失败，会破坏当地土地利用模式，并浪费大片仅适合畜牧业的土地资源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续土地利用理论、牧民生计恢复理论、畜牧业承载力与资源管理理论。
AI.method: 使用索马里收集的数据，将牲畜承载力估计与以下因素联系起来：饲料资源特征、土地面积、牲畜单位、以及良好、平均和干旱年份的频率，以探索将畜群重建纳入难民恢复工作的可能性。
AI.findings: 通过将农业活动作为支持手段，可以促进畜群重建目标，使牧民难民能够重新获得牲畜并恢复可持续的畜牧业生计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将畜群重建作为牧民难民恢复计划可行选择的框架，挑战了传统永久性安置模式，强调畜牧业在特定生态区域的经济和生态可持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为援助机构提供了具体的操作方案，将农业支持与畜群重建相结合，帮助牧民难民恢复生计，同时保护当地生态系统的可持续性。

title: Management of Spatially Extensive Natural Resources in Postwar Contexts: Working with the Peace Process

detail.title: Management of Spatially Extensive Natural Resources in Postwar Contexts: Working with the Peace Process
detail.abstract: While extensively occurring natural resources play a fundamental role in the survival and recovery of postwar populations, their management is not presently part of the operational priorities in a peace process. Dependence on naturally occurring food, fuel, water, secure locations, and products that can be obtained and sold quickly for dislocated, war-weary populations is a primary approach to postwar livelihoods. The peace process however focuses on the logistical and institutional aspects of security, demobilization, reintegration and humanitarian efforts. The result is profound degradation of the spatially extensive resources necessary for longer-term recovery. The primary reason for the inattention to resource degradation in a peace process is that conventional conservation approaches do not fit with the priorities of a peace process or attend to the immediate needs of a postwar population; designed as they are for stable, peaceful settings. This article focuses on the need to derive postwar natural resource management approaches which can work with the in-place priorities of a peace process. Four such approaches are suggested, with successful examples from specific countries.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出和平进程忽视自然资源管理，导致战后恢复所需资源退化，并提出四种与和平进程优先事项兼容的自然资源管理方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在和平进程中有效管理自然资源以支持战后长期恢复？
AI.motivation: 和平进程当前关注安全、复员、重返社会和后勤等人道主义努力，却忽视了自然资源管理，导致战后人口赖以生存的自然资源退化，影响长期恢复。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战后恢复理论、自然资源管理理论、和平进程理论，以及传统保护方法与战后环境不匹配的理论分析。
AI.method: 概念性分析，基于现有文献和案例研究，提出理论框架和具体方法建议。
AI.findings: 和平进程忽视自然资源管理导致资源退化；传统保护方法不适合战后环境；需要开发与和平进程优先事项兼容的自然资源管理方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自然资源管理纳入和平进程理论框架，提出战后自然资源管理的理论创新，挑战传统保护方法的适用性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四种具体的战后自然资源管理方法，提供成功国家案例作为实践参考，为和平进程设计者提供可操作建议。

title: An Examined Education
affiliations: School of Social and Political Sciences, University of Lincoln

detail.title: An Examined Education
detail.abstract: What is the value of tests in education? Encouraging learning and establishing merit are traditional justifications for stressful ordeals such as competitive examinations. Some critics argue that these approaches negatively impact students' well-being and do not represent essential experiences for future life and work. As a result, higher education in the United Kingdom has seen less attention on proven knowledge acquisition and formal testing in favour of alternative modes of coursework assessment perceived to be less stressful and, therefore, more accessible. Drawing on Adam Smith's moral psychology from The Theory of Moral Sentiments, this article argues that this understandable drive to reduce unpleasant experiences associated with learning denies students important opportunities to mature as well as the pleasure associated with clearly demonstrating one's educational achievement.

AI.tldr: 本文基于亚当·斯密的道德心理学，论证了考试在教育中的价值，认为减少考试压力虽然可理解，但剥夺了学生成熟和展示成就的机会。
AI.research_question: 考试在教育中的价值是什么？减少考试压力是否对学生发展有益？
AI.motivation: 英国高等教育中减少正式考试、采用替代性课程评估的趋势，以及关于考试压力对学生福祉影响的争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密《道德情操论》中的道德心理学理论。
AI.method: 理论分析，基于亚当·斯密道德心理学框架对考试价值进行哲学论证。
AI.findings: 考试不仅促进学习、建立功绩，还为学生提供重要的成熟机会和展示教育成就的愉悦感。减少考试压力可能剥夺这些重要体验。
AI.theory_contributions: 将亚当·斯密的道德心理学应用于教育评估领域，为考试的传统价值提供新的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒教育政策制定者重新思考减少考试的趋势，认识到考试对学生成熟和发展的积极价值。

title: Reclaiming Finance: Taming Capital and Human Nature Through the "Institutional Cage"-A Theoretical Analysis from the Perspective of Human Nature Institutionalism
affiliations: and Soochow University

detail.title: Reclaiming Finance: Taming Capital and Human Nature Through the "Institutional Cage"-A Theoretical Analysis from the Perspective of Human Nature Institutionalism
detail.abstract: In response to Professor Wang Defeng's controversial assertion that "finance is an evil discipline", this paper adopts China's indigenous original theory of Human Nature Institutionalism as the analytical framework to systematically deconstruct the neutral essence and alienation logic of financial instruments, and deepen the core consensus that "tools are neither good nor evil; morality lies in humans and institutions". Human Nature Institutionalism takes "short-sightedness, self-interest and risk aversion" as its core axiom, integrates behavioral economics, institutional economics and evolutionary psychology, and constructs a complete theoretical system of "axiom-theorem-tool". The study finds that the essence of financial alienation lies in the malicious inducement of human nature by financial institutions through the "benefit perception function" in the absence of institutional constraints; the key to breaking the dilemma is to build a collaborative governance system featuring "macrolevel anti-empty-promising, meso-level damping optimization, micro-level combination of rigidity and flexibility, and statutory human nature review". Through in-depth deconstruction of Collateralized Debt Obligation (CDO) products and case analysis of the "Five-Pillar Supervision" system implemented by the National Financial Regulatory Administration, this paper verifies the explanatory power and practicality of the theory. Furthermore, aiming at the problem of algorithmic short-sightedness in the era of financial technology, it proposes the "algorithmic damping" mechanism and AI-assisted regulatory solutions. The core contribution of this study is to deeply integrate indigenous original theory with financial governance practices, provide an operable institutional framework for finance to "promote good and curb evil", and offer a non-Western-centric Chinese solution for global financial governance.

AI.tldr: 本文以人性制度主义为分析框架，系统解构金融工具的中性本质与异化逻辑，提出"宏观反空诺、中观阻尼优化、微观刚柔并济、法定人性审查"的协同治理体系，为金融"扬善抑恶"提供可操作的制度框架。
AI.research_question: 金融工具如何从"中性"本质走向"异化"？如何构建有效的制度框架使金融"扬善抑恶"？
AI.motivation: 回应王德峰教授"金融是邪恶学科"的争议性论断，探讨金融工具的本质属性及其异化机制，为金融治理提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人性制度主义（Human Nature Institutionalism），以"短视、自利、风险规避"为核心公理，整合行为经济学、制度经济学和演化心理学，构建"公理-定理-工具"的完整理论体系。
AI.method: 理论分析与案例研究相结合：1）系统解构担保债务凭证（CDO）产品；2）分析国家金融监督管理总局实施的"五支柱监管"体系案例；3）理论验证与方案设计。
AI.findings: 金融异化的本质在于制度约束缺失时，金融机构通过"利益感知函数"恶意诱导人性；破解困境的关键在于构建"宏观反空诺、中观阻尼优化、微观刚柔并济、法定人性审查"的协同治理体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化"工具无善恶，道德在人与制度"的核心共识；2）将本土原创理论与金融治理实践深度融合；3）为非西方中心的全球金融治理提供中国方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出针对金融科技时代算法短视问题的"算法阻尼"机制和AI辅助监管方案；2）为金融"扬善抑恶"提供可操作的制度框架；3）验证人性制度主义理论的解释力和实用性。

title: The Impact of Flood Risk on England's Property Market
affiliations: and City University London - The Business School

detail.title: The Impact of Flood Risk on England's Property Market
detail.abstract:
• Based on our sample, one out of six properties in England are at risk of flooding and around half of those affected properties can be characterised as high risk. This is in line with current insurance underwriting assessments. 

• Findings show that residential properties in England with flood risk are sold at a 8.14% discount compared to non-affected properties. The level of the price discount is strongly correlated with the probability of flood risk. The price discount reaches 31.3% for very high risk properties. 

• The average flood risk of sold properties in the England between 2006 and 2021 is estimated at 8.01 per cent, compared to unsold property flood risk of 8.63 per cent. Zero exposure to flooding increases the saleability of a property from 63.3 per cent to 65.6 per cent, however flood risk is never the main driver of a sale. 

• The regions most exposed to flood risk are East Anglia, North West and Yorkshire, where around 13%-18% of properties are affected. In terms of property types, semi-detached and terraced houses are more vulnerable to flooding since any temporary protection measures, such as blocking doors, windows, vents and pipes, will not be effective unless their neighbours take similar steps. 

• Between 2050 and 2080, property-level flood risk is projected to increase further by 8%. Our empirical model suggests that one percentage point increase in properties’ flood risk is associated with a decline of 0.11-0.19% in both sold and asking price. 

• Our results suggest that market participants tend to underestimate the probability of flooding. Therefore, after periods of extreme weather events the one percentage point increase in flood risk results in a greater price discount (0.17 - 0.20%) for a short period. 

• The research also confirms that the effect of flood risk is asymmetric and buyers of lower-priced properties are more sensitive towards flood risk compared to buyers of more expensive properties. A one percentage point increase in flood risk is associated with 0.16% discount in properties priced within the lower quantile of the sample, 0.13% for properties priced around the sample median and 0.10% for properties priced within the upper quantile of the sample.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了英格兰房地产洪水风险对房价的影响，发现六分之一的房产面临洪水风险，高风险房产占受影响房产的一半。洪水风险导致房价平均折扣8.14%，极端高风险房产折扣达31.3%。市场参与者倾向于低估洪水概率，极端天气事件后短期内价格折扣会更大。洪水风险对低价房产影响更大，且半独立和联排房屋更易受洪水影响。
AI.research_question: 洪水风险如何影响英格兰房地产的价格和销售性？市场参与者对洪水风险的认知如何影响定价？不同房产类型和价格区间的洪水风险敏感性有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，洪水风险对房地产市场的影响日益显著。了解洪水风险如何影响房价、销售性以及市场参与者的风险认知，对于房地产投资者、保险公司、政策制定者和购房者都具有重要实践意义。当前研究需要量化洪水风险的经济影响并揭示市场行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论和风险溢价理论，洪水风险应反映在房地产价格中。行为经济学视角下，市场参与者可能存在风险认知偏差。信息不对称理论解释不同价格区间房产对风险敏感度的差异。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用2006-2021年英格兰房地产交易数据，结合洪水风险概率数据。采用回归分析量化洪水风险对房价的影响，比较已售和未售房产的洪水风险差异，分析不同区域、房产类型和价格区间的敏感性差异。
AI.findings: 1. 六分之一房产面临洪水风险，高风险占一半；2. 洪水风险房产平均折扣8.14%，极端高风险折扣31.3%；3. 洪水风险降低销售性，但非主要驱动因素；4. 东盎格鲁、西北和约克郡风险最高；5. 半独立和联排房屋更易受洪水影响；6. 市场低估洪水概率，极端天气后折扣更大；7. 低价房产对洪水风险更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了洪水风险在房地产定价中的具体影响程度；2. 揭示了市场参与者对洪水风险的系统性低估现象；3. 证明了洪水风险影响的非对称性，低价房产更敏感；4. 提供了气候变化风险在资产定价中的实证证据；5. 拓展了行为经济学在房地产风险认知中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为房地产投资者提供洪水风险定价参考；2. 帮助保险公司改进风险评估模型；3. 为购房者提供风险意识教育；4. 协助政策制定者制定洪水风险管理政策；5. 为城市规划提供洪水风险区域化建议；6. 为房地产估价师提供风险调整方法。

title: Finite-Sample Long-Memory Estimation via Detectability Boundaries
affiliations: Fordham University

detail.title: Finite-Sample Long-Memory Estimation via Detectability Boundaries
detail.abstract: We propose a finite-sample framework for removing long-range dependence in equity log-price series based on a detectability boundary dLTM: the largest fractional differencing order at which hyperbolic ACF tail structure remains statistically distinguishable from noise. Under stationary ARFIMA dynamics, dLTM satisfies dLTM ≈ d* −d0, where d* is the true fractional integration order and d0 is a finite-sample resolution limit. Monte Carlo calibration yields the scaling law for ARFIMA ^d0(T) = 5.81·T−0.367 (R2 = 0.999), with d0 = 0.30 at T = 3,200 and d0 = 0.20 at T =10,000. In market data, regime heterogeneity and volatility clustering make d0 persistence estimator instead of true memory, making dLTM a reliable differencing index in practice. Applied to the S&P 500 universe over 2010–2020, dLTM is estimated on a rolling n = 2,400 window and evaluated monthly against a fixed d = 0.5 benchmark across 484 assets. dLTM produces whiter AR(1) residuals in 70–90% of assets at every evaluation date over a full decade. The win rate rises monotonically from near 50% when dLTM ≈ 0.5 to 97–100% in the quartile where the two approaches diverge most, and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test rejects equality at p <0.0001 at every date. Results hold broadly across sectors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个有限样本框架dLTM，用于消除股票对数价格序列中的长程依赖性。dLTM是可检测边界，即双曲ACF尾部结构在统计上仍可与噪声区分开的最大分数差分阶数。在ARFIMA动态下，dLTM ≈ d* - d0，其中d*是真实分数积分阶数，d0是有限样本分辨率限制。应用于S&P 500数据时，dLTM在70-90%的资产中产生更白的AR(1)残差。
AI.research_question: 如何基于有限样本框架有效消除股票对数价格序列中的长程依赖性？
AI.motivation: 传统方法在处理金融时间序列的长程依赖性时存在局限性，特别是在有限样本条件下。需要开发一个可靠的差分指数来实际应用中有效去除长程记忆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ARFIMA（自回归分数积分移动平均）模型和分数差分理论，提出可检测边界dLTM概念，即双曲自相关函数尾部结构在统计上仍可与噪声区分开的最大分数差分阶数。
AI.method: 1. 蒙特卡洛校准建立ARFIMA模型的缩放定律；2. 在S&P 500成分股2010-2020年数据上应用滚动窗口（n=2,400）估计dLTM；3. 每月评估484个资产，与固定d=0.5基准比较；4. 使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验统计显著性。
AI.findings: 1. 蒙特卡洛校准得到缩放定律：d0(T) = 5.81·T^(-0.367) (R²=0.999)；2. 在S&P 500数据中，dLTM在70-90%的资产中产生更白的AR(1)残差；3. 胜率从dLTM≈0.5时的近50%单调上升到两种方法差异最大时的97-100%；4. Wilcoxon检验在每个日期都拒绝相等性(p<0.0001)；5. 结果在各行业间广泛成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了有限样本框架下的可检测边界dLTM概念；2. 建立了ARFIMA模型中d0与样本量T的缩放定律；3. 区分了真实记忆与d0持久性估计器在存在制度异质性和波动率聚类时的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了实际应用中可靠的差分指数dLTM；2. 在S&P 500数据中证明dLTM优于固定d=0.5基准；3. 为金融时间序列分析和风险管理提供了有效的长程依赖性去除工具；4. 方法适用于各种资产和行业。

title: Wage Flexibility, Trend Inflation, and Welfare in a Currency Union
affiliations: University of Melbourne and University of Southampton

detail.title: Wage Flexibility, Trend Inflation, and Welfare in a Currency Union
detail.abstract: This paper revisits the welfare consequences of wage flexibility in a currency union model in which member countries face limited monetary autonomy. Earlier studies conclude that, under a zero inflation target, greater wage flexibility can be welfare-reducing because it increases the volatility of price and wage inflation. However, we show that this result reverses when the inflation target is positive. We find that trend inflation affects the welfare consequences of wage flexibility primarily through changes in the constant term capturing the steady-state utility cost arising from price and wage dispersion, rather than through changes in volatilities. Greater wage flexibility reduces this steady-state cost, which dominates the increased welfare losses associated with higher price and wage inflation volatility. This result holds in both a simple analytical model and a medium-scale model with realistic features.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了货币联盟中工资灵活性的福利效应。传统观点认为，在零通胀目标下，工资灵活性增加会降低福利，因为它增加了价格和工资通胀的波动性。但本文发现，当通胀目标为正时，这一结论会逆转：工资灵活性增加反而提高福利，因为它减少了价格和工资分散带来的稳态效用成本，这一效应超过了通胀波动性增加带来的福利损失。
AI.research_question: 在货币联盟中，当通胀目标为正时，工资灵活性如何影响福利？
AI.motivation: 先前研究认为在零通胀目标下，工资灵活性增加会降低福利，因为增加了价格和工资通胀的波动性。但这一结论在正通胀目标下是否成立？需要重新审视工资灵活性的福利效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币联盟理论、新凯恩斯主义模型、工资和价格刚性理论、福利分析框架
AI.method: 使用简单的分析模型和具有现实特征的中等规模模型进行理论分析和数值模拟
AI.findings: 1. 在正通胀目标下，工资灵活性增加会提高福利；2. 趋势通胀主要通过改变价格和工资分散带来的稳态效用成本来影响福利，而非通过波动性变化；3. 工资灵活性减少稳态成本，这一效应超过了通胀波动性增加带来的福利损失
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统关于工资灵活性福利效应的观点；2. 揭示了趋势通胀在调节工资灵活性福利效应中的关键作用；3. 阐明了稳态效用成本机制的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币联盟政策制定者提供了关于工资灵活性的新见解；2. 表明在正通胀目标下，促进工资灵活性可能是有益的；3. 有助于设计更有效的劳动力市场政策

title: Harvest FIRE: Increasing Lifetime Consumption by 25-60% Without Increasing Ruin Risk

detail.title: Harvest FIRE: Increasing Lifetime Consumption by 25-60% Without Increasing Ruin Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human subjects. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Conventional retirement withdrawal research has focused on minimizing portfolio ruin probability, treating survival as the primary success criterion. However, a portfolio that survives 30 years with substantial residual wealth implies systematic underspendingconsumption capacity that was generated but never utilized. This paper introduces Harvest FIRE, a dynamic withdrawal framework that redefines retirement optimization as a constrained consumption-maximization problem. The framework operates on a predominantly equity portfolio with a cash buffer and incorporates three mechanisms: (1) a guaranteed base withdrawal of 4% of initial wealth, inflation-adjusted, which serves as a consumption floor rather than a ceiling; (2) a performance-based bonus that transfers surplus above a linear depletion path into consumption, at reward ratios of 15-30%; and (3) a user-defined depletion slope that converts terminal wealth from an uncontrolled residual into a design variable. An optional Seeding mechanism redeploys cash reserves into equities following large drawdowns, exploiting the statistical tendency for above-average returns after market declines. While equity concentration increases short-term portfolio volatility, the framework absorbs this through consumption flexibility and the cash buffer rather than asset-allocation shifts. Using 20,000 Monte Carlo simulations and 47 rolling 30-year historical back-tests of S&P 500 total-return data (1950-2024), we compare five strategies: the traditional 4% rule (60/40), a three-layer bucket strategy, and three Harvest variants (15%, 30%, and 30% with Seeding). Harvest strategies increase median lifetime consumption by 22-53% in Monte Carlo simulations and by 24-64% in historical backtests, while maintaining comparable success rates. Terminal-wealth variance is markedly reduced under all Harvest variants, indicating more efficient conversion of assets into lifetime consumption. Our findings suggest that exclusive reliance on ruin minimization may overlook an equally important dimension of retirement risk: systematic underspending.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Harvest FIRE动态提取框架，将退休规划从最小化投资组合破产概率重新定义为约束条件下的消费最大化问题。通过结合保证基础提取、绩效奖金和用户定义的耗尽斜率等机制，该框架在保持类似成功率的同时，将中位终身消费提高了22-64%，显著降低了终端财富方差。
AI.research_question: 如何重新定义退休提取优化问题，从最小化投资组合破产概率转向最大化终身消费，同时控制风险？
AI.motivation: 传统退休提取研究过度关注最小化投资组合破产概率，将生存作为主要成功标准。然而，一个存活30年但仍有大量剩余财富的投资组合意味着系统性的消费不足——生成了消费能力但从未被利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: Harvest FIRE动态提取框架，将退休优化重新定义为约束条件下的消费最大化问题。核心理论包括：消费最大化而非破产最小化、动态调整提取策略、利用市场统计特性（如市场下跌后的超额回报趋势）。
AI.method: 使用20,000次蒙特卡洛模拟和47个滚动30年历史回测（1950-2024年标普500总回报数据）。比较五种策略：传统4%规则（60/40）、三层桶策略，以及三种Harvest变体（15%、30%和30%带Seeding机制）。
AI.findings: Harvest策略在蒙特卡洛模拟中将中位终身消费提高了22-53%，在历史回测中提高了24-64%，同时保持可比的成功率。所有Harvest变体都显著降低了终端财富方差，表明资产向终身消费的转换更加高效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将退休提取优化重新定义为约束条件下的消费最大化问题；2. 提出系统性消费不足是重要的退休风险维度；3. 开发了动态提取框架，将终端财富从不可控残值转变为设计变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为退休人员提供了提高终身消费的具体策略；2. 通过保证基础提取提供消费底线；3. 通过绩效奖金机制将超额收益转化为即时消费；4. 通过Seeding机制利用市场下跌后的统计特性；5. 在保持成功率的同时显著改善消费结果。

title: WTO's Dispute Settlement, MPIA, and India
affiliations: Jindal Global Law School, O P Jindal Global University  and University of Sussex

detail.title: WTO's Dispute Settlement, MPIA, and India

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of World Trade, Volume 60, Issue 3/4 (forthcoming)

detail.abstract: The establishment of a two-tier dispute settlement system at the WTO has significantly judicialized international trade relations. However, this process is currently hindered by the Appellate Body's dysfunction. In the absence of the Appellate Body, the Multi-Party Interim Arbitration (MPIA) Arrangement is partially bridging the gap. This MPIA initiative aims to restore the WTO's two-tier dispute settlement system and has recently gained traction, garnering support from 57 countries. However, India, a crucial developing-country member, has not joined the MPIA, despite its ongoing call for the restoration of the Appellate Body. Most of India's concerns regarding the MPIA do not hold up under scrutiny. Contrary to India's argument, joining the MPIA would not diminish its position in advocating for the restoration of the Appellate Body. Furthermore, although the United States-India's key trading partneris not a member of the MPIA, India can still invoke the MPIA in disputes with other significant players, such as the European Union and Japan. As the multilateral trading system faces increasing challenges, countries like India need to build alliances and develop innovative solutions. Supporting the MPIA is one such step toward restoring the WTO's judicial function and should be embraced by India.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了印度为何未加入WTO多边临时仲裁安排（MPIA），驳斥了印度的担忧，认为印度加入MPIA不会削弱其恢复上诉机构的立场，且即使美国未加入，印度仍可在与其他重要贸易伙伴的争端中使用MPIA。
AI.research_question: 为什么印度作为关键的发展中国家成员，尽管持续呼吁恢复WTO上诉机构，却未加入多边临时仲裁安排（MPIA）？
AI.motivation: WTO上诉机构功能失调导致两级争端解决机制受阻，MPIA作为临时替代方案获得57国支持，但印度这一重要发展中国家未加入，需要分析其原因和合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际组织司法化理论、争端解决机制设计理论、发展中国家在国际贸易体系中的战略选择理论。
AI.method: 规范性分析和政策论证，通过逻辑推理和事实分析驳斥印度的担忧。
AI.findings: 1. 印度对MPIA的担忧经不起推敲；2. 加入MPIA不会削弱印度恢复上诉机构的立场；3. 即使美国未加入MPIA，印度仍可在与欧盟、日本等重要贸易伙伴的争端中使用该机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家在国际贸易争端解决机制改革中的战略选择理论，提供了分析国家参与多边机制决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度提供了具体的政策建议：应加入MPIA以恢复WTO司法功能，在多边贸易体系面临挑战时建立联盟和寻求创新解决方案。

title: The Collapse of the Shrimp Industry in Mozambique’s Coastal Triggered by the White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV): A Qualitative Case Study
affiliations: Universidade Eduardo Mondlane, Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, UEM, Universidade Eduardo Mondlane, Eduardo Mondlane University (UEM), Eduardo Mondlane University (UEM), Eduardo Mondlane University (UEM), Universidade Eduardo Mondlane, Universidade Eduardo Mondlane and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: The Collapse of the Shrimp Industry in Mozambique’s Coastal Triggered by the White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV): A Qualitative Case Study
detail.abstract:
