title: Equality of Opportunity and the Case for a Universal Child Allowance
affiliations: University of San Diego School of Law

detail.title: Equality of Opportunity and the Case for a Universal Child Allowance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

publicationDetails.detailsText: San Diego Legal Studies Paper No. 26-007
publicationDetails.journalName: University of San Diego Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The widespread popularity of equal opportunity ideals fuels strong public support for helping low-income children despite fierce debate over aid to adults. Yet key features of many current child benefit programs undermine that ideal, in part because policymakers muddy the waters with additional aims when crafting them. Programs for children get tangled up in disputes over aid to adults, undermining the goal of giving all children a fair shot at success. This Article untangles that knot by explicitly centering the child as the locus of our concern. Building on equal opportunity theory, it proposes a Universal Child Allowance (UCA) that provides unconditional, no-strings-attached cash grants to all children. Discarding work requirements means that the neediest children are no longer excluded, incorrectly deemed “at fault” for their plight; unrestricted cash allows parents to decide what their children need most. Notably, evidence from existing programs and past experiments suggests parents spend extra cash in ways that benefit their children and that they will not drop out of the labor force altogether or “blow” a UCA on themselves. 

At a time of heated polarization, the time is right to explore a UCA. Focusing on children avoids disputes that plague universal basic income proposals and reflects the renewed political focus on opportunities instead of outcomes. This comprehensive analysis of a UCA—the first in the law review literature—complements public policy work that advocates for such a benefit but does not address key design questions. Further, it contributes to scholarship on the tax and transfer system, poverty, and welfare by advancing our understanding of the relationship between a benefit program’s normative goals and structural design choices. And for both advocates and opponents of unconditional cash transfers, it offers a nuanced exploration of the debate surrounding welfare reform that promises a potential resolution of the enduring stalemate over restrictions on government aid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出建立"通用儿童津贴"(UCA)，为所有儿童提供无条件现金补助，以解决现有儿童福利计划因附加条件而未能实现机会平等的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够真正实现机会平等的儿童福利计划，避免现有计划因附加条件和与成人福利争议纠缠而失效？
AI.motivation: 尽管公众强烈支持帮助低收入儿童，但现有儿童福利计划因附加工作要求和与成人福利争议纠缠，实际上破坏了机会平等理想。政策制定者在设计时混入其他目标，导致最需要帮助的儿童被排除在外。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机会平等理论，强调儿童作为关注焦点，主张无条件现金转移的理论基础。
AI.method: 理论分析和政策设计研究，结合现有项目和过去实验的证据分析，对UCA进行综合法律和政策分析。
AI.findings: 证据表明父母会将额外现金用于有益儿童的开支，不会完全退出劳动力市场或挥霍资金。无条件现金补助能确保最需要帮助的儿童不被排除，同时让父母自主决定儿童需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在法律评论文献中对UCA进行全面分析，深化对福利计划规范性目标与结构设计选择之间关系的理解，为税收转移系统、贫困和福利研究做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为UCA提供具体设计方案，避免普遍基本收入提案的争议，聚焦儿童机会而非结果，为福利改革辩论提供潜在解决方案，打破政府援助限制的僵局。

title: When does Titling Informality lead to the Upgrading of Slums?

detail.title: When does Titling Informality lead to the Upgrading of Slums?

contentType.other: Policy paper written in fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of Master of Public Administration in International Development, Harvard Kennedy School.

detail.abstract:
This policy paper claims that formal and informal institutions should be taken into consideration when designing urban land-titling programs. This is true not only when granting titles, but also before and after such programs. Taking the experience of the largest land formalization program carried out in Peru by COFOPRI, this policy paper suggests that although the program was properly designed to map and legally recognize informal arrangements related with the allocation of land; COFOPRI overlooked other informal arrangements related with the use of land that led the formalized dwellings to become informal again. 

By qualitatively analyzing the existing formal and informal institutions in four squatter settlements in Lima, the author finds that much of the economic progress of a slum depends jointly on the following: 1) Informal institutions: Squatters’ organizations and plans after occupation occurs and title is issued. Squatters aim for government recognition and access to public services. When both demands are met, settlers’ informal institutions fine-tune towards aiming at doing business, getting jobs and leveraging capital. 2) Formal Institutions: Government recognition of slum and access to courts, police offices, microfinance institutions, municipality and property registration offices. Formal institutions shape the informal ones. When they are absent, informal institutions take on their responsibilities. When they are present, they must be fine-tuned to the informal ones to maintain the formalized land within formality and enhance the effects of the granting of title deeds. 

COFOPRI should coordinate the provision of the fine-tuned formal institutions and quality public services to the slums with the respective public and private agencies, as well as with community representatives. These policy measures would be: 1) Political supportable: The Peruvian population perceives COFOPRI as one of the most reliable government agencies. The proposed policies are grounded on the local necessities in the slums, and there are no major veto players. 2) Administrative feasible: COFOPRI already has expertise dealing with informal organizations. It needs to organize internally to be able to both identify which slums lack the most of access to formal institutions and public services and coordinate their provision. 3) Technically correct, because the expected economic benefits of carrying out land titling programs considering the relevance of informal and formal institutions would exceed the required additional budget.

AI.tldr: 这篇政策论文主张，在设计城市土地确权项目时，必须同时考虑正式和非正式制度，不仅在授予产权时，还包括确权前和确权后。通过对秘鲁COFOPRI实施的最大规模土地正规化项目的分析，作者发现尽管项目在测绘和承认土地分配方面的非正式安排上设计得当，但忽视了与土地使用相关的其他非正式安排，导致已正规化的住宅再次非正规化。
AI.research_question: 在实施城市土地确权项目时，如何通过协调正式和非正式制度来确保土地正规化的长期有效性，并促进贫民窟的经济发展？
AI.motivation: 秘鲁COFOPRI实施的大规模土地正规化项目虽然成功授予了产权，但许多已正规化的住宅却再次陷入非正规状态。这表明单纯的土地确权不足以维持正规化，需要更全面地考虑制度因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论，特别是正式制度与非正式制度的相互作用。正式制度包括政府机构、法院、警察、金融机构等；非正式制度包括居民组织、社区规范、使用土地的安排等。
AI.method: 定性分析，对利马四个贫民窟的现有正式和非正式制度进行案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 贫民窟的经济发展同时取决于正式和非正式制度；2. 非正式制度会随着居民需求变化而调整（从寻求政府认可转向商业活动）；3. 正式制度塑造非正式制度，当正式制度缺失时，非正式制度会承担其职责；4. 正式制度需要与非正式制度协调才能维持土地正规化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了土地正规化理论，强调确权前、中、后都需要考虑制度因素；2. 深化了对正式与非正式制度相互作用的理解；3. 提出了制度协调框架，解释为何单纯确权可能失败。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为COFOPRI提出具体政策建议：协调提供精细化正式制度和公共服务；2. 政策具有政治可行性、行政可操作性和技术正确性；3. 强调与社区代表合作的重要性；4. 提供评估贫民窟制度需求的框架。

title: How Markets Forecast and "Front Run" Information: Bayesian Market Efficiency

detail.title: How Markets Forecast and "Front Run" Information: Bayesian Market Efficiency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: A common and widely accepted conclusion in rational expectations models of financial reporting is that a scheduled report (e.g., the annual company earnings statement) can not affect the firm's stock price or cost of capital until the result is reported. I argue that Bayesian investors, rather than waiting, infer a probability distribution over what might be in the report and re-price the stock based on that probability distribution. To allow for their uncertainty about the report's content and the resulting stock price, the asset pricing formula includes a risk premium related strictly to the precision or quality of the firm's financial reporting. That premium can be positive or negative, which means that the firm can affect its cost of capital up or down by its choice of information system.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了理性预期模型中关于预定财务报告（如年度收益报表）在发布前不影响股价或资本成本的普遍结论。作者认为，贝叶斯投资者会基于对报告内容的概率分布推断来重新定价股票，从而在报告发布前就影响资本成本。
AI.research_question: 预定财务报告（如年度收益报表）在发布前是否会影响公司的股价和资本成本？如果是，这种影响如何通过财务报告质量体现？
AI.motivation: 传统理性预期模型普遍认为预定财务报告在发布前不影响股价或资本成本，但这一结论与现实观察不符。作者旨在解释为何财务报告质量在报告发布前就能影响资本成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯投资者行为和理性预期理论，结合信息经济学和资产定价理论，分析投资者如何通过概率推断在报告发布前重新定价股票。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含贝叶斯投资者、信息不确定性和风险溢价的资产定价模型，分析财务报告质量对资本成本的影响机制。
AI.findings: 贝叶斯投资者会在报告发布前基于对报告内容的概率分布推断来重新定价股票。资产定价公式中包含与财务报告精确度或质量相关的风险溢价，该溢价可为正或负，意味着公司可以通过选择信息系统来影响其资本成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统理性预期模型中关于预定报告在发布前不影响资本成本的结论；2. 将贝叶斯推断引入财务报告分析；3. 建立了财务报告质量与资本成本之间的理论联系；4. 解释了为何公司可以通过信息选择影响资本成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供了通过改善财务报告质量来降低资本成本的依据；2. 帮助投资者理解财务报告质量在投资决策中的重要性；3. 为监管机构制定财务报告标准提供了理论支持；4. 解释了高质量财务报告对资本市场的实际价值。

title: Bankruptcy Law, Creditor Rights, and Earnings Management in Distressed Indian Firms
affiliations: , Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Powai, Mumbai, India and SUNY College at Brockport

detail.title: Bankruptcy Law, Creditor Rights, and Earnings Management in Distressed Indian Firms
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of creditor rights on earnings management practices of financially distressed firms in India. Using the enactment of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) 2016 as a quasi-experiment and applying a difference-indifferences design, we investigate how enhanced creditor rights, resulting from this new bankruptcy regulation, affect the earnings management behaviours of financially distressed firms. We find that these firms significantly increase their income-increasing earnings management activities post-IBC implementation. We also document that the post-IBC increases in earnings management are less salient in firms with better corporate governance quality and also smaller among family firms than non-family firms. Our results remain robust across alternative measures and different estimation models. We reveal that bankruptcy law reforms influence managerial reporting incentives and highlight the roles of corporate governance and ownership structure in mitigating managerial opportunism and safeguarding creditor rights for listed and unlisted distressed firms in India.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了印度《破产与破产法》(IBC) 2016实施后，债权人权利增强对财务困境公司盈余管理行为的影响。研究发现，财务困境公司在IBC实施后显著增加了增加收入的盈余管理活动，但公司治理质量较好的企业以及家族企业的这种增加幅度较小。
AI.research_question: 债权人权利增强如何影响财务困境公司的盈余管理行为？
AI.motivation: 研究破产法改革对管理层报告激励的影响，特别是在印度这样的新兴市场环境中，了解债权人权利保护如何影响财务困境公司的会计行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、债权人权利理论、盈余管理理论，探讨破产法改革如何改变管理层与债权人之间的激励冲突，以及公司治理和所有权结构在其中的调节作用。
AI.method: 采用准实验设计，以《破产与破产法》(IBC) 2016的实施作为外生冲击，运用双重差分法(DID)分析债权人权利增强对财务困境公司盈余管理行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 财务困境公司在IBC实施后显著增加了增加收入的盈余管理活动；2. 公司治理质量较好的企业盈余管理增加幅度较小；3. 家族企业比非家族企业的盈余管理增加幅度更小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了破产法改革如何通过改变债权人权利影响管理层报告激励；2. 扩展了公司治理和所有权结构在缓解管理层机会主义中的作用；3. 为新兴市场中的债权人权利保护研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计破产法提供了实证依据；2. 为投资者和债权人评估财务困境公司风险提供了参考；3. 强调了公司治理和所有权结构在保护债权人利益中的重要性。

title: A Multi-method Econometric Analysis of SME Loan's Impacts on Women's Entrepreneurial Development in Bangladesh
affiliations: Bangladesh Institute of Capital Market , University of Dhaka and University of Dhaka

detail.title: A Multi-method Econometric Analysis of SME Loan's Impacts on Women's Entrepreneurial Development in Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no personal and financial relationship with other people or organizations that may influence the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Written consent is properly taken while doing survey with questionnaire. Apart from that, no ethical issues are concerned.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding is applicable

detail.abstract: The paper examines how the socioeconomic developments of women entrepreneurs in Bangladesh are influenced by small and medium enterprises (SMEs). An equal weighted composite index based on a quantitative cross-sectional survey design was employed on 489 women entrepreneurs borrowing SME loans to meet the objectives. The study employed methodologies such as OLS, quantile regression, bootstrapped regression, standardised beta regression, hierarchical regression, and moderation effects to test the hypotheses and check the robustness. Results indicate that access to loans and adequacy of loans have a positive influence on the socioeconomic development of women entrepreneurs. On the other hand, tight credit checks, excessive collateral requirements and lack of institutional support are growth inhibitors, particularly among lowincome individuals. The study has significant policy implications in that SME loans are significantly contributing to the socioeconomic welfare of the women entrepreneurs, and Loan factors impact mostly, while both age and education imply the variations across the benefits received from the SME loans. This paper adds value to the literature by examining the dynamics between financial inclusion and institutional support in determining the success of women entrepreneurs by leveraging rigorous econometric modelling. The study paves the way to further research and policy development with a focus on the absorption of SME benefits by optimising loan factors and institutional factors, similar to other emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了孟加拉国女性企业家的社会经济发展如何受到中小企业贷款的影响。研究发现贷款获取和充足性对女性企业家有积极影响，而严格的信贷审查、过高的抵押要求和缺乏机构支持则是增长障碍，尤其对低收入群体影响更大。
AI.research_question: 中小企业贷款如何影响孟加拉国女性企业家的社会经济发展？哪些贷款因素和机构因素促进或抑制了这种发展？
AI.motivation: 研究女性企业家在孟加拉国这样的新兴经济体中的社会经济发展，特别关注中小企业贷款的作用，以及金融包容性和机构支持如何影响她们的创业成功。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、机构支持理论、女性创业发展理论，以及中小企业贷款对经济发展的影响框架。
AI.method: 采用定量横断面调查设计，基于489名获得中小企业贷款的女性企业家样本，构建等权重综合指数。使用OLS、分位数回归、自助回归、标准化贝塔回归、层次回归和调节效应等多种计量经济学方法检验假设和稳健性。
AI.findings: 1. 贷款获取和贷款充足性对女性企业家的社会经济发展有积极影响；2. 严格的信贷审查、过高的抵押要求和缺乏机构支持是增长抑制因素，尤其对低收入群体影响显著；3. 年龄和教育水平解释了从中小企业贷款中获得收益的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过严格的计量经济学建模，深入探讨了金融包容性和机构支持在决定女性企业家成功方面的动态关系，丰富了相关文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了重要启示：中小企业贷款显著促进了女性企业家的社会经济福利；应优化贷款因素和机构因素以最大化中小企业效益；研究结果为其他新兴经济体提供了借鉴，为进一步研究和政策发展铺平了道路。

title: Expected value‑added, employment, and climate impacts of an offshore Carbon Capture Storage system in Denmark
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, DTU Management, Technical University of Denmark and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Joint Program on the Science and Policy of Global Change

detail.title: Expected value‑added, employment, and climate impacts of an offshore Carbon Capture Storage system in Denmark

keywords: Keywords: Offshore carbon capture and storage (CCS)

detail.abstract: The economic and environmental co-benefits of offshore carbon capture and storage (CCS) infrastructure remain largely unquantified at the project level. This study provides the first economy-wide appraisal of a planned Danish offshore CCS system—the BIFROST project—which repurposes existing North Sea hydrocarbon pipelines and depleted reservoirs for permanent geological CO₂ storage. A bottom-up cost inventory covering liquefaction, shipping, pipeline transport, and offshore injection, validated through semi-structured interviews with industry experts, is integrated into a multi-regional input–output (MRIO) model to trace direct and indirect effects on value added (VA), employment, and greenhouse gas emissions across global supply chains. Over a 28-year, three-phase lifetime storing approximately 190 Mt of CO₂, the project generates €1.5–1.6 billion in global VA and 110,000–117,000 job-years, of which €0.4–0.5 billion and 14,000–24,000 job-years accrue to Denmark. Upstream and on-site CO₂ emissions (Scopes 2 and 3) represent 9.3–10.5% of the volume permanently stored; sourcing liquefaction power from low-carbon grids emerges as the most effective lever for reducing this ratio. Two transport sequences are compared: Denmark's domestic returns are maximised when pipeline transport is adopted as early as possible and liquefaction facilities are sited domestically. These findings indicate that repurposed offshore infrastructure can deliver simultaneous climate mitigation and regional economic gains when transport sequencing, plant siting, and fiscal policy are jointly optimised.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次对丹麦海上CCS项目BIFROST进行经济-环境协同效益评估，发现该项目在28年储存190Mt CO₂期间，能创造15-16亿欧元全球增加值、11-11.7万就业年，其中丹麦获得4-5亿欧元和1.4-2.4万就业年。上游排放占储存量的9.3-10.5%，低碳电网供电是最有效的减排手段。
AI.research_question: 海上碳捕集与封存（CCS）基础设施在项目层面的经济与环境协同效益如何量化？特别是利用现有北海油气管道和枯竭储层进行永久地质封存的丹麦BIFROST项目。
AI.motivation: 目前对海上CCS基础设施的经济与环境协同效益在项目层面缺乏量化评估，特别是利用现有油气基础设施进行改造的项目。丹麦BIFROST项目作为首个此类项目，其综合效益评估对政策制定和投资决策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用多区域投入产出（MRIO）模型分析全球供应链的直接和间接影响；结合自下而上的成本清单方法（涵盖液化、航运、管道运输和海上注入等环节）；通过半结构化专家访谈验证数据。
AI.method: 1. 构建涵盖液化、航运、管道运输、海上注入等环节的自下而上成本清单；2. 通过半结构化访谈验证行业专家数据；3. 将成本数据整合到多区域投入产出（MRIO）模型中；4. 追踪全球供应链对增加值、就业和温室气体排放的直接和间接影响；5. 比较两种运输序列的经济效益。
AI.findings: 1. 28年储存190Mt CO₂期间，项目创造全球增加值15-16亿欧元和11-11.7万就业年，其中丹麦获得4-5亿欧元和1.4-2.4万就业年；2. 上游和现场排放（范围2和3）占永久储存量的9.3-10.5%；3. 液化环节使用低碳电网供电是最有效的减排手段；4. 管道运输尽早采用且液化设施设在丹麦国内时，丹麦的经济回报最大化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在项目层面量化海上CCS的经济与环境协同效益；2. 建立了整合自下而上成本清单与MRIO模型的评估框架；3. 揭示了现有油气基础设施改造项目的综合效益机制；4. 提出了运输序列、工厂选址和财政政策联合优化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为丹麦BIFROST项目提供了经济-环境效益的量化依据；2. 识别了液化环节使用低碳电网的关键减排杠杆；3. 提出了最大化国内经济回报的运输序列和设施选址方案；4. 为政策制定者提供了基础设施改造、能源转型和区域经济发展的综合决策支持。

title: Unveiling Agricultural Resilience to Climate Change: A Structural Model Analysis Using Australian Farm Data Abstract
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Unveiling Agricultural Resilience to Climate Change: A Structural Model Analysis Using Australian Farm Data Abstract
detail.abstract: Understanding the impact of weather shocks on agricultural production and farmers’ adaptive capacity is critical for designing effective climate policies. This paper develops a structural model to examine farmers’ profit-maximizing responses to weather variability, distinguishing between output transformation and input adaptation effects. Using longitudinal data from broadacre farms in New South Wales, Australia (1977–2007), we find that water scarcity, rather than temperature fluctuations, poses the most significant constraint on farm productivity. A 1% decline in rainfall reduces crop production by 0.5% and livestock production by 0.1%. Each millimeter decrease in annual rainfall reduces annual farm profits by AU$8,700. While input adjustments help mitigate losses, adaptive strategies differ by farm type and regional conditions, with livestock producers in arid zones demonstrating greater flexibility. These findings underscore the importance of region-specific, production-tailored adaptation policies to strengthen agricultural resilience in the face of climate change.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构模型分析天气冲击对农业生产的影响，发现水资源短缺比温度波动对农场生产力约束更大。降雨减少1%导致作物产量下降0.5%、牲畜产量下降0.1%，每毫米年降雨减少使农场年利润减少8700澳元。不同农场类型和区域的适应策略存在差异，需要针对性的气候适应政策。
AI.research_question: 天气冲击如何影响农业生产？农民如何通过产出转换和投入调整来适应天气变化？不同农场类型和区域条件下的适应策略有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解天气冲击对农业生产的影响和农民的适应能力对于设计有效的气候政策至关重要。气候变化带来的天气变异性增加，需要了解农民如何调整生产决策以应对这些冲击，以及哪些适应策略最有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利润最大化理论，构建结构模型区分产出转换效应和投入适应效应。考虑农民在面对天气冲击时的生产决策调整，包括产出结构调整和生产要素投入调整。
AI.method: 使用澳大利亚新南威尔士州广域农场1977-2007年的纵向数据，构建结构模型分析农民对天气变化的利润最大化反应。区分产出转换和投入适应效应，比较不同农场类型和区域条件的适应策略差异。
AI.findings: 1. 水资源短缺比温度波动对农场生产力约束更大；2. 降雨减少1%导致作物产量下降0.5%、牲畜产量下降0.1%；3. 每毫米年降雨减少使农场年利润减少8700澳元；4. 投入调整有助于减轻损失；5. 适应策略因农场类型和区域条件而异，干旱区牲畜生产者表现出更大灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了区分产出转换和投入适应效应的结构模型；2. 明确了水资源短缺在天气冲击中的主导作用；3. 揭示了不同农场类型适应策略的异质性；4. 为农业气候适应理论提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调需要针对特定区域和生产类型的适应政策；2. 为政策制定者提供基于实证的决策依据；3. 帮助农民优化适应策略选择；4. 增强农业面对气候变化的韧性。

title: Myanmar Sign Language Recognition Using Deep Learning
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, , , , , Simbolo and University of Technolgoy (Yatanarpon Cyber City)

detail.title: Myanmar Sign Language Recognition Using Deep Learning

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no financial, commercial, or personal relationships that could have influenced the research reported in this paper. The study was conducted independently, and the authors have no affiliations or involvement with any organization or entity that could be perceived as having a direct or indirect interest in the results of this work. The research design, data collection, analysis, and interpretation were carried out solely for academic and research purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved the collection of video data from human participants for the purpose of developing and evaluating a Myanmar Sign Language recognition system. All participants were informed about the nature and purpose of the research prior to data collection. Informed consent was obtained from each participant, and participation was entirely voluntary. The recorded data were used exclusively for academic research purposes and were handled responsibly to ensure respect for participants’ privacy and dignity. No sensitive personal information was collected beyond what was necessary for the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was fully self-funded by the authors. No external financial support, grants, sponsorships, or institutional funding were received for the development, implementation, or publication of this study. All resources, including data collection tools, computational resources, and development environments, were independently arranged by the research team.

detail.abstract: In this paper, we propose a word and expression-level recognition system using Pose Estimation and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) for Myanmar Sign Language. The model converts Myanmar Sign Language from videos into Burmese words and expressions, using diverse data collected from different people in various situations for training. In the data preprocessing stage, the dataset was subjected to the landmark of face, body, and hand using mediapipe, with the resulting data stored as numpy arrays in CSV format. These arrays were subsequently used as the training data input for the model. The model's function involved predicting or recognizing the signs presented in the input video. The accuracy rate during the training phase was 94.4%, whereas the accuracy rate during the validation phase was slightly lower at 92.78%. A 60% accuracy rate was attained in the real-time testing phase using signer data that had not been seen before by the model. Whereas people who are new to studying sign language achieve an accuracy rate of 80% resulting in human performance remaining superior to the model. Our main purpose is to break the barrier and connect hearing-impaired people to hearing people with our research and technologies as much as possible. Lastly, we believe that our approach will help solve the problem of hearing-impaired people unable to communicate with hearing people.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于姿态估计和LSTM的缅甸手语识别系统，能够将视频中的手语转换为缅甸语单词和表达，训练准确率达94.4%，验证准确率92.78%，实时测试准确率60%，旨在帮助听力障碍人士与听力正常人士沟通。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个有效的缅甸手语识别系统，将视频中的手语动作准确转换为缅甸语单词和表达？
AI.motivation: 打破听力障碍人士与听力正常人士之间的沟通障碍，利用技术帮助听力障碍人士更好地融入社会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机视觉的姿态估计技术和深度学习中的长短期记忆网络（LSTM）理论。
AI.method: 使用Mediapipe提取面部、身体和手部关键点作为特征，将数据存储为numpy数组，采用LSTM模型进行训练和识别。
AI.findings: 训练准确率94.4%，验证准确率92.78%，实时测试准确率60%，但新手学习手语的准确率可达80%，人类表现仍优于模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将姿态估计与LSTM结合应用于缅甸手语识别，为低资源语言的手语识别提供了技术框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际应用的缅甸手语识别系统原型，为听力障碍人士提供了沟通辅助工具，促进了社会包容性。

title: Economic Impact Analysis of Public-Charging Tariff Reduction on Electric Vehicle Adoption in the UAE
affiliations: Hamdan Bin Mohammed Smart University, Hamdan Bin Mohammed Smart University and Hamdan Bin Mohammed Smart University

detail.title: Economic Impact Analysis of Public-Charging Tariff Reduction on Electric Vehicle Adoption in the UAE
detail.abstract: Under the United Arab Emirates (UAE) Net Zero 2050 strategic initiative, the nation aims to achieve a 50% adoption rate of electric vehicles (EVs). However, despite significant investment in charging infrastructure, current adoption rates remain below 5%, raising critical questions about the factors impeding this transition. This study investigates a fundamental barrier to EV adoption: the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority’s (DEWA) direct current (DC) fast-charging tariff of AED 1.26 per kilowatt-hour (kWh). This pricing structure renders the operation of EVs 35% more expensive than that of efficient internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles. A comparative analysis of 50 EV models reveals an average operating cost of AED 22.33 per 100 km, compared to AED 16.57 per 100 km for efficient petrol vehicles, creating a significant economic disincentive that disproportionately affects the 60% of Dubai residents residing in apartments who rely exclusively on public charging infrastructure. International benchmarking further indicates that the UAE’s charging-to-petrol cost ratio of 135% significantly exceeds that of successful markets, such as Norway (32%) and Finland (29%), where ratios between 20% and 50% have driven widespread adoption. Based on these findings, this study recommends reducing DC fast-charging tariffs to a range of AED 0.45–0.55/kWh. Such an adjustment would not only align energy costs with international best practices but also restore the economic rationale for EV ownership, enabling the realization of the UAE's national EV adoption targets and contributing to an estimated 26 million tonnes of annual carbon dioxide emissions reduction.

AI.tldr: 阿联酋为实现2050年净零排放目标，计划将电动汽车采用率提升至50%，但目前仅低于5%。研究发现，迪拜水电局1.26迪拉姆/千瓦时的直流快充电价是主要障碍，使电动汽车运营成本比高效燃油车高出35%。建议将电价降至0.45-0.55迪拉姆/千瓦时，以符合国际最佳实践并实现国家目标。
AI.research_question: 迪拜水电局的直流快充电价（1.26迪拉姆/千瓦时）如何影响阿联酋电动汽车的采用率，以及如何通过电价调整实现国家电动汽车采用目标？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋设定了2050年净零排放战略目标，计划实现50%的电动汽车采用率，但当前采用率低于5%，尽管在充电基础设施上投入了大量资金。这种差距引发了关于阻碍电动汽车转型的关键因素的疑问。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于成本效益分析和比较分析理论框架，通过国际基准对比（如挪威和芬兰的成功案例），探讨电价政策对电动汽车采用的经济激励作用。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法：1）对50款电动汽车模型进行运营成本分析；2）将阿联酋充电成本与燃油成本比率与国际市场（挪威32%、芬兰29%）进行基准对比；3）分析电价调整对经济激励的影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）当前电价使电动汽车运营成本达22.33迪拉姆/100公里，比高效燃油车（16.57迪拉姆/100公里）高出35%；2）阿联酋充电-燃油成本比率为135%，远高于挪威（32%）和芬兰（29%）的成功市场；3）60%的迪拜居民居住在公寓，完全依赖公共充电设施，受此经济障碍影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为电动汽车采用政策提供了实证支持，强调了电价政策在推动清洁能源转型中的关键作用，并建立了充电成本与燃油成本比率的国际基准框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将直流快充电价降至0.45-0.55迪拉姆/千瓦时范围，这将：1）使能源成本符合国际最佳实践；2）恢复电动汽车拥有的经济合理性；3）实现阿联酋国家电动汽车采用目标；4）每年减少约2600万吨二氧化碳排放。

title: Dynamic Credit Risk Assessment under Carbon Transition Pressures: Evi-dence from Chinese Firms
affiliations: China Jiliang University, Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics, Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics and China Jiliang University

detail.title: Dynamic Credit Risk Assessment under Carbon Transition Pressures: Evi-dence from Chinese Firms
detail.abstract: The rapid transition to a low-carbon economy challenges traditional credit-risk assessment, especially in carbon-intensive industries. In this paper, we develop a dynamic framework that embeds carbon-transition exposure into corporate risk assessment. Sector-specific data en-velopment analysis treats total greenhouse gas emission intensity as a negative (undesirable) input, producing interpretable carbon cost signals. We separate historical from expected per-formance using maximum-entropy time weights and peer-incentive adjustments, then classify firms with a topology-aware self-organizing map followed by K-means clustering. For 1,222 Chinese listed firms across 11 sectors during 2016–2021, we find that: (i) carbon intensity is the second-most important driver of efficiency after leverage, with substantial cross-sector het-erogeneity; (ii) forward-looking scoring materially reorders mid-tier firms while the top and bottom deciles remain stable across reasonable settings of the time-preference parameter; and (iii) industries group into three patterns—history–expectation synchronization, expecta-tion-dominant, and history-oriented.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个动态框架，将碳转型风险嵌入企业风险评估中，使用数据包络分析处理碳排放强度作为负面输入，通过最大熵时间权重和同行激励调整分离历史与预期表现，并采用拓扑感知自组织映射和K均值聚类对企业分类。研究发现碳排放强度是效率的第二重要驱动因素，前瞻性评分显著重新排序中游企业，行业呈现三种模式。
AI.research_question: 如何将碳转型风险动态嵌入企业信用风险评估框架？碳强度对企业效率的影响如何？不同行业在碳转型风险下的表现模式有何差异？
AI.motivation: 向低碳经济的快速转型对传统信用风险评估构成挑战，特别是在碳密集型行业。现有风险评估方法未能充分纳入碳转型风险，需要开发能够动态嵌入碳暴露的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据包络分析（DEA）理论、最大熵原理、自组织映射（SOM）理论、K均值聚类理论、碳转型风险理论、企业风险评估理论
AI.method: 1. 使用部门特定数据包络分析，将温室气体排放强度作为负面输入；2. 采用最大熵时间权重和同行激励调整分离历史与预期表现；3. 使用拓扑感知自组织映射和K均值聚类对企业分类；4. 样本包括2016-2021年11个行业的1,222家中国上市公司
AI.findings: 1. 碳强度是杠杆之后第二重要的效率驱动因素，存在显著的跨行业异质性；2. 前瞻性评分显著重新排序中游企业，而顶部和底部十分位数在不同时间偏好参数设置下保持稳定；3. 行业分为三种模式：历史-预期同步型、预期主导型和历史导向型
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了将碳转型风险动态嵌入企业风险评估的理论框架；2. 提出了结合最大熵时间权重和同行激励调整的方法分离历史与预期表现；3. 建立了基于拓扑感知自组织映射和K均值聚类的企业分类方法；4. 丰富了碳转型风险与企业效率关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构提供碳转型风险评估工具；2. 帮助企业识别碳效率改进机会；3. 为政策制定者提供行业碳转型模式分析；4. 为投资者提供碳风险敏感的投资决策支持

title: Policy Design and Firm-Level Energy Efficiency: Evidence from Emissions Trading versus Command-and-Control in Korea
affiliations: University of Seoul and University of Seoul

detail.title: Policy Design and Firm-Level Energy Efficiency: Evidence from Emissions Trading versus Command-and-Control in Korea
detail.abstract: This study investigates how differences in climate policy design—emissions trading versus command-and-control regulation—affect firm-level energy efficiency. Exploiting the coexistence of the Korea Emissions Trading Scheme and its command-and-control Target Management System, we identify the net effects of policy type on firms’ energy and carbon intensity. Using firm-level panel data from 2011 to 2023, we implement a staggered difference-in-differences framework and a separate event-study design to trace dynamic treatment effects. Because regime eligibility is determined by emissions thresholds, we focus on firms whose emissions lie in a neighborhood around the regulatory cutoffs and construct a unified measure of policy stringency to isolate policy-type effects. We find that emissions trading is associated with significant improvements in both energy and carbon intensity during the early phase of the Korea Emissions Trading Scheme, although these advantages diminished over time. Policy effects are stronger for firms with greater financial capacity, while target stringency alone does not guarantee sustained improvements. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of differentiated market-based policy design that accounts for firms’ financial conditions and sectoral abatement potential.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了韩国排放交易体系与命令控制型目标管理体系对企业能源效率的影响，发现排放交易在初期显著改善了企业的能源和碳强度，但效果随时间减弱，且政策效果受企业财务能力影响。
AI.research_question: 不同气候政策设计（排放交易与命令控制型监管）如何影响企业层面的能源效率？
AI.motivation: 韩国同时存在排放交易体系和命令控制型目标管理体系，为比较两种政策类型对企业能源和碳强度的净效应提供了独特的研究机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的政策工具理论，比较市场型政策（排放交易）与命令控制型政策的效果差异；企业行为理论，关注政策对企业能源效率决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用2011-2023年企业层面面板数据，采用交错双重差分框架和事件研究设计，聚焦排放阈值附近的公司，构建统一政策严格度指标以分离政策类型效应。
AI.findings: 排放交易在韩国排放交易体系初期显著改善了企业的能源和碳强度，但优势随时间减弱；政策效果对财务能力更强的企业更明显；仅政策严格度本身不能保证持续改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境政策工具比较研究提供了实证证据，揭示了政策类型随时间变化的动态效应，强调了企业异质性在政策效果中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者应设计差异化的市场型政策，考虑企业财务条件和行业减排潜力；政策设计需要关注随时间推移的效果衰减问题。

title: Brighten Life After Sunset: The Improvement on Mental Health From Nighttime Economy
affiliations: , Beijing Foreign Studies University, University of Colorado Denver and

detail.title: Brighten Life After Sunset: The Improvement on Mental Health From Nighttime Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Mental health problems impose substantial social and economic burdens worldwide and call for innovative public strategies beyond conventional individual medical interventions. The nighttime economy in China has developed over the ages into a multifaceted paradigm that systematically combines outdoor social entertainment and small family businesses, a phenomenon rare in the West. This paper aims to explore the relationship between the development of the nighttime economy and mental health. With a dataset from the China Family Panel Survey (CFPS), we find that the development of the nighttime economy significantly improves residents' mental health. This positive effect exhibits a distinct social-equality orientation: it effectively benefits both low- and high-income groups but through heterogeneous channels that align with their respective needs. Specifically, the nighttime economy enhances low-income residents' mental health via the income channel, while improving high-income residents' mental health via the consumption channel. Geographical patterns further show that the gains are concentrated where baseline amenities are relatively scarce. In northern provinces, where the nighttime economy lags behind that of southern counterparts, favorable summer temperatures expand opportunities for evening outdoor activities, so increases in nighttime economic activity translate into larger improvements in mental health. Within provinces, the effects are stronger in rural than in urban areas, consistent with the idea that limited recreational alternatives leave greater scope for the nighttime economy to enhance well-being. These findings highlight the nighttime economy as an innovative socio-economic lever to promote population mental health, offering a complementary pathway to relieve healthcare burdens and foster inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 研究发现中国夜间经济发展能显著改善居民心理健康，且具有社会平等效应：通过收入渠道改善低收入群体心理健康，通过消费渠道改善高收入群体心理健康。效果在基础设施相对匮乏的地区更明显。
AI.research_question: 夜间经济发展与居民心理健康之间存在何种关系？这种关系在不同收入群体、不同地理区域中如何呈现异质性？
AI.motivation: 心理健康问题造成巨大社会经济负担，需要超越传统医疗干预的公共策略创新。中国夜间经济形成了独特的户外社交娱乐与小型家庭企业结合的模式，为探索促进心理健康的新途径提供了契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会经济学和公共健康理论，探讨经济活动（特别是夜间经济）作为社会心理干预手段的可能性；结合收入效应和消费效应对不同收入群体的异质性影响机制；考虑地理环境和基础设施条件对干预效果的调节作用。
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，通过实证分析方法检验夜间经济发展对心理健康的影响，采用异质性分析考察不同收入群体、不同地理区域（南北差异、城乡差异）的作用机制差异。
AI.findings: 1. 夜间经济发展显著改善居民心理健康；2. 具有社会平等效应：同时惠及低收入和高收入群体，但机制不同：低收入群体通过收入渠道改善，高收入群体通过消费渠道改善；3. 地理模式：在基础设施相对匮乏的地区效果更明显；4. 北方省份夏季适宜温度扩大了夜间经济活动机会，心理健康改善效果更大；5. 农村地区效果强于城市，因娱乐替代选择有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了夜间经济作为促进心理健康的社会经济杠杆理论；2. 揭示了经济活动通过异质性渠道影响不同社会阶层的心理健康机制；3. 拓展了环境条件（温度、基础设施）对经济-健康关系调节作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府制定促进心理健康的公共政策提供了新思路：通过发展夜间经济而非单纯医疗干预；2. 为促进包容性增长提供了具体路径：夜间经济能同时惠及不同收入群体；3. 为区域发展规划提供指导：在基础设施相对匮乏地区优先发展夜间经济可获得更大健康收益；4. 为缓解医疗系统负担提供了补充途径。

title: Fairness and the SEC's Competing Regulatory Paradigms
affiliations: NYU Pollack Center for Law & Business

detail.title: Fairness and the SEC's Competing Regulatory Paradigms
detail.abstract:
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has invoked fairness to justify trading restrictions in the stock market, particularly in the areas of insider trading, high-frequency trading, and short selling. The Commission typically includes fairness considerations in its cost-benefit analysis, reasoning that such restrictions enhance investors’ perceived fairness of the stock market, which in turn bolsters investor confidence, thereby promoting capital formation, market stability, and ultimately allocative efficiency. 

Invoking fairness as a policy justification, however, raises questions under the arbitrary-and-capricious standard of the Administrative Procedure Act, which requires the SEC to provide an adequate justification for its rules. Indeed, scholars have noted that, although the Commission has sometimes included perceived fairness in its cost-benefit analysis, it has not demonstrated empirically how certain trading restrictions generate measurable benefits in terms of enhanced perceived fairness and thereby allocative efficiency. This Article argues that such shortcomings reveal the limits of the “efficiency regulatory paradigm” as a framework for justifying fairness-based trading restrictions. This Article contends that, where feasible, the Commission should instead explain how such restrictions align with the principle of fair markets. Codified in Section 2 of the Exchange Act, this principle can be construed as justifying restrictions not only on trading practices that result in unfair prices but also on those that confer either undue advantages or lawful advantages that allow sophisticated investors to increase their wealth at the expense of individual investors without creating any meaningful social value. This approach recognizes the relevance of fairness within the “public values regulatory paradigm,” in which regulatory principles independent of efficiency can justify rulemaking for the equity market structure.

By examining short selling regulation as a case study, this Article demonstrates the SEC’s inadequate justification of trading restrictions as necessary to enhance perceived fairness and thereby allocative efficiency. At the same time, the short selling context illustrates how the Commission could instead ground such restrictions in the principle of fair markets, treated as an independent regulatory principle. Given the increased scrutiny by courts and interest groups regarding the SEC’s rulemaking justifications, this Article advances an analytical framework to guide both the SEC and policy analysts in articulating fairness as a defensible policy justification in securities regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文批评美国SEC以"公平"为名实施交易限制时，仅将其作为提升感知公平→投资者信心→资本配置效率的中间环节，缺乏实证支持。作者主张SEC应基于《交易法》第2条的"公平市场原则"，将公平视为独立于效率的监管价值，为交易限制提供更坚实的法律基础。
AI.research_question: 美国SEC如何能够为基于公平的交易限制提供充分的法律和监管依据？
AI.motivation: SEC常以"公平"为由对内幕交易、高频交易和卖空等实施限制，但仅将其作为提升感知公平→投资者信心→配置效率的中间环节，缺乏实证支持，面临《行政程序法》的"武断和反复无常"标准挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 效率监管范式：将公平视为实现配置效率的工具；2. 公共价值监管范式：将公平视为独立于效率的监管原则；3. 《交易法》第2条的公平市场原则。
AI.method: 规范分析、法律解释分析，以卖空监管为案例研究，对比SEC现行论证方式与基于公平市场原则的替代论证框架。
AI.findings: 1. SEC现行基于效率范式的公平论证存在实证缺陷；2. 《交易法》第2条的公平市场原则可为交易限制提供独立依据；3. 该原则可限制导致不公平价格、不当优势或合法但无社会价值的优势获取行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了效率监管范式在论证公平限制时的局限性；2. 提出了基于公共价值监管范式的替代理论框架；3. 发展了公平市场原则作为独立监管原则的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为SEC提供了应对法院和利益集团审查的分析框架；2. 指导政策分析师如何将公平作为可辩护的政策理由；3. 为卖空等具体交易限制提供了更坚实的法律论证基础。

title: Fighting Fake News with Peer Feedback: Theory and Experiment
affiliations: Waseda University, Waseda University, Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics and Waseda University - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Fighting Fake News with Peer Feedback: Theory and Experiment
detail.abstract: The diffusion of fake news on social media poses a growing challenge to society. This study develops a theoretical model and laboratory experiment to examine whether userto-user feedback such as likes or negative comments can reduce fake news sharing. We construct a sender-receiver game in which the sender receives a signal from potentially unreliable sources and decides whether to share it, while feedback from the receiver enables learning about information quality over time. The model predicts that (i) peer feedback induces self-selection: individuals with unreliable sources learn to stop sharing, and (ii) fake news spreads more when senders are motivated by reputation rather than accuracy, though this effect is modest. We test these predictions by developing a novel lab experiment based on the ball-and-urn experimental design. Consistent with the theory, feedback reduces fake news sharing, but effects are weaker due to underreaction in belief updating and noisy decisions. Differences across motivational incentives are minimal. These findings highlight both the potential and limits of peer feedback in preventing fake news sharing, offering implications for platforms seeking to curb misinformation through user-to-user feefback.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过理论模型和实验室实验发现，用户间的反馈（如点赞或负面评论）能够减少假新闻分享，但效果有限。反馈通过自我选择机制让不可靠信息来源者停止分享，但声誉动机和信念更新不足会削弱反馈效果。
AI.research_question: 用户间的反馈（如点赞或负面评论）能否减少社交媒体上的假新闻分享？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上假新闻的传播对社会构成日益严峻的挑战，需要研究有效的干预措施。用户间反馈作为平台可能采用的机制，其有效性需要理论和实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个发送者-接收者博弈模型，发送者从可能不可靠的来源接收信号并决定是否分享，接收者的反馈使发送者能够随时间学习信息质量。模型基于贝叶斯更新和激励理论。
AI.method: 开发了基于球和瓮实验设计的实验室实验，测试理论模型的预测。通过控制实验条件，比较不同激励（准确性vs声誉）下的反馈效果。
AI.findings: 1. 反馈减少了假新闻分享，但效果较弱；2. 反馈通过自我选择机制起作用：不可靠信息来源者学会停止分享；3. 当发送者受声誉而非准确性激励时，假新闻传播更多，但差异不大；4. 效果有限的原因是信念更新不足和决策噪声。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了用户反馈影响假新闻分享的理论模型；2. 揭示了反馈通过自我选择机制减少假新闻的微观机制；3. 区分了准确性激励和声誉激励对假新闻传播的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为社交媒体平台设计用户反馈机制提供了理论依据；2. 指出了反馈机制的效果有限性，需要结合其他干预措施；3. 强调了激励设计在减少假新闻传播中的重要性。

title: Reforming Tax or Reshaping Rights? A Critical Analysis of the Income Tax Bill, 2025
affiliations: Amity University, Amity Law School

detail.title: Reforming Tax or Reshaping Rights? A Critical Analysis of the Income Tax Bill, 2025
detail.abstract: The new Income Tax Bill is drafted to replace the Income Tax Act, 1961, with a more up-to-date and organized system. The bill makes procedures simpler and increases the use of technology, but it has raised serious concerns about its strong surveillance. The study examines if Sections of the bill are in line with the Constitution such as the right to privacy mentioned in Article 21 and the distribution of powers mentioned in Articles 246 and 280. Judging from tax practices in the United States, United Kingdom and Canada, the paper finds what works best and where Indian laws deviate from democratic rules in other nations. In the end, it is recognized that without proper judicial review, strong statutory safeguards and adequate federal regulations, the bill might challenge civil liberties and the balance between state and federal governments. The paper gives specific proposals for tax reform that are in line with what the Constitution and international laws require.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了印度新所得税法案草案，评估其是否符合宪法规定（特别是隐私权和权力分配），通过比较美国、英国和加拿大的税收实践，指出法案可能威胁公民自由和联邦平衡，并提出符合宪法和国际法的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 印度新所得税法案草案中的条款是否符合宪法规定，特别是隐私权（第21条）和权力分配（第246条和第280条）？
AI.motivation: 新所得税法案旨在取代1961年所得税法，建立更现代化、有组织的税收体系，简化程序并增加技术应用，但引发了对其强大监控能力的严重担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法理论框架：印度宪法第21条（隐私权）、第246条和第280条（权力分配）；比较法理论：美国、英国和加拿大的税收实践与民主原则。
AI.method: 比较法分析：对比美国、英国和加拿大的税收实践；宪法分析：评估法案条款与印度宪法规定的符合性；规范性分析：识别最佳实践和偏离民主原则之处。
AI.findings: 研究发现印度新所得税法案在某些方面偏离了其他民主国家的实践；缺乏适当的司法审查、强有力的法定保障和充分的联邦监管可能威胁公民自由和联邦平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为税收立法与宪法权利（特别是隐私权）的平衡提供了理论框架；丰富了比较税收法的理论分析；提出了税收监管与联邦制平衡的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的税收改革建议，确保符合宪法和国际法要求；为立法者提供了避免侵犯公民自由和维护联邦平衡的实践指导；为其他国家的税收改革提供了比较参考。

title: The Contract-Based Approach To Restructuring Sovereign Debt: Theory, Evolution, And Reform
affiliations: Centre for International Governance Innovation and Harvard Law School

detail.title: The Contract-Based Approach To Restructuring Sovereign Debt: Theory, Evolution, And Reform
detail.abstract: This Paper presents a new theoretical framework for understanding how insolvent foreign nation-states work out their defaulted debts. "Sovereign debt restructuring," as the process is known, is of critical importance to the dozens of developing countries around the world who have borrowed over 1 trillion dollars under the law of the State of New York and other jurisdictions. It explains how and why the prevailing system of sovereign debt restructuring works even though it operates informally and is based on voluntary, out-of-court negotiations supported by the inclusion of voting clauses in sovereign bonds to bind-in holdout creditors ("Collective Action Clauses"). The theory of sovereign debt restructuring is introduced through a review of the famous 2001 and 2003 policy debates (known as "the CAC-SDRM debate") that pitted the U.S. Treasury, which favored the voluntary, contract-based approach based approach that is used today against the International Monetary Fund ("I.M.F."), which favored the adoption of a formal, treaty-based, Chapter-11-like statutory scheme, which it called a Sovereign Debt Restructuring Mechanism ("SDRM"). Material from these debates plus additional insights borrowed from the theory of corporate insolvency, the doctrine of sovereign immunity, and financial history are then used to argue that a workable system must be based on the voluntary participation of the sovereign and other stakeholder groups. This Paper sets out design principles for designing a workable voluntary sovereign debt restructuring system and presents a model of how the various parties and processes are effectively coordinated. This Paper concludes with the proposal of two incremental reforms to help fill observed gaps in the prevailing system: (i) an expansion of existing statutory stay powers to limit to the potential for disruption of out-of-court negotiations brought by uncooperative creditors; and (ii) a limitation on payment-blocking injunctions like the one granted in the Argentina bond litigation that led to a fresh default on 30 billion dollars of performing, but previously-restructured bonds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的理论框架来解释破产外国主权国家如何重组其违约债务。文章解释了当前基于自愿、庭外谈判的主权债务重组系统为何有效运作，尽管它是非正式的。通过回顾2001-2003年的CAC-SDRM辩论，结合公司破产理论、主权豁免原则和金融历史，论证了可行系统必须基于主权国家和其他利益相关方的自愿参与。最后提出了两项渐进式改革建议。
AI.research_question: 当前基于自愿、庭外谈判的主权债务重组系统如何以及为何能够有效运作？如何设计一个可行的自愿主权债务重组系统？
AI.motivation: 主权债务重组对数十个发展中国家至关重要，这些国家根据纽约州法律和其他司法管辖区借入了超过1万亿美元。理解当前系统如何运作以及如何改进它对于全球金融稳定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 主权债务重组理论；2. 公司破产理论；3. 主权豁免原则；4. 金融历史分析；5. 自愿参与理论框架
AI.method: 1. 理论框架构建；2. 历史案例分析（2001-2003年CAC-SDRM辩论）；3. 比较分析（美国财政部与IMF的不同方案）；4. 跨学科理论借鉴（公司破产、主权豁免、金融史）；5. 系统设计原则推导
AI.findings: 1. 当前基于自愿、庭外谈判的系统虽然非正式，但能够有效运作；2. 集体行动条款（CACs）在约束"钉子户"债权人方面发挥关键作用；3. 可行系统必须基于主权国家和其他利益相关方的自愿参与；4. 当前系统存在需要填补的空白
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个新的主权债务重组理论框架；2. 解释了自愿、非正式系统为何有效；3. 建立了主权债务重组的设计原则；4. 整合了公司破产理论、主权豁免原则和金融历史见解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出了主权债务重组系统的设计原则；2. 提出了两项渐进式改革建议：（i）扩大现有法定中止权力以限制不合作债权人对庭外谈判的干扰；（ii）限制类似阿根廷债券诉讼中的支付禁令，避免对已重组债券造成新的违约

title: Production Network Spillovers from EU Funded R&D Grants
affiliations: University of Dubrovnik,  and

detail.title: Production Network Spillovers from EU Funded R&D Grants

declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Croatian Science Foundation under project IP-2022-10-8560.

detail.abstract: Firms are embedded in production networks, so the returns to innovation policy may extend far beyond direct recipients. We quantify upstream propagation of R&D grants using administrative data from Croatia's €200 million program and comprehensive firm-to-firm transaction records. Grants generate large direct effects: recipient revenue rises by about 17%, material costs by about 22%, employment by about 8%, and tangible assets by about 27%. These gains transmit strongly to suppliers. Exposed suppliers expand persistently, with revenue increasing by roughly 28-46% and material costs by roughly 30-51%; employment rises more modestly but durably (about 9-12% from year 1 onward), while tangible assets accumulate gradually (roughly 17-40% over years 1-4). Spillovers are strongest for geographically proximate ties but remain meaningful well beyond local relationships. They accrue disproportionately to smaller firms and are more pronounced among financially constrained suppliers. Accounting for supplier responses raises the implied total impact to about four times the direct recipient effect. Production networks are therefore central to assessing the economic returns to innovation policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用克罗地亚2亿欧元研发资助计划的行政数据和企业间交易记录，量化了研发资助在上游供应链中的传播效应。研究发现资助不仅对直接受助企业产生显著正面影响，还通过生产网络强烈传导给供应商，使总影响达到直接受助企业效应的约4倍。
AI.research_question: 研发资助政策如何通过生产网络在上游供应商中传播？这种传播效应的大小和特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 企业嵌入生产网络中，创新政策的回报可能远远超出直接受助企业。然而，现有研究对研发资助在供应链中的传播效应缺乏量化分析，这限制了我们对创新政策整体经济回报的准确评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络理论、创新扩散理论、供应链传播效应、地理邻近性理论、金融约束理论
AI.method: 使用克罗地亚2亿欧元研发资助计划的行政数据，结合全面的企业间交易记录，采用实证分析方法量化研发资助的直接效应和上游传播效应。
AI.findings: 1. 直接效应：受助企业收入增长约17%，材料成本增长约22%，就业增长约8%，有形资产增长约27%。2. 传播效应：供应商收入增长28-46%，材料成本增长30-51%，就业增长9-12%，有形资产增长17-40%。3. 地理邻近性效应最强但非本地关系仍有意义。4. 传播效应在小企业和财务约束供应商中更显著。5. 考虑供应商响应后，总影响约为直接效应的4倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化了研发资助在生产网络中的上游传播效应。2. 揭示了创新政策回报的乘数效应机制。3. 拓展了生产网络理论在创新政策评估中的应用。4. 为理解地理邻近性和金融约束在传播效应中的作用提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估创新政策整体经济回报的新框架。2. 表明创新政策具有显著的间接经济效益，应纳入政策评估。3. 为针对小企业和财务约束企业的政策设计提供依据。4. 强调生产网络在政策设计中的重要性。

title: Treasury Financing by Hedge Funds: A Tale of Three Channels
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Isenberg School of Management and

detail.title: Treasury Financing by Hedge Funds: A Tale of Three Channels
detail.abstract: Hedge funds have become critical players in Treasury markets. To finance large amounts of Treasuries, hedge funds borrow in the repo market from commercial banks and dealers. We identify three channels that affect hedge fund borrowing costs. First, repo supply is inelastic, with larger Treasury offerings leading to higher repo rates paid by hedge funds (fiscal channel). Second, commercial banks reduce repo supply when their reserves decline (monetary channel). Lastly, bank leverage constraints increase the costs of repo intermediation, which are passed on to hedge funds as higher repo funding costs (regulatory channel).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了影响对冲基金国债回购融资成本的三个渠道：财政渠道（国债供给增加导致回购利率上升）、货币渠道（银行准备金减少降低回购供给）、监管渠道（银行杠杆约束增加中介成本）。
AI.research_question: 什么因素影响对冲基金在国债市场中的回购融资成本？
AI.motivation: 对冲基金已成为国债市场的重要参与者，它们通过回购市场从商业银行和交易商处融资来持有大量国债头寸。理解影响其融资成本的因素对市场稳定性和政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融市场微观结构理论，结合财政政策、货币政策和金融监管框架，分析国债市场融资成本的决定因素。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，识别三个影响渠道：财政渠道、货币渠道和监管渠道。
AI.findings: 发现三个主要渠道：1）财政渠道：国债供给增加导致回购利率上升；2）货币渠道：银行准备金减少降低回购供给；3）监管渠道：银行杠杆约束增加中介成本，最终转嫁给对冲基金。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了理解国债市场融资成本的多渠道理论框架，将财政、货币和监管因素整合到统一的金融中介分析中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解国债市场融资条件变化的框架，有助于评估财政政策、货币政策和金融监管对市场流动性和稳定性的影响。

title: Risk Sensing: LLMs for Risk Monitoring in SME Lending

detail.title: Risk Sensing: LLMs for Risk Monitoring in SME Lending
detail.abstract:
Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) are central to global economies yet face persistent credit constraints due to limited reliable financial data. This paper introduces RiskSensing, a dual-LLM agentic framework that extracts actionable credit risk signals from unstructured customer interaction records (chat transcripts and profiles) in digital banking channels. The framework consists of two core modules: (1) an LLM-augmented customer graph discovery pipeline that uncovers hidden person-to-business and business-to-business connections, and (2) an LLM-driven risk signal detection agent that identifies adverse events (operational disruptions, legal issues, bankruptcy signals, and key-person risks) using a custom risk taxonomy and structured prompting.

Deployed in the SME credit portfolio monitoring at a digital bank, the framework increased detection coverage by 23% (hidden connections) and 25% (adverse events, pooled across cohorts) over traditional baselines (company registries and third-party news feeds). Borrowers flagged by hidden connection signals showed 2.3× higher subsequent delinquency rates; those flagged by adverse event signals showed 2.4× higher rates. The median lead time from signal detection to delinquency was three months. Qualitative expert review confirmed high operational relevance.

The study demonstrates that customer conversational data, when processed through a modular LLM architecture, provides timely and complementary risk intelligence that traditional structured sources cannot capture. Practical implementation considerations and performance metrics are discussed across the credit risk lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RiskSensing框架，利用双LLM代理从数字银行渠道的非结构化客户交互记录中提取信用风险信号，显著提高了风险检测覆盖率和预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用数字银行渠道的非结构化客户交互记录（聊天记录和客户资料）来提取可操作的信用风险信号，以解决中小企业面临的信贷约束问题？
AI.motivation: 中小企业在全球经济中占据核心地位，但由于缺乏可靠的财务数据而面临持续的信贷约束。传统结构化数据源无法充分捕捉风险信号，需要探索新的数据源和分析方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于LLM增强的客户关系图发现和LLM驱动的风险信号检测理论框架，结合定制风险分类法和结构化提示技术。
AI.method: 采用双LLM代理框架：1）LLM增强的客户图发现管道，揭示隐藏的人对企业和企业对企业关系；2）LLM驱动的风险信号检测代理，使用定制风险分类法识别不良事件。
AI.findings: 在数字银行的中小企业信贷组合监控中，该框架比传统基线提高了23%（隐藏关系）和25%（不良事件）的检测覆盖率。被标记的借款人后续违约率分别高出2.3倍和2.4倍，信号检测到违约的中位提前期为三个月。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了客户对话数据通过模块化LLM架构处理，能够提供传统结构化数据源无法捕捉的及时且互补的风险情报，为信用风险评估理论提供了新的数据源和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了实用的RiskSensing框架，可集成到现有信贷风险管理流程中，提高风险检测的及时性和准确性，支持更精准的信贷决策和组合监控。

title: Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection in the Social Insurance Market for Entrepreneurs
affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - Department of Economics, Tampere University, VATT Institute for Economic Research, Tampere University and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB)

detail.title: Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection in the Social Insurance Market for Entrepreneurs
detail.abstract: This paper studies social insurance contribution choices, adverse selection, and moral hazard among Finnish entrepreneurs. We exploit quasi-exogenous variation from a reform that relaxed mandatory contribution requirements for a subset of entrepreneurs, combining administrative registry data with linked survey evidence. Entrepreneurs who gained discretion reduced their contributions by 16%, on average, relative to entrepreneurs subject to a strict mandate. Using this variation, causal tests of anticipatory responses and moral hazard as well as positive correlation tests, we show that moral hazard and adverse selection effects are near zero in this market. Survey responses help illuminate the mechanisms underlying these results.

AI.tldr: 芬兰企业家社会保险缴费选择研究：放松强制缴费要求后，企业家平均缴费减少16%，但道德风险和逆向选择效应几乎为零
AI.research_question: 企业家在社会保险缴费选择中是否存在道德风险和逆向选择问题？
AI.motivation: 理解企业家在社会保障体系中的行为反应，特别是当强制缴费要求放松时，是否存在道德风险和逆向选择问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保险经济学理论，包括道德风险、逆向选择理论，以及强制保险与自愿保险的比较分析
AI.method: 利用芬兰改革提供的准外生变异，结合行政登记数据和关联调查证据，进行因果检验和相关性分析
AI.findings: 获得缴费自主权的企业家平均缴费减少16%，但道德风险和逆向选择效应几乎为零
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统社会保险理论中关于道德风险和逆向选择的假设，表明在某些市场条件下这些效应可能不显著
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，表明放松强制缴费要求可能不会导致严重的道德风险和逆向选择问题

title: Not All Data Should Be Recovered: When Imputing Degrades Statistical Inference
affiliations: Tarleton State University and The University of Texas at Tyler

detail.title: Not All Data Should Be Recovered: When Imputing Degrades Statistical Inference
detail.abstract: In quantitative social science, the default response to empty cells is singular: impute. This practice ignores an ontological distinction between accidental absence (data the researcher failed to collect) and designed absence (data the researcher intentionally excluded to preserve experimental validity). We demonstrate that applying imputation to designed absence is a category error that systematically degrades inference. Using a large-scale discrete choice study (N = 7,181), we benchmark seven imputation methods, ranging from simple mean substitution to gradient-boosted Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE), against a ground-truth model estimated on observed data alone. Every method increased AIC, reduced predictive accuracy, and induced substantial coefficient bias. Most critically, imputation collapsed the variance structure, hollowing out the random effect and reducing the intraclass correlation (ICC) from a baseline of .602 to as low as .057. We demonstrate that "MICE" is not a singular method but a family of divergent models; on identical data, different MICE base learners produced contradictory substantive findings. The damage is driven by three mechanisms: counterfactual fabrication, de-randomization of experimental treatments, and the forced imposition of ergodicity on non-ergodic human behavior. We propose a new taxonomy of absence and argue that when data are absent by construction, the most defensible analytical response is to respect the design. No level of algorithmic sophistication can recover information from cells that were never intended to contain any.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了定量社会科学中对缺失数据的默认处理方法——插补。研究发现，当缺失是实验设计的一部分时（设计性缺失），插补会系统性损害推断质量，包括增加AIC、降低预测准确性、导致系数偏差，并破坏方差结构。作者提出了新的缺失分类法，并建议在设计性缺失情况下应尊重实验设计而非插补。
AI.research_question: 在定量社会科学中，当数据缺失是实验设计的一部分（设计性缺失）而非偶然缺失时，应用插补方法是否合适？插补方法如何影响统计推断的质量？
AI.motivation: 当前定量社会科学中对所有缺失数据都采用插补的默认做法，忽视了"偶然性缺失"（研究者未能收集的数据）和"设计性缺失"（研究者为保持实验有效性而故意排除的数据）之间的本体论区别。这种不加区分的做法可能导致系统性推断错误。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 缺失数据的本体论分类：偶然性缺失 vs. 设计性缺失
2. 实验设计原则：尊重实验设计的完整性
3. 统计推断理论：插补对模型拟合度、预测准确性和系数估计的影响
4. 随机效应模型和组内相关系数（ICC）理论
AI.method: 使用大规模离散选择研究（N=7,181），将七种插补方法（从简单的均值替换到梯度提升的MICE）与基于观察数据的地面真实模型进行基准比较。评估指标包括AIC、预测准确性、系数偏差、随机效应和组内相关系数（ICC）。
AI.findings:
1. 所有插补方法都增加了AIC、降低了预测准确性并导致显著的系数偏差
2. 插补破坏了方差结构，使组内相关系数从基线0.602降至最低0.057
3. MICE不是单一方法而是不同模型的家族，相同数据下不同MICE基础学习器产生矛盾的实质性发现
4. 损害机制：反事实虚构、实验处理的去随机化、对非遍历性人类行为强加遍历性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了新的缺失数据分类法，区分偶然性缺失和设计性缺失
2. 理论上论证了在设计性缺失情况下应用插补是范畴错误
3. 揭示了插补损害推断的三个机制理论
4. 挑战了"更复杂的算法总能处理缺失数据"的普遍假设
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为研究者提供了评估何时使用插补的决策框架
2. 建议在设计性缺失情况下应尊重实验设计而非盲目插补
3. 警示研究者MICE方法的选择会显著影响研究结论
4. 提供了评估插补方法影响的实证基准

title: From Transition to Physical Risk: Rethinking Portfolio Management
affiliations: Roma Tre University and Amundi Asset Management

detail.title: From Transition to Physical Risk: Rethinking Portfolio Management
detail.abstract:
Over the past fifteen years, responsible investment has evolved, shifting from broad ESG scores to more granular climate risk management. Transition risk has dominated, with portfolio decarbonization anchored in standardized carbon intensity metrics and, more recently, complemented by measures of green intensity. Frameworks such as the comprehensive integrated and core-satellite approaches now give investors effective tools to integrate transition risks into portfolio construction. In contrast, physical climate risk remains underdeveloped. Rising extreme weather events, chronic temperature increases, and ecosystem disruptions are already affecting asset values and supply chains. However, there is no standardized equivalent to carbon or green intensity for benchmarking. 

This paper argues that physical climate risk must now receive the same attention as transition risk. Unlike transition risk, physical climate risk lacks clear anchor metrics. This methodological gap explains why portfolio optimization that incorporates physical risk is still in its infancy. We review transition and physical risk modeling and discuss approaches for constructing physical risk scores. We also examine how to integrate these scores into portfolio optimization and strategic asset allocation. Our analysis shows that achieving significant reductions in both exposure and vulnerability to physical climate risk is extremely challenging. Moreover, the high shadow price associated with these mitigation policies suggests substantial implementation costs and trade-offs. Overall, we conclude that incorporating physical climate risk into portfolio management is considerably more complex than managing transition risk.

AI.tldr: 本文主张物理气候风险应与转型风险受到同等重视，但物理风险缺乏标准化的评估指标，导致其在投资组合优化中应用困难。研究发现降低物理风险暴露和脆弱性极具挑战性，且缓解政策成本高昂，使得物理风险整合比转型风险管理更为复杂。

AI.theoretical_framework: 转型风险与物理气候风险对比框架；投资组合理论；风险整合框架（如综合集成方法和核心-卫星方法）；物理风险评分构建理论；战略资产配置理论。
AI.method: 文献综述法（回顾转型和物理风险建模方法）；分析方法（构建物理风险评分方法）；投资组合优化分析；战略资产分配分析；成本效益分析（影子价格评估）。
AI.findings: 1. 显著降低物理气候风险暴露和脆弱性极其困难；2. 物理风险缓解政策具有高影子价格，意味着实施成本高昂且存在权衡取舍；3. 将物理风险整合到投资组合管理比管理转型风险更为复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统比较了转型风险与物理风险在投资整合中的差异；2. 提出了物理风险评分构建的理论框架；3. 揭示了物理风险整合到投资组合优化的理论挑战和复杂性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了整合物理气候风险到投资组合的实用方法；2. 揭示了物理风险管理的实际成本和实施障碍；3. 为制定物理风险标准化指标提供了方向；4. 帮助投资者更好地评估和管理气候相关投资风险。

detail.abstract: We use survey experiments to demonstrate that manipulating participants’ perceptions of the context can affect their decisions. We ran three survey experiments in the U.S. and Israel with participants from both economics and non-economics majors. In the experiments, participants face a tradeoff between profit maximization (market norm) and workers’ welfare (social norm). Our experimental setup enables us to discriminate between the self-selection and indoctrination effects. Existing studies find that economics and non-economics students make different choices in such situations, which the studies argue is because of differences in personality traits between economics students and others. While such differences might exist, we argue that context also plays an important role. Using priming to manipulate the context, we demonstrate that when participants receive cues signaling that their decision has an economic context, both economics and non-economics students tend to maximize profits. When participants receive cues emphasizing social norms, on the other hand, both economics and non-economics students are less likely to maximize profits. We find that the role of context in determining behavior is at least as large as the baseline differences between economics and non-economics students.

AI.tldr: 通过调查实验证明，操纵参与者的情境感知会影响其决策。当参与者收到经济情境线索时，经济学和非经济学专业学生都倾向于利润最大化；当收到强调社会规范的线索时，两者都较少追求利润最大化。情境对行为的影响至少与经济学和非经济学学生之间的基线差异一样大。
AI.research_question: 情境感知如何影响经济学和非经济学专业学生在利润最大化与工人福利之间的决策选择？情境效应与自我选择/灌输效应相比有多重要？
AI.motivation: 现有研究发现经济学和非经济学学生在此类情境中做出不同选择，通常归因于人格特质差异。本文认为情境也起着重要作用，需要区分自我选择效应和灌输效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场规范（利润最大化）与社会规范（工人福利）的权衡；情境理论（priming效应）；自我选择效应与灌输效应的区分
AI.method: 在美国和以色列进行的三项调查实验，参与者包括经济学和非经济学专业学生。通过priming操纵情境线索（经济情境vs社会规范情境）。实验设计能够区分自我选择效应和灌输效应。
AI.findings: 1) 当参与者收到经济情境线索时，经济学和非经济学学生都倾向于利润最大化；2) 当参与者收到社会规范线索时，两者都较少追求利润最大化；3) 情境对行为的影响至少与经济学和非经济学学生之间的基线差异一样大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明情境在决策中的重要作用，挑战了仅用人格特质差异解释经济学学生行为的观点；2) 提供了区分自我选择效应和灌输效应的实验方法；3) 扩展了情境理论在经济决策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为教育工作者提供启示：经济学教育可能通过情境线索影响学生价值观；2) 为组织管理者提供参考：通过情境设计可以影响员工的决策倾向；3) 为政策制定者提供洞见：情境线索可以引导公众在经济与社会目标间的权衡。

detail.abstract:
We develop a theoretical framework and conduct a laboratory experiment to study how group identity affects cooperative behavior and strategy selection in infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma (IRPD) games. We find that participants are more likely to cooperate and less likely to adopt the Always Defect strategy with ingroup members than with outgroup members or participants in the control condition. Ingroup pairs are also more likely to sustain cooperation but less likely to persist in defection over the dynamic course across supergames, compared to both outgroup and control pairs. However, these effects are statistically significant only in the low strategic risk environment when the discount factor is high enough for cooperation to be both a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium and risk dominant. In the high strategic risk environment where cooperation is
a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium but not risk dominant, the impact of group identity on cooperation is less robust and only holds qualitatively.

title: The 2024 Nobel Laureates Are Not Only Wrong About China, But Also About the West
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: The 2024 Nobel Laureates Are Not Only Wrong About China, But Also About the West
detail.abstract: Yuen Yuen Ang argues that the 2024 Nobel laureates in economics—Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, and James Robinson—offer an outdated and overly simplistic theory of development. She agrees that institutions matter, but criticizes their tendency to equate “good” institutions with Western liberal democracies while ignoring colonial violence, slavery, extraction, and inequality in the rise of wealthy Western states. Using the United States as an example, she contends that prosperity was built not only on democracy and property rights, but also on dispossession, coerced labor, and elite privilege. Ang also rejects the laureates’ explanation of China’s growth as a temporary anomaly or the product of luck. Instead, she argues that China’s post-Mao reforms created partial accountability and bureaucratic adaptability within an authoritarian system, enabling rapid development without Western-style democracy. Overall, she calls for a less ideological, less Western-centric understanding of development and a more realistic defense of democracy’s value.

AI.tldr: Ang批评2024年诺贝尔经济学奖得主的发展理论过于简单化和西方中心主义，认为他们忽视了殖民暴力、奴隶制和不平等在西方发展中的作用，同时错误地将中国发展视为异常现象而非制度创新的结果。
AI.research_question: 西方中心主义的发展理论（如Acemoglu等人的制度理论）是否充分解释了西方国家的发展历程和中国的发展奇迹？

AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学、发展理论、后殖民理论、历史制度主义
AI.method: 理论批判与历史案例分析：1）批判性分析Acemoglu等人的制度理论；2）以美国为例分析西方发展的复杂历史；3）以中国为例分析非西方发展路径
AI.findings: 1）西方发展建立在民主与财产权之外的因素上，包括殖民暴力、奴隶制、剥夺和不平等；2）中国发展不是异常现象，而是通过威权体制内的部分问责和官僚适应性实现的制度创新；3）需要去意识形态化、非西方中心主义的发展理解
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战西方中心主义的发展理论范式；2）提出更复杂、历史化的制度发展观；3）为威权体制下的发展机制提供理论解释；4）推动发展理论的去意识形态化

publicationDetails.detailsText: New literacies in the age of AI: Ethics, teaching, and writing (English Version)

detail.abstract: This chapter examines how to rigorously and scalably integrate generative artificial intelligence into the teaching of cost structures in higher education. The objective is to design a teaching framework and strategy architecture with prompts aimed at strengthening accounting reasoning, traceability, and formative assessment. An evidence-based instructional design approach is adopted that articulates active learning, supervised algorithmic tutoring, and verification protocols. Additionally, prototypes are proposed for activity-based costing, time-based extensions, and cost-volume-profit analysis, along with prompt engineering rubrics and learning outcome matrices. The findings point to significant improvements in process transparency, the relevance of assumptions, and the reasoned defense of decisions when these are based on the documentation of interactions, triangulating product, process, and calculation. It is also noted that quality depends on data curation, critical literacy, and meaningful human oversight. The implementation of responsible use policies, the creation of curriculum-aligned prompt libraries, and the development of assessment cycles with iterative feedback are recommended. The contribution lies in translating the current discussion on generative AI into operational practices that enhance the quality of learning (SDG4) and the reliability of accounting decisions.

title: Flora, Fauna, and Fairness: Reframing Financial Risk as Ecological Responsibility
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Department of Finance, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), University of Melbourne - School of Botany, University of Melbourne, Cambridge Judge Business School - Finance Subject Group, FTSE Russell, London Stock Exchange Group, SKEMA Business School and University of Melbourne

detail.title: Flora, Fauna, and Fairness: Reframing Financial Risk as Ecological Responsibility
detail.abstract: This commentary examines the ethical implications of biodiversity measurement in corporate finance. We argue that the lack of epistemic clarity—the inability to see the specific, spatial consequences of corporate action—is the primary obstacle to ethical biodiversity stewardship. Drawing on the concept of moral decoupling, we contend that this abstraction into simplified financial risk metrics allows decision-makers to overlook the specific ecological consequences of their value chains. We propose that the next generation of biodiversity metrics must move beyond the financialized aggregation of the nature-as-asset paradigm towards spatial resolution. Using the nSTAR methodology as a case study, we demonstrate how spatially explicit tools can serve as Moral Technologies that restore the link between corporate action and ecological reality. By improving the resolution of measurement, these tools provide the necessary epistemic foundation for genuine stewardship and accountability. We conclude that adopting such high-resolution tools is a moral imperative, as they collapse the distance between the boardroom and the biosphere, restoring the capacity for accountability in an age of extinction.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨企业金融中生物多样性测量的伦理问题，认为缺乏认知清晰度（无法看到企业行为的具体空间后果）是伦理生物多样性管理的主要障碍。作者提出下一代生物多样性指标必须超越自然作为资产的金融化聚合，转向空间分辨率。通过nSTAR方法案例，展示了空间明确工具如何作为道德技术恢复企业行为与生态现实之间的联系。

AI.method: 概念分析和案例研究，以nSTAR方法论作为案例研究，展示空间明确工具的应用。
