publicationDetails.detailsText: Longbing Cao. 2025. Humanoid AI with Humanity Modeling: Bridging Humans and Virtual–Physical Humanoids. 1, 1 (February 2025), 40 pages

detail.abstract: The seventy-year AI is now entering another major resurgence, the era of Generative AI (GenAI), characterized by the rapid advancement of large multimodal models (LMMs). GenAI and LMMs are fundamentally transforming sixty-decade-old humanoid robots, advancing them from human-looking and humanlike embodiments toward human-level AI and robotics, and inspiring a new era of AI-robotics symbiosis: humanoid AI. Humanoid AI develops humane AI-driven humanoids (AI humanoids) that go beyond traditional humanlooking robots, which typically exhibit little or no humanity and intelligence due to their dedication to predefined and limited AI functions and exteriors. By contrast, AI humanoids undertake real-time, situated, and interactive mind-to-action, perception-to-behavior, and vision-to-emotion transformations, achieving an unprecedented degree of replicating human characteristics and intelligence. Realizing this vision requires systematic humanity modeling, ensuring that AI humanoids are shaped, guided, and governed by robust frameworks of AI and robotic humanity. We then propose human-virtual-physical humanoid transform and alignment and human-metaverse-humanoid ecosystem for open, complex human-digital-machine-cooperative methodology and problem-solving, followed by general principles and frameworks for building actionable humanoids and evaluating humanoid quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人形AI"概念，将生成式AI和大规模多模态模型应用于人形机器人，使其从传统的外形模仿转向具备人类级智能和行为，实现AI与机器人的深度融合。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生成式AI和大规模多模态模型，将传统的人形机器人转变为具备人类特征和智能的"人形AI"，并建立相应的理论框架和生态系统？
AI.motivation: 当前AI进入生成式AI时代，但传统人形机器人仍局限于预定义功能和外形模仿，缺乏真正的人类智能和人性特征。需要突破这一局限，实现AI与机器人的深度融合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 人形AI理论：超越传统人形机器人的概念框架；2) 人性建模：系统化的人类特征建模方法；3) 人-虚拟-物理人形转换与对齐；4) 人-元宇宙-人形生态系统理论。
AI.method: 提出开放、复杂的人-数字-机器协同方法论和问题解决框架，包括构建可操作人形机器人的通用原则和评估人形质量的框架。
AI.findings: 生成式AI和大规模多模态模型能够从根本上改变传统人形机器人，使其实现实时、情境化、交互式的心智到行动、感知到行为、视觉到情感的转换，达到前所未有的复制人类特征和智能的程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"人形AI"新范式；2) 建立系统性人性建模理论；3) 构建人-虚拟-物理转换对齐框架；4) 提出人-元宇宙-人形生态系统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为构建可操作人形机器人提供通用原则；2) 建立人形质量评估框架；3) 推动AI与机器人深度融合的实际应用；4) 促进开放复杂系统的问题解决方法。

title: AI in the Age of Fake (Imagined) Content
affiliations: University of Florida

detail.title: AI in the Age of Fake (Imagined) Content
detail.abstract: An overview of the current AI landscape and the geopolitical challenges faced in the AI era. The line between what is real and what is fake is rapidly disappearing. We are at a turning point in the era of misinformation and disinformation, with AI fundamentally reshaping how fabricated content is created and spread. Because this threat is borderless, we urgently need a new framework. A global credibility institute that brings together journalists, researchers, technologists, and policymakers can serve as a shared starting point. Such an initiative can help establish common norms and standards for defining, disclosing, and governing content authenticity. Protecting the truth is a public good problem, and establishing a shared epistemic foundation is critical to preserve trust in the AI era.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI时代虚假信息威胁，提出建立全球可信度机构作为应对框架，旨在保护真相这一公共产品
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，如何应对虚假信息威胁并建立可信的内容真实性治理框架？
AI.motivation: AI技术正在根本性地改变虚假内容的生成和传播方式，真实与虚假的界限正在迅速消失，这种无国界的威胁迫切需要新的应对框架
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共产品理论（真相作为公共产品）、信息可信度理论、全球治理框架理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于当前AI技术发展和虚假信息传播现状的理论构建
AI.findings: AI技术加剧了虚假信息威胁，需要建立全球性的可信度机构来制定共同规范和标准，保护真相这一公共产品
AI.theory_contributions: 将真相保护概念化为公共产品问题，提出建立共享认知基础的理论框架，为AI时代信息可信度研究提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 提出建立全球可信度机构的具体建议，为记者、研究人员、技术专家和政策制定者提供合作平台，推动内容真实性标准的制定和实施

title: Trade Finance Use by Heterogeneous Firms
affiliations: World Bank, World Bank, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, affiliation not provided to SSRN and World Bank

detail.title: Trade Finance Use by Heterogeneous Firms
detail.abstract: Letters of credit are a key trade finance instrument that covers more than 10 percent of global trade, with a notably larger role in low-and middle-income economies. Studying detailed trade data from Viet Nam, we document how letter of credit use varies with firm characteristics. We show that the probability of using a letter of credit is systematically lower for younger, smaller, and foreign-owned trading firms. Importers that are less diversified or have less trading experience are more likely to use letters of credit. Firm characteristics have the strongest effects in markets where information is scarce and enforcement is weak. These patterns are consistent with a model in which the ability to screen trading partners and the cost of bank intermediation vary with firm characteristics, and where a firm’s screening ability and country institutions are substitutes. Any policy or intervention that aims at increasing the use of bank-intermediated trade finance will therefore need to take firm heterogeneity into account.

AI.tldr: 研究越南贸易数据，发现信用证使用概率与企业特征相关：年轻、小型、外资企业使用较少，进口商多样化程度低、经验不足则使用更多。企业特征在信息稀缺、执法薄弱的市场中影响最大，符合筛选能力与银行中介成本随企业特征变化的模型。
AI.research_question: 信用证使用如何随企业特征变化？企业特征与制度环境如何影响贸易融资选择？
AI.motivation: 信用证覆盖全球贸易10%以上，在中低收入经济体作用更大，但企业特征如何影响其使用尚不清楚。理解这一关系对设计促进银行中介贸易融资的政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于筛选能力与银行中介成本模型：企业筛选交易对手的能力和银行中介成本随企业特征变化，企业筛选能力与制度环境存在替代关系。
AI.method: 使用越南详细贸易数据，分析信用证使用概率与企业特征的关系，考察不同市场条件下（信息稀缺、执法薄弱）的异质性效应。
AI.findings: 年轻、小型、外资企业使用信用证概率较低；进口商多样化程度低、贸易经验不足则更可能使用信用证。企业特征在信息稀缺、执法薄弱的市场中影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出企业筛选能力与制度环境替代的理论框架，解释企业特征如何影响贸易融资选择，丰富了贸易金融与制度经济学文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：任何促进银行中介贸易融资的政策需要考虑企业异质性，特别是在信息稀缺、执法薄弱的市场中。

title: Peer Gender Composition and University Climate
affiliations: , Bocconi University and University of Turin

detail.title: Peer Gender Composition and University Climate
detail.abstract: Students’ university experience includes both academic and non-academic outcomes, which are shaped by the educational environment in which students interact. We refer to this environment as university climate and measure it along three dimensions: conformity to masculinity-related attitudes and perceptions, the perceived academic impact of mental health (worry and anxiety), and classroom interactions. Using administrative records combined with original survey data, and exploiting the random assignment of students to teaching classes within degree programs at an Italian university, we identify the causal effect of peer gender composition on university climate and academic performance. Greater exposure to female peers reduces conformity to masculinity-related attitudes, lowers the perceived academic impact of mental health, fosters more collaborative classroom interactions, and increases academic performance. These effects are observed for both male and female students. Our findings provide causal evidence that peer gender composition influences multiple dimensions of university climate beyond academic achievement alone.

AI.tldr: 研究利用意大利大学随机分班数据，发现增加女性同伴比例能改善大学氛围（降低男性气质认同、减少心理健康对学业影响的担忧、促进课堂合作），并提高学业成绩，且对男女学生均有积极影响。
AI.research_question: 同伴性别构成如何影响大学氛围（包括男性气质认同、心理健康对学业影响的感知、课堂互动）和学业表现？
AI.motivation: 大学经历包含学术和非学术成果，这些成果受到学生互动教育环境（大学氛围）的影响。了解同伴性别构成如何塑造这种环境对改善高等教育质量具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大学氛围理论，包括三个维度：1）对男性气质相关态度和认知的认同；2）心理健康（担忧和焦虑）对学业的感知影响；3）课堂互动。同伴影响理论，特别是性别构成对群体动态的影响。
AI.method: 使用行政记录与原始调查数据相结合，利用意大利大学学位课程内学生随机分配到教学班级的自然实验设计，识别同伴性别构成对大学氛围和学业表现的因果效应。
AI.findings: 更多接触女性同伴会：1）降低对男性气质相关态度的认同；2）减少心理健康对学业的感知影响；3）促进更合作的课堂互动；4）提高学业表现。这些效应对男女生均存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了同伴性别构成影响大学氛围多个维度的因果证据，超越了仅关注学业成就的传统研究。扩展了对高等教育环境中性别动态的理解，特别是男性气质认同和心理健康感知方面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学管理者提供了改善校园氛围的具体策略：增加班级性别多样性，特别是女性比例，可以创造更包容、合作的学习环境，同时提高所有学生的学业表现。对课程设计和班级安排具有实际指导意义。

title: The Changing Landscape of International Development: An Introduction
affiliations: Princeton University, Yale University - Department of Economics and Yale University - Economic Growth Center

detail.title: The Changing Landscape of International Development: An Introduction
detail.abstract: Since the late 1980s, extreme poverty has declined sharply, life expectancy and schooling have increased, and electoral democracy has expanded. However poverty reduction has slowed in recent years, particularly following the COVID-19 pandemic, amid intensifying conflict, fragility, climate risks, democratic backsliding, and the erosion of global trends—including trade integration and geopolitical stability—that once supported growth. These dynamics raise three interrelated questions: what barriers impede further progress; where will future growth in lower-income countries come from; and how can growth be broadly shared. Taking stock of 15 chapters forthcoming in Volume 6 of the Handbook of Development Economics, we discuss how external conditions, state capacity and policy choices shape development; analyze the shifting growth drivers, including trade, technology and the rise of services; discuss persistent inequality and distributional tensions; and conjecture that investing in institutions and people pays off.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了发展经济学的最新研究，探讨了全球发展面临的挑战：极端贫困减少放缓、冲突加剧、气候风险、民主倒退等问题，分析了未来低收入国家增长来源和包容性增长路径。
AI.research_question: 什么障碍阻碍了进一步发展？低收入国家未来的增长将来自哪里？如何实现广泛共享的增长？
AI.motivation: 自1980年代末以来，极端贫困大幅减少，预期寿命和教育水平提高，民主选举扩大。但近年来减贫速度放缓，特别是在COVID-19大流行后，冲突加剧、脆弱性增加、气候风险、民主倒退以及曾经支持增长的全球趋势（如贸易一体化和地缘政治稳定）受到侵蚀。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展经济学理论框架，涵盖外部条件、国家能力、政策选择对发展的影响；贸易、技术和服务业兴起等增长驱动因素；不平等和分配紧张关系；制度与人力资本投资的重要性。
AI.method: 文献综述和综合分析，基于《发展经济学手册》第6卷即将出版的15章内容，对发展经济学领域的最新研究进行系统性梳理和讨论。
AI.findings: 外部条件、国家能力和政策选择共同塑造发展路径；增长驱动因素正在从传统要素转向贸易、技术和服务业；不平等问题持续存在且分配紧张关系加剧；投资于制度和人力资本具有长期回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了发展经济学的最新理论进展，提出了理解当代发展挑战的综合框架，强调了制度、人力资本和包容性增长在发展理论中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对当前发展挑战的实践指导，强调投资制度和人力资本的重要性，为促进低收入国家可持续和包容性增长提供了政策建议。
